data.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.


Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Join our Product and Regulatory Legal team, embedded with Kraken's Product, Design and Engineering teams to ship novel products and experiences that accelerate the global adoption of crypto. We are a tight, experienced group of lawyers from a diverse range of tradfi, fintech and crypto backgrounds who move fast, stay curious and take pride in the commercial accountability of our advice, partnering directly with Product, senior leadership and Compliance to chart clear, defensible paths to launch and to keep our licensed entities running smoothly.

This is a senior product-facing legal role for the European Union. You will be the lawyer the business trusts on questions that cut across several regimes at once: for example, a single product such as a tokenised equity, a card, or an institutional custody and prime brokerage service can touch the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive ("MiFID II"), the Markets in Crypto-Assets Regulation ("MiCA"), the Payment Services Directive ("PSD2"), the Electronic Money Directive ("EMD2") and banking rules at the same time. You will bring clarity on which regime applies, what it requires, and how to launch within it.

 

The opportunity

Reporting to the Head of Product Legal, you will act as a senior legal adviser to European leadership on new products, licensing structure and regulatory strategy.

  • Own cross-functional product counselling for European Union launches from discovery to design, launch and iteration, giving Product, Engineering, Compliance and leadership decision-ready advice with clear options and risk trade-offs

  • Advise on the regulatory perimeter and classification of new offerings across MiFID II and the Markets in Financial Instruments Regulation ("MiFIR"), MiCA, the European Market Infrastructure Regulation ("EMIR"), payment services and electronic money rules, and banking regulation, including where an instrument or service falls between regimes (for example tokenised securities, crypto-asset derivatives, margin and financing, and stablecoin-linked products)

  • Advise on payments and electronic money offerings, including the Krak card and account propositions, safeguarding, open banking and account-access obligations, and the developing Payment Services Directive 3 and Payment Services Regulation framework

  • Advise on banking-related questions that arise in the European Union, including bank partnerships and sponsor-bank arrangements, deposit-taking and lending perimeter questions, the Capital Requirements Regulation and Directive, and the interaction of these rules with our custody, prime brokerage and financing products

  • Monitor and interpret European Union legislative and supervisory developments, take part in consultations and industry association work where appropriate, and translate their significance for the business proactively

  • Draft and negotiate client-facing terms and conditions, taking clear, business-aligned positions

  • Act as gatekeeper for European Union outside counsel engagements: scope the work, estimate and manage cost, and sign off before matters go externally

  • Mentor and develop more junior lawyers in the team, set quality standards for plain-English, risk-based advice, and act as a senior sounding board for colleagues across the Regulatory Legal team

  • Use AI-assisted tools (for example Enterprise GPTs) to speed up regulatory analysis, first drafts and matter tracking, and to build self-service tools that let stakeholders answer commoditised legal and regulatory questions themselves

  • Advise on anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing requirements affecting products, including the Transfer of Funds Regulation ("Travel Rule") and the new European Union anti-money laundering package, and on market abuse, conduct, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including the Digital Operational Resilience Act ("DORA")

  • Lead or oversee licensing, authorisation and variation workstreams in the European Union, including scoping requirements, mapping pathways, supervising outside counsel, preparing application materials and managing regulator interactions

 
 

What you bring

  • Qualified lawyer admitted in Ireland, England and Wales, or another European Union Member State

  • 15 or more years' post-qualification experience ("PQE") in financial services regulatory law, gained at a regulated financial services institution (for example a bank, payment institution, broker-dealer, exchange, central counterparty or crypto services provider) or at a leading law firm supporting such clients, ideally with in-house or direct product counselling experience

  • Deep, current knowledge of several of the following, with real depth in at least two: MiFID II and MiFIR (investment services, market structure, derivatives and conduct), MiCA (crypto-asset services, custody, trading platforms and stablecoins), European Union payment services and electronic money regulation, and European Union banking regulation

  • Demonstrated ability to analyse novel products against overlapping regimes and give a clear view on classification and perimeter, including in areas where the rules are unsettled or supervisors have not yet spoken

  • Direct experience managing senior regulator relationships, including notifications, information requests, supervisory correspondence and examinations

  • Working knowledge of anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing, outsourcing and operational resilience obligations, including DORA

  • Proven ability to instruct, supervise and manage the cost of outside counsel across multiple jurisdictions

  • Outstanding analytical, drafting and organisational skills, with crisp, plain-English writing

  • Ability to distill complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-lawyer stakeholders and for senior leadership

  • A pragmatic, commercially accountable approach to legal and regulatory risk that gives stakeholders a useful range of options and a clear recommendation

  • Experience mentoring or managing lawyers, and the judgement to know when to escalate

  • Comfort operating with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-moving, remote environment

  • Familiarity with using AI tools such as Enterprise GPTs to increase the efficiency of legal services

You’re going to fix that.

  • Know the product cold. Use Kraken Pro like a trader would, understand what makes it better, and turn those strengths into growth levers.

  • Lead a lean, scrappy team. Set direction, coach, and unblock a small team, while staying hands-on enough to ship, test, and fix things yourself.

  • Test and learn. Run experiments across channels and funnel steps, double down on what works, and kill what doesn’t.

data.title: Clinical AI Engineer
data.description:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

We’re looking for a doctor who has moved into AI and can code, to join Clinical AI R&D as a Clinical AI Engineer. You’ll sit inside a product pod and own the evidence for its product: define the evaluation before anyone builds, run it to a standard a journal reviewer would accept, keep watching the product once it ships, publish what the evidence shows, and change the product when the evidence says to.



The pod’s engineers can change the product but can’t judge whether a discharge summary missed something a consultant would catch. Clinicians can make that call but can’t open a pull request. You do both, and you treat the gap between a model’s output and good clinical practice as the thing you’re here to measure and close.



The loop doesn’t end at launch. You stay with the product for its life in market.

 

What you’ll do

  • Design the evaluation. Define evaluations for greenfield products to an academic standard: endpoints, comparators, ground truth, sample size, analysis plan. Set the bar before the result arrives.

  • Build the measurement. Build, optimize and validate the LLM judges and rubrics that score the product at scale. Report their agreement with clinician ground truth, not their convenience, and retire the ones that drift.

  • Run it and write it up. Execute the evaluation, do the statistics, and write it up once in a form that serves the pod, the regulatory file and an academic submission.

  • Run post-market surveillance. Monitor output quality in production and respond to regulatory feedback with data. Our clinical safety team triages complaints and incidents; you’re their counterpart in the pod, working out what their findings mean for the product and what should change.

  • Fix what the evidence finds. Prompt and rubric changes, evaluation harness changes, code changes in the pod’s codebase, shipped through the pod’s normal review and release process.

  • Publish. Contribute to peer-reviewed literature on the translational benefit of the product.

  • Be the clinician in the room. Catch the output that reads well and is wrong. Hold the line on clinical nuance when a shortcut would ship faster.

 

What you'll need

  • A medical degree and clinical practice with independent clinical judgment. This role runs on medical nuance, and this requirement doesn’t flex.

  • Academic depth. Study design, inferential statistics, agreement and reliability measures, sample size, handling of multiple comparisons. Thesis or publication-level work, not a methods module.

  • Experience evaluating medical software or clinical AI, including building or validating LLM-as-judge pipelines.

  • Enough engineering to work in a production codebase. Read it, understand what a change will do, make the change in Python or TypeScript, and get it through review. Prompt engineering and AI-assisted coding are daily tools here, and they’re the floor, not the ceiling.

  • Independence. You can run a project for weeks with light direction, and you say early when it’s stuck.

  • Clear writing. Evaluation reports, surveillance summaries and manuscripts are the primary output of this role.

Nice to have

  • Post-market surveillance or vigilance work under a medical device framework (TGA, MHRA, FDA or EU MDR). Appetite to learn counts for more than existing depth.

  • Peer-reviewed publications on clinical AI or LLM evaluation.

  • Machine learning background beyond prompting, such as fine-tuning or classical model evaluation.

  • Specialty depth in an area Heidi is moving into.

  • An academic or clinical-site network able to host a study.

How we show up

  • Build for the next decade, not next quarter. Our targets are outrageous on purpose. The world's health doesn't have the luxury of incrementalism.

  • Lead, don't wait. We treat tomorrow's problems today. Sometimes we build what's needed before it's wanted, and we're fine with that.

  • Follow the evidence. Trust the patient. We pursue truth relentlessly. But when the subjective and objective disagree, we treat the patient, not the numbers. Ego is a comorbidity we can't afford.

  • Own the outcome. Everyone here carries the company. Raise problems with solutions, solve them end-to-end, and never be a bystander.

  • Ship, measure, go again. A button today, a workflow tomorrow. More iterations beat better planning. We're precise at pace, not reckless.

  • Live in clinicians' reality. Not the ideal workflow, the twenty-patients-before-lunch actual one. We build for exhausted humans, and we'd better be decent ones while we do it.

 

Why Heidi?

You’ll join a team measured on real-world impact, not press cycles. We live and breathe the challenges of modern health systems, and are laser-focused on exacting the change we’d like to see. We’re medicos, engineers, builders and designers who’ve felt (on every side of the equation) what non-care feels like, the moral and practical toll as a provider or receiver.

Building what we’re building isn’t always easy. Standard tech playbooks routinely fail in healthcare, and the friction of the medical system will test your perseverance. But we didn’t choose easy, we chose a purpose-driven mission that actually matters. We hold ourselves to a higher standard because healthcare demands it. If you join Heidi, you recognize that the deeper question isn’t whether AI can solve the global healthcare crisis, but whose hands will shape it.

True A-players progress extremely fast here. The nature of the scale-up game is demanding, but we value sustainable performance and mental health. You're trusted to perform, and you set your schedule. We operate on outcomes > inputs, not process theatre. We all take the bins out, metaphorically and literally.

Our Benefits

  • Equity from day one. When Heidi wins, you win. You'll share directly in the success you help create.

  • Your health, covered. Comprehensive private medical and dental cover through Bupa, plus 24/7 mental health, coaching and wellbeing support through Sonder and a £100/month Healthy Heidi’s stipend.

  • Global parental leave. 26 weeks paid for primary carers and 18 weeks for secondary carers, subject to eligibility.

  • Fertility support. £7,000 one-off payment, eligibility applies.

  • Learning & development. £700 per year for courses, books, memberships, conferences and more.

  • Home office budget of £500 one-off to set up a workspace you actually want to work in.

  • Recharge days after major milestones and busy periods so you can reset and come back strong.

  • Work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year, wherever the world takes you.

  • Clinical leave. 10 days per year for eligible clinical roles to maintain accreditation and requirements.

  • Flexibility that works. A hybrid environment, with 3 days in the office.

Heidi’s commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

Heidi is dedicated to creating an equitable, inclusive, and supportive work environment that brings people together from diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Our strength is in our differences. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are proud to welcome all applicants as we're committed to promoting a culture of opportunity for all.

data.title: Principal Product Designer (Ventures)
data.description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Join us in our mission to transform the way people shop and eat, where impact, innovation and growth drive everything we do. Our Product team defines how millions of people experience Deliveroo, turning complex marketplace challenges into simple, high-impact solutions. Working at the intersection of data, design and engineering, we set direction, prioritise what matters most, and deliver outcomes that move the business forward.

We're looking for a Principal Product Designer to join our Ventures team in London. You'll be the senior design voice on an early-stage product, taking it from first concept to a test-market launch and shaping it for global scale.

About Ventures

Ventures is DoorDash's internal incubator, where we build the next generation of businesses adjacent to our core. We fund small teams with a strong sense of ownership and grow the investment as they hit clear milestones. Early on, teams build a Minimum Lovable Product and prove product-market fit in a single country. Successful initiatives graduate to new resources and new markets, with the chance to become the next billion-euro businesses at DoorDash. Ventures teams are scrappy and ambitious, chase goals that almost feel too ambitious, and thrive on a startup mentality and a high tolerance for ambiguity. We're now placing bigger and more diverse bets than ever, and we need people with equal ambition and drive to build and scale, or sunset, some of our biggest experiments yet.

What You'll Be Doing

Vision & Influence

  • Define the design vision and strategy across several Ventures products, deciding what to build at product-area level and sequencing work across teams.
  • Become an expert on local market dynamics, ensuring each product is shaped by how people behave in each place.
  • Partner with product-area leadership as a trusted advisor, shaping roadmaps and priorities.
  • Build like a founder: set success metrics, share weekly updates, present at key business reviews and partner with your cross-functional team leads to build the case for further investment.

Craft & Leadership

  • Deliver differentiated, step-change improvements to customer journeys in crowded markets.
  • Design scalable foundations across complex journeys, and turn regulatory constraints into simple experiences with legal, finance and operations.
  • Build systems, prototyping frameworks and AI-enhanced workflows, setting the standards that drive adoption.
  • Establish critiques and planning practices, mentor senior designers and emerging leaders, and hire senior designers and first-line managers.

What You'll Need to Thrive

  • Product-Area Leadership: Proven experience leading design initiatives across multiple products, including taking more than one from 0-1.
  • Product Judgement: A track record of spotting opportunities that improve long-term outcomes, backed by exceptional craft.
  • Strategic Influence: Credibility with senior leaders and the ability to connect customer research, business goals and feasibility into one strategy.
  • Developing Leaders: A history of coaching designers and managers and recruiting talent that wants to join you.
  • Systems and AI Fluency: Experience building tools and standards that scale across teams.
  • Bias for Action: Comfort with ambiguity in a fast-moving, startup-style environment.

Why Join Us?

At Deliveroo, you'll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that's constantly evolving.

We're food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:

🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.

🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.

🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.

🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.

​​💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you're rewarded for the impact you make.

➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our Tech Blog.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We're committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you'll have the opportunity to let us know once you've submitted your application. We'll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you're excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we'd love to hear from you!

Project Coordinator

Location: London, with travel across Europe · Reports to: Delivery Manager · Team: Delivery

Company Overview:

Radiant is redefining how AI infrastructure is built.

We design and operate AI-native cloud platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale. Our infrastructure powers GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems designed for the most demanding environments.

We are not building a generic cloud. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure — from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale, we're building this organisation from the ground up. We're looking for people who'd rather build the playbook than inherit one — who are comfortable doing the work themselves as well as directing others, and who can adapt as fast as our strategy does. This is a startup model: attitude and adaptability matter more to us than years of experience or the size of team you've previously managed.

This is a client-side role supporting our Delivery Manager across data centre construction projects, with exposure to executive stakeholders, EPCs, contractors, cost consultants, equipment OEMs, and the teams receiving each completed site.

What You'll Do

You'll own governance and reporting across Radiant's live construction projects, for all RIBA stages, supporting multiple sites across regions from our London base. You'll work directly with the Delivery Manager, running the project controls and taking ownership of building new ones where gaps appear.

 

Key Responsibilities

Programme and Governance

  • Own the governance cadence — agendas, pre-reads, minutes, action logs and decision registers — and chase overdue items without waiting to be asked.

  • Track programme milestones, stage gate criteria and critical path dependencies across multiple sites, flagging slippage early.

  • Maintain risk and issue logs, making sure every item has an owner, a mitigation and a date.

Procurement and Contractors

  • Track long-lead items against programme dates and escalate risk to energisation early.

  • Be the day-to-day interface with contractors and consultants: progress meetings, RFIs, submittals and change requests.

Cost

  • Keep a close eye on monthly costs against budget, tracking forecasts and change across each site.

  • Review interim payment valuations submitted by the Project Manager and cost consultant ahead of our approval, checking them against progress, programme and budget, and raising queries early.

Reporting and Information

  • Produce clear regular reporting for senior stakeholders.

  • Keep project documents, drawings and correspondence organised and easy to find.

Build the playbook

  • Help define Radiant's project controls templates, reporting standards and lessons-learned routines from scratch.

What You Bring:

  • Attitude matters more to us here than number of years of experience.

  • Experience in construction projects, on the contractor, consultant or developer side.

  • A working understanding of the design and construction lifecycle (RIBA Stages 2–6 or equivalent).

  • Comfort with numbers — budgets, forecasts and payment valuations — and the confidence to question them.

  • Comfort building routines and templates from experience rather than inheriting mature ones.

  • We're hiring for the instinct to spot problems early and follow them through, not years of managing a project office.

  • Clear writing and confidence chasing contractors, consultants and suppliers.

  • Willingness to travel to sites across Europe at short notice as projects demand; this is not a purely desk-based role.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have):

  • Data centre or other mission-critical infrastructure experience.

  • Familiarity with scheduling and document control tools.

  • APM PMQ, PRINCE2, or equivalent.

Qualities we look for:

  • Set the standard: Every single day, you spot opportunities to constructively shake things up.

  • Inspire the change: There's no blueprint for the future. You'll embrace challenges and change.

  • You're real and you're true to yourself: We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are and whoever you're talking to, you treat everyone the same.

  • Get stuck in: You'd rather be building than overseeing. Our strategy will keep evolving, and so will you — attitude and adaptability matter more to us than a fixed playbook or a big team behind you.

We design and operate AI-native infrastructure platforms engineered for sovereignty, performance, and scale — powering GPU-native workloads, multi-tenant control planes, and high-performance AI systems for the most demanding environments. We are building purpose-built AI infrastructure from powered land, to compute, to software.

As we scale our operations and deploy capital into the next generation of AI infrastructure, we are looking to expand our finance team with leaders who can combine technical strength with execution excellence and are driven to build.

Radiant was established by Brookfield, a leading global alternative asset manager with over US$1 trillion of assets under management across real estate, infrastructure, renewable power and transition, private equity and credit. Brookfield's global relationships, investment expertise and access to long-term institutional capital provide Radiant with a differentiated platform from which to develop, finance and operate AI infrastructure assets. This combination of entrepreneurial execution and institutional sponsorship enables Radiant to pursue large-scale GPU and AI infrastructure opportunities globally.

About the Role

Location: UK (occasional travel to data centre and test environments, confirm exact cadence) | Employment Type: Full-time, Permanent | Reports to: VP Information Security

We're looking for a Principal/ Staff Security Engineer to join Infosec, reporting to our VP InfoSec. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will need a deep, technical understanding of Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls to manage our production environment.

As we move toward owning and operating more of our own data centre footprint, the accuracy of our firewall policies, network access controls and technical security testing matters more than ever. This role will build our internal penetration testing capability, so testing becomes more targeted and accurate over time, working alongside our external testers rather than replacing them. You will need to work proactively across engineering teams so knowledge does not sit with one person alone.

What You'll Do

Security Testing & Audit:

  • Audit firewall policies and network access controls across the estate.

  • Conduct internal penetration testing, working alongside our external penetration testing partners.

  • Build a penetration testing strategy and cadence that improves accuracy and coverage over time.

  • Identify and help remediate security gaps found through testing and audit.

Production Estate & Technical Depth:

  • Build and maintain a deep, working understanding of our production environment, including Kubernetes clusters, network architecture and access controls.

  • Investigate technical issues directly and dig into root cause, rather than relying on reported findings alone.

  • Support the VP Infosec on controls testing across the Production Estate.

Access & Environment Management:

  • Own and maintain SSO and systems access configuration.

  • Build and maintain penetration testing environments, including small Kubernetes clusters as needed.

  • Maintain the tooling and infrastructure supporting security testing.

Collaboration:

  • Work proactively across engineering teams to avoid becoming a single point of knowledge or failure.

  • Document processes, findings and configurations so knowledge is shared, not siloed.

  • Partner with the Head of Security Operations on shared governance, risk reporting and security testing.

What You'll Bring

  • Strong Kubernetes experience, with the technical depth to investigate and resolve issues directly.

  • Experience auditing firewall policies and network access controls.

  • Experience conducting or coordinating penetration testing.

  • Comfortable maintaining and operating security tooling and environments on an ongoing basis.

  • Strong written communication skills, given the solo nature of the role.

  • Experience operating as the sole security engineer, or within a small security team.

Nice to Have

  • Network engineering experience or strong networking fundamentals.

  • Background in data centre environments, or related infrastructure environments.

  • Experience with AI security specifically.

  • Exposure to compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2, and an understanding of how technical controls map to audit evidence.

Why Join Radiant

  • Build Radiant's internal penetration testing capability at a moment when our security and compliance obligations are scaling fast, as a Brookfield portfolio company moving into owned data centre operations.

  • Work directly with our VP Infosec and Head of Security Operations, protecting both our corporate and production estates.

  • Be part of a team whose work protects the infrastructure powering sovereign and enterprise AI deployments globally.

  • Develop your career in a Brookfield backed company with resources, mentorship and genuine growth opportunities.

data.title: Datacentre Operations Engineer
data.description:
About Us

Radiant is powered intelligence, delivering scalable, high-performance compute infrastructure purpose-built for AI and HPC workloads. Operating across global data centres, we run mission-critical environments where uptime, throughput, and ultra-low latency are non-negotiable.

Role Overview

We are seeking a deeply technical, hardware-passionate Datacentre Operations Engineer to execute on-the-ground operations for our new East London deployment—Radiant's newest AI infrastructure site. This role focuses on delivering precise, repeatable physical practices—including advanced smart-hands support, complex cabling, and hands-on operation of high-density, air-cooled compute systems—to guarantee world-class SLAs on next-generation hardware architecture.

Working closely with Infrastructure (HPC) SRE, Network Engineering, and Datacentre Strategy teams, you will uphold uncompromising standards across East London's data centre floor, spanning multiple data halls. You will live and breathe the hardware, maintaining elite facility reliability through hands-on deployment, proactive maintenance, rapid incident response, and structured break/fix execution across high-density air cooling systems, busbar-based power distribution, and next-generation GPU compute platforms. The role centres on technical execution and optimised output.

You will turn global engineering standards into flawless, repeatable daily routines, continually honing on-the-ground practices to keep our most advanced hardware running at peak performance. East London's hardware platform is NVIDIA B300-class, fully air-cooled compute, delivered through a new OEM partner being onboarded to Radiant's fleet; while the interfaces and overall architecture closely align with other OEM platforms you may already know, you'll be one of the first teams operating it on the ground, so a fast learning curve and strong first-principles troubleshooting matter more than prior exposure to this specific vendor.

You will be part of the founding team standing up 24x7x365 on-site coverage at East London to meet tight customer SLAs, and as Radiant expands its EMEA footprint, your relentless drive for hardware perfection and proven field expertise with high-density environments will serve as the operational blueprint to scale execution models efficiently across the region.

What’s in it for you?

Join a team operating some of the world’s most advanced high-performance computing infrastructure. As a Datacentre Operations Engineer, you’ll work hands-on with cutting-edge GPU and CPU platforms — including the latest NVIDIA architectures — powering dense, large-scale compute environments used for AI, machine learning, and next-generation workloads.

This is an opportunity to build expertise at the forefront of modern infrastructure, where reliability, scale, and performance matter every day. You’ll collaborate with experienced engineers across a globally distributed organisation that values openness, inclusion, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

We move quickly, solve meaningful challenges, and give people the space to make an impact. If you thrive in fast-paced environments, enjoy working with advanced technology, and want to help shape the future of high-performance compute, you’ll find both challenge and opportunity here.

You can also expect:

  • Exposure to industry-leading GPU and AI infrastructure

  • Opportunities to grow alongside a rapidly scaling global business

  • A collaborative, inclusive, and supportive engineering culture

  • Real ownership and the ability to influence operational excellence

  • Work that sits at the intersection of people, performance, and technology

  • A modern, flexible, globally connected workplace with ambitious goals

Key Responsibilities

Hardware Operations & Break/Fix

  • Quickly diagnose and resolve hardware and network issues to maximise uptime; execute structured fault isolation methodologies to drive rapid resolution

  • Respond to critical hardware alerts via our monitoring and observability platform; contribute to ongoing service improvement to improve monitoring capability and alert quality

  • Deploy and maintain HPC and AI hardware for uninterrupted operations, including hardware troubleshooting, firmware updates, and component replacement

  • Execute break/fix procedures for advanced hardware platforms, including GPU module exchange, component-level fault isolation, and firmware-level diagnostics

  • Execute or support break/fix operations on ultra-high-density compute systems including NVIDIA B300-class chassis or equivalent platforms, including GPU/fan module exchange, chassis-level fault isolation, and busbar connection/disconnection—under the direction of the Lead where qualification is in progress

Air Cooling Operations

  • Operate, monitor, and maintain high-density air cooling infrastructure in conjunction with our datacentre partner, including CRAC/CRAH units, in-row and containment cooling, and associated airflow management systems

  • Facilitate in conjunction with our datacentre partner, routine and corrective maintenance on air cooling systems: monitoring supply/return temperatures and airflow rates, maintaining hot-aisle/cold-aisle containment and blanking, and performing scheduled filter and component inspections

  • Follow and contribute to SOPs for safe working around high-density, air-cooled compute platforms

  • Monitor thermal performance and raise anomalies before they escalate into incidents

Capacity Management

  • Contribute to site-level capacity management operations, maintaining accurate records of power, space, and cooling utilisation

  • Support capacity planning activities by providing accurate as-built data and flagging infrastructure changes to the Lead and relevant teams

  • Manage on-the-ground assets from point of purchase and delivery through lifecycle management and disposal, owning asset management within Radiant's CMDB system

Infrastructure & Facilities

  • Handle RMAs and support requests within Radiant's Service Level Objectives (SLOs) to meet customer contract SLAs

  • Contribute to ongoing maintenance, fostering compliance and leveraging strong vendor partnerships

  • Operate cooling, power distribution (including busbar and PDU infrastructure), and other critical data centre technologies to maintain high operational standards

  • Develop and maintain datacentre/hardware management SOPs, ensuring continual alignment with Radiant's governance and compliance requirements

Service & Operational Excellence

  • Apply ITSM frameworks: Incident, Major Incident, Change Management, and service improvement

  • Operate and support services 24x7x365 for production environments as part of a structured on-site shift rotation—working 12-hour shifts across a 4-team pattern with two engineers on shift at all times—to meet tight customer SLAs

  • Prioritise and triage incident and smart-hands workload ensuring tight SLA coverage is maintained with a small on the ground team

  • Contribute to Incident postmortem analyses, root cause analysis, document learnings, and automate remediations

  • Communicate technical decisions clearly to stakeholders and customers

  • Champion a culture of: do, document, automate

  • Willing to cross train and upskill in Infrastructure/Platform SRE practices

  • Willing to travel across EMEA to support future datacentre onboarding and train in new technologies

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science/Electrical Engineering, or 5+ years of directly relevant industry experience in data centre operations

  • 3+ years of experience in data centre operations, HPC, or related roles

  • Passion for hardware and upholding the highest operational standards on the ground

  • Strong communication skills in English

  • Proven hands-on experience with HPC/NVIDIA GPU platforms or equivalent high-density compute systems, high-performance storage, and networking

  • Practical knowledge of high-density air cooling systems—CRAC/CRAH operation, airflow and thermal monitoring, containment management, and associated maintenance—or strong related cooling infrastructure experience

  • Experience with, or demonstrable willingness and aptitude to train on, ultra-high-density compute platforms such as NVIDIA B300, busbar-based power distribution, or equivalent systems

  • Experience with and passion for management of compute at massive scale

  • Comfort operating a newly-onboarded OEM hardware platform, applying transferable knowledge from other high-density GPU/HPC OEM systems to ramp up quickly without direct prior exposure to this specific vendor

  • Familiarity with structured break/fix practices for complex hardware platforms, including module-level component exchange and firmware fault isolation

  • Expertise in hardware installation, network configuration, and low-level system maintenance, including firmware management

  • Knowledge of data centre environment technologies, including cooling and high-density power distribution

  • Understanding of capacity management principles: power, space, and cooling tracking

  • Strong understanding of hardware and spares management; ability to handle RMAs within defined SLOs

  • Understanding of HPC and AI workloads at a high level

  • Strong problem-solving abilities and resilience in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong grasp of ITSM and service operation best practices

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate with cross-functional, internationally dispersed teams

  • Comfortable interfacing with internal stakeholders and external customers

  • Bonus: Vendor-endorsed qualifications from NVIDIA or equivalent OEMs for high-density, air-cooled AI compute systems

Preferred Qualifications

  • Knowledge of large scale private cloud deployments and capacity planning.

  • Qualifications in HVAC management and deployments

  • Certifications in relevant areas - Hardware, Networking

  • ITIL Foundation level qualification or equivalent experience

data.description:
Our Mission

At Omnea, we’re reinventing how enterprise businesses operate, starting with the most painful parts: procurement – where a single purchase can drag on for months, trigger 50+ emails, and pull in Finance, Legal, Security, and IT just to get something approved.

We’ve raised $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, and Accel to change that. Our AI-native platform connects every person, step, and system so buying is fast, safe, and efficient – one place to request, automated approvals and renewals, real-time supplier risk, and complete spend visibility.

The opportunity is massive. Every enterprise on the planet has this problem and nobody has solved it. We’ve 10x’d ARR to double-digit millions in 18 months and are trusted by global enterprises like Spotify, MongoDB, Monzo, and Albertsons. We’re now the 4th fastest growing startup in Europe & the Sunday Times' #1 Best Medium Sized Tech Company To Work for.

Our team previously scaled Tessian (cybersecurity tech, backed by Sequoia, Balderton, Accel, acquired post-Series C), and our team includes ex-founders operators who’ve grown unicorns, shipped world-class products, and executed at the highest levels. You’ll work alongside leaders like Ben, Abs, Sabrina, and Rebe.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The Role

We're looking for our Founding Technical Solutions Consultant to join our high-performance team.

As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you’ll be the critical bridge between Product and Customer teams. You’ll align Omnea’s platform with customer needs, dive deep into technical configurations, troubleshoot complex integration challenges, and help shape the future of procurement.

You’ll work directly with some of the world’s leading tech companies (like Spotify, TeamViewer, McAfee, Pleo, and more), helping them unlock the full potential of Omnea.

You’ll be joining us at a pivotal time. We’ve just raised $50M in Series B funding from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, Accel, Point Nine, and First Round Capital. In the past year we’ve grown revenue 5x, tripled our customer base, and maintained >99% retention with enterprises like Spotify, Wise, Albertsons, Adecco, and McAfee. Our team is small but high-calibre -- it took over 10,000 interviews to hire our first 50 Omneans.

Now we’re scaling fast and building the category of AI Supplier Relationship Management. And we are looking for the best Technical Solutions Consultant out there to help turn procurement into a true competitive advantage!

What You Can Expect

You’ll also assist the Commercial team by rapidly creating solutions for sophisticated demos.

You’ll help own Customer Experience, managing the delivery and prioritisation of Eng support tickets.

This involves working closely with them to prioritise, scope, and deliver features that reduce churn and drive upsell, informed by a thorough analysis of Customer asks. You'll also assist with writing Product tickets to define engineering requirements and manage their delivery.

This includes helping develop and refine the Omnea Knowledge Repository, managing our Product Accreditation, and creating Customer Training/Support materials. You’ll also produce and maintain technical materials to assist with Customer implementations and project work (Onboarding Workflows, Workflow Templates, Form Templates, Technical Documentation).

About You

You’re ambitious and hard-working, and will succeed at whatever you put your mind to. You make up for any potential lack of experience with intelligence, grit, and a constant growth mindset. You have natural hustle and know how to get things done.

data.title: Technical Support & Operations Engineer
data.description:
Quandela is a global leader in quantum computing, designing, building, and delivering cutting-edge quantum solutions for research and industry. Its offerings include the most energy-efficient quantum computers for data centers, full-stack quantum computing solutions accessible via the cloud, and algorithm access services for academic and industrial customers. Following a pragmatic, step-by-step roadmap, Quandela has been deploying industrial-grade systems since 2023 while developing future generations of fault-tolerant quantum computers capable of scaling through the integration of thousands of photonic components. Quandela is committed to making quantum computing accessible to all in order to address the most complex industrial and societal challenges.

Learn more at: Quandela | Leading Photonic Quantum Computing Solutions

Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀 

About the Role

As part of the continued growth of our activities and the deployment of our photonic Quantum Processing Units (QPUs) to international customers, we are looking for a Technical Support & Operations Technician / Engineer to join our team.

You will contribute to the operational monitoring of Quandela's QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites, ensuring their proper operation and supporting maintenance activities, both remotely and on site.

Working at the interface between Quandela's technical teams and system users, you will develop a broad understanding of our products, particularly the interactions between hardware equipment and software control interfaces. You will perform initial technical investigations when issues arise and involve the relevant technical experts when required.

The role combines technical support, maintenance, field interventions, training and continuous improvement in a complex and international technological environment.

Internal training will provide you with the specific knowledge required to understand our technology and systems. No previous experience in quantum computing is required.

As our support and maintenance activities are still being structured, you will also contribute to improving our processes, tools and operational methods.

Your Key Responsibilities:  

System operations & technical support

You will contribute to maintaining the operational performance and availability of QPUs and other hardware products deployed at customer sites.

    • Monitor the operation and performance of installed systems.
    • Analyse operational data and identify anomalies or performance degradation.
    • Perform initial technical investigations to characterise issues and help determine the appropriate resolution path.
    • Follow up on technical incidents and corrective actions with the relevant teams.
    • Maintain accurate technical records of systems and interventions.
    • Provide remote technical support to customers and trained personnel working on the systems.

Maintenance & customer-site interventions

You will contribute to the preparation and follow-up of preventive and corrective maintenance activities.

    • Track maintenance schedules and anticipate upcoming interventions.
    • Identify the resources, equipment, spare parts and technical expertise required for each intervention.
    • Perform diagnostic, maintenance and system recovery operations according to established procedures.
    • Support technicians and technical experts remotely or on site during interventions.
    • Perform functional checks and testing following maintenance activities.
    • Track completed actions, outstanding issues and upcoming maintenance requirements.

The role involves business travel within France and internationally, with frequency and duration depending on the needs of our installed systems.

User training & technical guidance

You will help customers and technical operators become increasingly autonomous in operating and maintaining our QPUs.

    • Train users and technical operators on routine QPU operation and maintenance activities.
    • Support users in operating the systems and their control interfaces.
    • Share best practices for operation, troubleshooting and maintenance.
    • Contribute to the creation and improvement of training materials and technical documentation.

Documentation & continuous improvement

You will ensure the traceability of technical operations and contribute to structuring our support and maintenance activities.

    • Prepare technical monitoring, intervention and maintenance reports.
    • Maintain up-to-date technical documentation for installed systems.
    • Contribute to writing and improving diagnostic, maintenance and operating procedures.
    • Capitalise on field experience to improve reliability and facilitate future interventions.
    • Contribute to implementing tools and methods for the structured monitoring of our installed systems.

Requirements

Education & experience

  • Associate's, Bachelor's or Master's degree in instrumentation, applied physics, optoelectronics or a related technical field.
  • The position is open to both experienced technicians and engineers with a strong interest in hands-on, operational activities.
  • Previous experience in operations, system integration, maintenance or technical support for complex systems is preferred.
  • Experience working in a multidisciplinary hardware/software environment is highly valued.
  • Experience supporting or maintaining technical equipment installed at customer sites would be an advantage.

Technical skills Required

  • Good understanding of complex technical systems combining hardware and software.
  • Knowledge of electronics, instrumentation and/or control systems.
  • Ability to analyse operational data and characterise technical issues.
  • Ability to perform diagnostic and maintenance operations according to established procedures.
  • Ability to identify and involve the appropriate technical experts when required.
  • Strong organisational skills and ability to rigorously track interventions, deadlines and outstanding actions.
  • Ability to follow, write and improve technical procedures.
  • Professional fluency in English, both written and spoken, as you will interact directly with international customers and colleagues, deliver training sessions and produce technical documentation.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally.

Nice to have

  • Knowledge of optics, photonics and/or cryogenics.
  • Hands-on experience with optical systems, including basic optical alignment.
  • Experience operating or maintaining cryogenic systems.
  • Basic programming or scripting skills, particularly Python.
  • Experience maintaining scientific or industrial equipment.
  • Experience delivering technical training to users or operators.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary, flexible based on your experience
  • Profit-sharing & company savings plan
  • 100% health coverage (Alan)
  • 50% transport reimbursement or sustainable mobility bonus
  • Meal vouchers (Swile), Gymlib fitness support
  • Childcare assistance & referral bonuses (€1,000–€2,000)

What we offer

  • A meaningful role with real ownership, from day one
  • A team eager to collaborate and grow with you
  • A hybrid work model (3 days/week onsite in Massy, 1 day in Paris, 1 to 2 days remotely)
  • Daily exposure to the entire quantum stack — from high-level APIs to low-level firmware, and everything in between.

Process

  • Talent Acquisition Interview (30' - 45')
  • Hiring Manager Interview (45')
  • Use Case (a live use case or one to be prepared at home and presented afterward)
  • Meeting with the teams
  • 2 reference check
  • Offer

(This process is provided for guidance only and may evolve depending on the roles)

At Quandela, we believe that the strength of our team is the plurality of experiences, perspectives, and journeys. We are committed to building a respectful, inclusive, and welcoming work environment. All applications are welcome.

data.title: Legal Counsel - AdTech Transactions
data.description:
About Voodoo

Voodoo is a consumer tech company founded in Paris in 2013, with one mission: entertain the world. Today we are 1,000 people, generating $1b+ in annual revenue, profitably. Our games and apps have passed 7 billion downloads and reach 200 million+ active users every month, making Voodoo the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in downloads, after Google and Meta. We were backed by Goldman Sachs, Tencent and GBL along the way.

Team

Our Corporate teams support the company’s performance and growth whilst putting people at the core of everything they do. As a French tech leader and global successful company, our Corporate teams are constantly looking for ways to innovate and increase organization efficiency to keep Voodoo ahead of the market. Voodoo’s Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo’s success.

Role

We're looking for a Legal Counsel, AdTech Transactions to join our Legal team. In this role, you'll own the contracts and legal questions across Voodoo's advertising activity: selling ad inventory in our apps, buying user acquisition at scale, and the ad network we are now launching to connect third-party publishers and advertisers.

This position sits at the intersection of ad tech, commercial contracting, and data and privacy law, in a market where platform policies, ATT, GDPR, and consent frameworks change several times a year. Your work will directly shape how Voodoo monetizes its inventory, buys and measures user acquisition, grows its advertising network, and handles player data,while keeping us within legal and platform requirements and player expectations.

Your main responsibilities :

  • Own ad tech transactions end-to-end for Voodoo's games and apps portfolio: draft, negotiate and close agreements with mediation platforms, ad networks, exchanges and SSPs on the sell side, and with ad networks, DSPs, direct advertisers and rewarded platforms on the buy side,including the incentive and rebate agreements (bonuses, UA credits, payment terms), that drive the commercial terms..

  • Negotiate agreements with mobile measurement partners, attribution and analytics vendors, data providers and other partners

  • Advise on SDK integrations and data flows together with the Privacy team, so contracts match what the tech actually does

  • Build our advertising network's contract framework and advertising policies for third-party publishers, advertisers and programmatic partners; negotiate its infrastructure agreements and structure its commercial offers on the legal side

  • Manage partner disputes with networks, mediation platforms and other ad tech partners, including reporting discrepancies, invalid traffic (IVT) and compensation claims, from first analysis through negotiated resolution.

  • Track and apply platform policy changes and translate them into contract positions and business guidance

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Monetization, UA, Ad Network, Publishing and other product teams, serving as a trusted legal partner who helps the business move with speed and confidence

  • Build scalable legal infrastructure-templates, playbooks, fallback positions, contract tooling - that allows the business to operate efficiently as volume grows

Profile

  • 5-7 years of relevant legal experience, with meaningful time spent on ad tech and mobile/programmatic advertising, ideally in-house

  • Substantive familiarity with ad tech: you understand how mediation, in-app bidding, SDK-based data collection, attribution and device identifiers work at a technical level - not just a conceptual one - and you know who does what along the supply chain

  • Transactional experience: you've negotiated agreements with companies across the advertising ecosystem, ideally on both the publisher and advertiser side

  • Privacy law fluency: you handle the privacy side of a deal as comfortably as the commercial side

  • Industry standards: you know IAB terms and the TCF inside out

  • Risk tolerance and business judgment: you're comfortable making calls in the absence of perfect information, offering clear and concise risk framing that avoids unnecessary stalling of the business. You operate like a business partner, not outside counsel

  • Strong communication skills: you translate complex legal requirements into plain language for technical and non-technical stakeholders alike, and you're comfortable presenting your views succinctly and with confidence

  • Autonomy and initiative: you take ownership of your portfolio, identify problems before they escalate, and propose solutions rather than waiting to be directed

  • Master 2 in business law, IT/digital law or IP law from a French university or equivalent; avocat or in-house juriste profiles are equally welcome; an LL.M. or study abroad experience is a plus

  • Full professional English required

Benefits

  • Competitive salary based on experience

  • Swile Lunch voucher

  • Gymlib (100% covered by Voodoo)

  • Premium healthcare coverage with SideCare, 100% covered for you and your family

  • Wellness activities in our Paris office

  • Remote Fridays

data.title: Senior Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
data.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA. If you’re someone who is excited and driven by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

Sales Cycle Ownership

  • Coplan and execute discovery calls to understand customer requirements, their technical environment, and current business challenges.

  • Design and deliver compelling demonstrations that solve customer problems, quantify the value of solving those problems, and tell a clear, credible story of how Synthesia solves them better than anything else.

  • Understand and overcome technical objections and integration concerns; identify blockers early and develop solution paths with customers.

  • Support stakeholder workshops that connect Synthesia to the buyer's broader technology strategy on complex, multi-stakeholder deals.

  • Partner with Account Executives to define account and deal strategy, advise on competitive positioning, and provide your assessment of opportunity stage and forecast your book of business to leadership.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable Demo methodologies that prove Synthesia’s business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, designing Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively empower executive champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objections, and industry playbooks brought to life directly in Synthesia’s platform.

  • Support POC and pilot readouts as a business narrative, not a feature tour, learning to bring storytelling and executive presence to the room as you grow into more senior conversations.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments.

Product & Industry Expertise

  • Maintain deep expertise on Synthesia's platform capabilities across all product lines, roadmap, and positioning to highlight value driving use cases.

  • Specific vertical knowledge, establishing credibility as a subject matter expert within an industry to easily build credibility and trust with executive buyers.

  • Share customer and prospect product and competitive feedback to the pre-sales leadership and Product team; flag customer pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in live deals.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from current, static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

  • Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

  • Enablement: Review and enhance enablement content from what is effective in preparing our team members for client engagements, delivering and evaluating certification as needed to accelerate understanding in the commercial team.

What we are looking for

  • We think the ideal candidate for this role will bring 5+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience at SaaS companies.

  • Strong consultative discovery, stakeholder management, and communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with both executive decision-makers (CHRO, CLO, Head of L&D, CTO) and technical audiences (IT, security, developers).

  • Technical depth in at least one area: Creation flows, APIs, integrations (LMS, HCM, CRM, identity), security, compliance; willingness to learn quickly across domains.

  • Fluency with sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC and Command of the Message. Comfort translating technical requirements into business value and ROI conversations.

  • Consultative approach to problem-solving; comfort gathering requirements, asking clarifying questions, and adapting solutions to customer needs.

  • Excellent business and technical presentation skills, in person and remote, and the ability to explain complex AI and integration concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Self-motivated and organized; ability to manage multiple POCs, demos, and customer conversations simultaneously while meeting deadlines.

  • Collaborative mindset; thrives working with AEs, Product, Customer Success, and other teams to drive customer and company success.

  • Product orientation; genuine curiosity about how customers use technology

  • Willing to travel; willingness to visit key customers for discovery, executive conversations, and on-site demos.

Location

We’re ideally looking for someone based in Paris who can spend time in our office at 40 Rue du Colisée, 75008 Paris, or someone based in the UK who can spend time in our London office at 20 Triton Street, Regent’s Place, London NW1 3BF. Please confirm where you are located and whether you can spend two days a week in either location.

Founded in 2012, Mirakl has been at the forefront of marketplace innovation, empowering every business to compete in the platform economy.

Today, Mirakl's operating system combines an enterprise marketplace solution (Mirakl Platform) that enables retailers and B2B organizations to launch, scale, and operate marketplaces and dropship, AI-powered multichannel selling (Mirakl Connect), retail media (Mirakl Ads) and an agentic commerce infrastructure (Mirakl Nexus).

Brands like Macy's, Decathlon, Carrefour, Asos, and Airbus Helicopters use Mirakl to grow their businesses in new and remarkable ways.

For more information: www.mirakl.com.

Mirakl in Numbers:

  • 🇫🇷 350+ Mirakl Tech teams members mainly based in France
  • ⚙️ 5 Saas Solutions

Our Values:

Working at Mirakl means accelerating your career alongside ambitious, passionate, and supportive colleagues. We're proud of the diversity of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences that make our teams unique.

Our 5 values guide how we collaborate:

  • 💡 Work Hard Together: Teamwork and collaboration are the foundation of our success

  • 🎓 Succeed Through Expertise: Knowledge sharing and continuous learning are core to our culture
  • 🤝 Satisfy & Empower Clients: We're committed to our clients' success

1. The Team You'll Join

You'll join one of the Mirakl Labs Ads teams for a six-month internship starting in January or February 2027, based in Paris or Bordeaux. You'll be part of a cross-functional Squad made up of a Senior Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, Software Engineers, and a QA Engineer.
 

2. Your Impact

  • Contribute to the development and enhancement of an AI agent that autonomously generates and executes test scenarios, covering new feature validation, regression testing, and exploratory testing.
  • Help design, write, and run test cases to evaluate the agent's performance.
  • Explore different technical approaches and contribute to benchmarking their results.
  • Work under the guidance of experienced engineers and QA team members
  • Contribute to the project using existing programming skills


3. What You'll Bring to the Role

Experience:

  • Currently pursuing a degree in software engineering, computer science, or a related field (engineering school, university, or career change), and looking for a 6-month internship
  • First hands-on development experience through an internship, academic project, apprenticeship, or personal project
  • Good understanding of a programming language
  • Proficient in working with LLMs and developing skills and/or agents
  • Appreciation for software quality best practices: testing, clean code, design patterns
  • Strong team player with a genuine enthusiasm for knowledge sharing and problem-solving

4. Tech Stack

  • Back-end: Java 21, Spring Boot
  • Front-end: ReactJS
  • Data & Messaging: Kafka, ElasticSearch, PostgreSQL
  • Tooling & Practices: CI/CD, Git, Docker, Monitoring

5. Languages

  • French: Fluent
  • English: Professional proficiency (written and spoken)

 

Compensation, Perks & Benefits

  • Pay Range: €1,200 – €1,400 per month

 

Our Hiring Process

We warmly encourage you to apply to any of our roles, even if you think you're not an exact match.

Please click the "Apply" button to submit your application — this helps us make the best possible assessment and get back to you as quickly as possible.

  1. Manual screening of your CV by a recruiter, then an AI-powered screening conversation (10 min) with Emma, Mirakl's AI Talent Ambassador, to explore your background and motivation for the role. You will need to complete this step within 3 days, otherwise we won't be able to move forward with your application.
  2. Recruiter interview (30 min) — conversation about your background, motivations, and an introduction to Mirakl
  3. Hiring Manager interview (45 min) — technical discussion 
  4. STAR interview (1h) — exchange with one or two team members exploring Mirakl's values and culture

We welcome collaborators with their diverse perspectives and experiences to power us forward. These often far exceed conventional job requirements and help us create a culture of continuous learning. If you're ready to join a global leader powering digital transformation for 450+ of the world's most innovative retailers and B2B organizations.

As part of our recruitment process, Mirakl processes your personal data to review and manage your application and, where appropriate, to consider your profile for future opportunities. You can exercise your data protection rights at any time, and as further detailed in our policies. For more information about how we process your personal data and your rights, please consult our Recruitment Privacy Notice, here in English and here in French. 

We may use Artificial Intelligence (AI) solutions to help streamline our hiring process, including screening applications, analyzing resumes, and assessing responses. data.description:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka

For this role you will need to speak English and German and have technical bike knowledge!

You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...

Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.

Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.

Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.

What have we been up to since then...?

In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:

🚀 Raised an awesome Series B investment round

🚀 Grown the team to over 70 Lakanauts, based across the UK, NL and France, enabling a choice-based, hybrid way of working

🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!

🚀 Captured the UK, NL and French enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering

🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

🚀 Opened 3 shiny new offices in London, Bristol & Amsterdam to provide spaces for people to collaborate as they like

🚀 We've also achieved a 5* rating on Google Reviews and Glassdoor - go check us out!

Help us continue to change an outdated industry...

We’re growing real fast on our path to make the Laka collective model the industry standard and we’re expanding across segments, products, and territories. We’re looking for innovative, bold and brave minds to help us build the world’s best insurance company.

🤘🏼 The role

Customer Experience (CX) at Laka

CX are firmly at the heart of why Laka was created - we exist to be there for people when shit happens - our CX function is where this magic takes place...

You'll be a key part of our Customer Experience team. Providing a great customer experience is the most important part of our plans to grow the Laka brand internationally. As part of a small, dedicated function (we currently have a team of 11 superstars), you'll be the first point of contact for general and claim-related enquiries.

What you'll be getting up to:

  • Supporting Laka customers (& potential customers) with general questions about Laka's products & services, their bicycle insurance and new initiatives via web chat and email
  • Help Laka members to file their claims and guide them through the process of replacing or repairing their bikes and kit either directly with us or by coordinating with third-parties (shops, manufacturers, distributors etc)
  • Be the first point of contact for our B2B partners, supporting them to get their riders back on the road
  • Work closely with the CX team across both the UK and NL to provide a convenient, swift and seamless experience to our members
  • Collate feedback from the collective on an ongoing basis and produce actionable intel to support decision making, both in the CX team and others around Laka
  • Get stuck into our squad-based work, with the goal to continue to make Laka the best it can be (you might find yourself working on exciting projects with the Marketing, Product or Technology teams)

Requirements

👉🏻 This role will be a great fit if you:

  • We require that you speak English and German
  • Have a super strong empathy for cyclists and what it means when someone has their bike nicked, damaged or injures themselves whilst out & about on their bike
  • Have a decent understanding of technical terms in cycling (we can bring you up to speed with the latest bike tech), so you can best support all types of customers with whatever query is thrown your way
