data.title: Senior Product Manager (all genders)
data.description:
About GeneralMind

GeneralMind builds AI Systems of Action for complex enterprise workflows. We deploy AI employees that automate messy operational handovers across supply chains - processing orders, validating invoices, coordinating suppliers, and handling exceptions directly on top of enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, JDE, and Dynamics.

Our platform combines AI agents, operational context graphs, and real transaction data to achieve Autopilot-grade automation in real operational environments.

We work closely with leading global companies across manufacturing, retail, and logistics to deploy AI into mission-critical workflows.

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who can operate at the intersection of enterprise operations, AI systems, and platform product strategy.

You will work closely with customers, founders, and engineering teams to understand how large enterprises actually operate: ERP systems, supply chain workflows, approvals, exceptions, emails, spreadsheets, and fragmented operational processes.

This is not a traditional roadmap-management role. A core part of the job is identifying the reusable platform hidden underneath customer-specific operational problems. You will help determine what becomes a platform capability and what stays customer-specific, where configuration ends and engineering begins, where AI can reliably automate workflows, and where humans should remain in the loop.


Tasks

  • Work directly with enterprise customers to deeply understand operational workflows and pain points.

  • Translate customer realities into scalable product and platform decisions.

  • Define roadmap priorities across platform, workflow, and AI capabilities.

  • Collaborate closely with engineering teams on architecture and product tradeoffs.

  • Drive product thinking around AI agents, workflow orchestration, and enterprise operations.

  • Identify recurring patterns across customers and turn them into reusable product abstractions.

  • Help define the long-term platform strategy of the company.

  • Improve how we capture, operationalise, and learn from customer feedback.

Requirements

  • Strong product thinking and systems intuition.

  • Deep understanding of enterprise operations, supply chain workflows, or ERP systems.

  • Ability to operate effectively in highly technical environments.

  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to balance customer needs with long-term platform strategy.

data.title: Consultant Psychiatrist PAYE
data.description:
An opportunity to help patients who have run out of options

 

For many people living with chronic pain, the journey has been long. They have tried multiple medications, procedures and therapies, yet their pain continues to impact every aspect of daily life. By the time they reach us, many are looking for another option where conventional treatment has fallen short.

We are Montu UK, one of the UK's largest medical cannabis clinics, and we are looking for Consultants specialising in Pain Management to join our clinical team.

 

About the role

You will assess and manage patients exploring cannabis based medicines, making the clinical decision on whether treatment is appropriate and managing their care from there. This is an evolving area of medicine where the evidence base continues to grow, giving you the opportunity to help shape how cannabis based medicines are used within pain management in the UK.

You do not need previous experience with cannabis based medicines. We are looking for experienced Pain Management Consultants with sound clinical judgement, an open mind and a genuine interest in improving outcomes for patients with complex chronic pain. We provide comprehensive specialist training, and our multidisciplinary model means you are never working in isolation. Nurses and pharmacists complete pre consultation and follow up prescribing tasks, allowing you to focus on clinical decision making and patient care.

 

What you will be doing:

  • Provide high quality care for patients seeking medical cannabis treatment.

  • Conduct patient consultations, including assessment and ongoing management.

  • Engage in clinical outcome data collection to support evidence based practices.

  • Contribute to clinical governance and maintain robust patient care standards.

  • Collaborate effectively within a multidisciplinary team, including nurses and pharmacists.

  • Participate in ongoing training and professional development, including bespoke specialist training in cannabis based medicines (CBMPs).

     

What you need:

  • Full GMC Registration

  • Completion of Specialist Training (CCST/CCT) or equivalent certification

  • On the GMC Specialist Register for Pain

  • Demonstrated interest in alternative therapies

  • Willingness to participate in data collection and reporting

     

Why join us?

  • Highly Competitive Salary: £190,000 - £275,000 FTE, pro rata for part time roles based on experience and hours worked.

  • Flexible Working: Full time or part time options available

  • Comprehensive Indemnity Coverage: Montu will cover all professional and clinical indemnity insurance for your work with us

  • Private Healthcare

  • Work-Life Balance: No night shifts or on call requirements

  • Cutting Edge Training: Access to CPD accredited medical cannabis education and specialist in house training from industry leaders

  • Collaborative Environment: Join a multidisciplinary team of healthcare professionals

  • Personal Growth: Be part of a pioneering field and shape the future of medical cannabis care in the UK

Training & Development:

  • Attendance at a recognised Medical Cannabis Course for Specialist Physicians (sponsored by Montu)

  • Specialist training delivered by experts, including Prof Anup Mathew (Consultant Psychiatrist) and Dr Gerard Sinovich (Pain Management Consultant).

  • Ongoing support and training on clinical protocols, prescribing practices, and Montu’s system usage

Working arrangements:

  • Remote Role: Flexible working hours and days

  • Session Structure:

  • Standard session length: 4 hours

  • Appointment duration: 15 minutes (new and existing patients)

Montu’s multidisciplinary model allows consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care, while nurses and pharmacists handle pre consultation and follow up tasks.

If you are passionate about innovative patient care, thrive in a dynamic environment, and are looking to make a real impact in the field of medical cannabis, we would love to hear from you!

Sessions:

Each standard session consists of 4 hours of patient consultations. Clinicians can choose their preferred working days and hours, with sessions spread flexibly if needed.

To support onboarding, clinicians are required to commit to a minimum of 2 sessions per week/ 8 hours initially, to ensure they become proficient with Montu’s platform.

Appointment Durations:

Appointments are 15 minutes in length for new and existing patients as Montu operates a multidisciplinary approach, leveraging a clinical skills mix where nurses and pharmacists handle pre-consultation and follow-up prescribing tasks allowing Consultants to focus on prescribing and patient care.

 

About MONTU

Montu UK is a leading digital health company specialising in cannabis based medicines (CBPM). We are committed to transforming lives by improving access to safe, effective treatments and offering an exceptional standard of care. Our dynamic and supportive work environment is the perfect place for you to grow professionally while making a meaningful impact on patients’ lives.

data.description:
Senior Brand Designer

OUR MISSION

To become the car-changing destination of choice. By combining technology, media and deep automotive expertise, we've turned how people buy, sell, advertise and lease cars on its head.

What started as a simple reviews site is now one of the largest online car-changing destinations in Europe. Last year alone we grew over 50% with nearly £3bn worth of cars bought on site, while £1.8bn of cars were listed for sale through our Sell My Car service.

In 2024 we went big and acquired Autovia - creators of AutoExpress and Evo magazines - doubling our audience overnight. Together we now have one of the biggest YouTube channels in the world with almost 10m subscribers and over 1.1 billion annual views, while we sell 1.2 million print copies of our magazines and have an annual web content reach over 350million.

And we’re a long way from done!

BRAND CREATIVE @ CARWOW

Brand Creative is the central creative studio for all brands within the Carwow Group. We’re an ambitious team who thrive on storytelling, craft and collaboration.

We bring our portfolio of brands to life across every channel; from large-scale campaigns to social-first paid marketing creative, events, brand identity, commercial initiatives and internal culture-building.

We move quickly, adapt often and work closely with colleagues across the whole business. Due to the scale up nature of the business you’ll enjoy a unique mix of variety, ownership and creative exploration.

YOUR MISSION

Your mission is to elevate how our brands show up visually; taking ownership of everything from early creative concepts to final delivery across a wide mix of channels.

As the sole permanent designer in the team, you will play a central role in shaping how we communicate visually, balancing conceptual thinking with hands-on craft, and ensuring our brands remain consistent, recognisable and creatively ambitious. You will support onboarding and coaching our freelancers in the guidelines and internal systems, taking ownership of both.

You’ll collaborate closely with marketing, content, product and editorial teams, while being confident operating independently, solving problems proactively and bringing structure to a fast-moving creative environment. You’ll also be an active contributor to our Creative Community, helping connect, inspire and align creatives across the wider business (there are plenty of creative pockets at Carwow Group!).

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver high-quality design across brand, campaign, social, print, CRM, paid media and editorial channels.

  • Partner with the Head of Creative, Creative Strategist and Copywriters to develop clear, insight-led creative ideas and campaign directions.

  • Interpret brand guidelines pragmatically, knowing when to follow, when to adapt and when to propose improvements.

  • Produce assets that scale: layouts, toolkits, templates and visual systems that support efficiency across the group.

  • Concept and create social-first paid video content that reflects platform behaviours and audience expectations, particularly across YouTube and Meta.

  • Work with Product Designers to ensure brand and campaign creative translates effectively into digital journeys.

  • Present your work with clarity, explaining rationale, constraints, and the impact of design decisions.

  • Provide constructive, objective feedback to freelancers and ensure their work aligns with brand expectations.

  • Bring structure and consistency to design delivery through thoughtful file organisation, templating and process improvements.

  • Contribute actively to Carwow’s Creative Community, sharing inspiration, collaborating across teams and helping strengthen our creative culture.

  • Proactively explore AI solutions in the creative workflow without compromising on execution.

KEY REQUIREMENTS

  • A strong portfolio showcasing both concept development and crafted design across digital and print, preferably including a 360 campaign from ATL to tactical performance assets.

  • Proficiency in Figma, Illustrator, InDesign and Photoshop, with consistent attention to detail.

  • Ability to create coherent campaign executions, from early concepts to multi-channel rollouts.

  • Experience adapting design to fit channel needs, especially across social and performance environments.

  • Comfortable collaborating creatively with copywriters and stakeholders, and able to offer clear, thoughtful feedback.

  • Self-sufficient, organised and proactive, confident managing multiple projects without heavy oversight.

  • Strong understanding of visual trends, social formats and the role of motion in brand expression.

  • A natural collaborator who enjoys working across disciplines and connecting with other creatives.

BONUS POINTS

  • Motion design capability (After Effects + Premiere Pro)

  • Interest or experience in shooting UGC-style short form content

  • Illustration or iconography skills

  • An interest in creative operations, workflow improvements or building toolkits (including AI solutions)

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Introductory call with our Talent team

  • Step one: Video call with Head of Creative (30 mins)

  • Step two: Concepting or design task presented to two members of the Brand Creative team (1 hr)

  • Step three: Interview with our Brand and Comms Director (30 mins)

Default on all JDs:

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

  • Competitive compensation package

  • 28 days’ holiday + bank holidays (up to 35 with service)

  • Share options

  • Pension via Royal London (up to 5% company contribution)

  • Vitality private healthcare

  • Life assurance (4x salary)

  • Monthly wellbeing coaching with Spill

  • Inclusive parental leave policies

  • Bubble childcare support & discounted nanny fees

  • Work-from-abroad scheme

  • Generous learning & development budget

  • £500 / €550 home office budget

Diversity and inclusion are integral to our culture. We know that diverse teams are strong teams, so we welcome those with alternative identities, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. We make recruiting decisions based on experience, skills and potential, and treat all applicants fairly and equally.

data.title: Director of Customer Success [EMEA]
data.description:
This is a hands-on leadership role at the center of our EMEA Customer Success organization.

You'll lead a small, senior team of 5 with the intention to double to 10 in the next 12 months.

Based from London, your team sit locally along with a growing team in Munich and possibly Riyadh in future working with enterprise customers across EMEA.

Where You Come In

You'll carry formal accountability for your team's performance, development, hiring, and day-to-day effectiveness — and you'll stay personally engaged in the region's most strategic accounts, at the level where a senior voice changes the outcome. Your core mandate is to turn a set of excellent individual practices into one operating system: the account planning, escalation, and reporting structures that let the team scale without a proportional rise in headcount.

This fits someone who wants to lead from close range rather than inherit a large, already-built org. If you're looking for a defined playbook or a steady renewal book to protect, this isn't that — you'll be building the playbook as you go.

What You'll Own

  • Lead the EMEA Customer Success team — owning hiring, onboarding, coaching, performance management, and career development for a small group of senior CSMs.

  • Stay personally engaged in the region's most strategic accounts, holding senior relationships directly and stepping in when a situation needs a decision at your level.

  • Decide where the team's time goes: which accounts warrant depth, what account enablement work is worth the investment, and what should become a repeatable, templated motion versus a bespoke one-off.

  • Build the account planning, escalation, and reporting processes that let the team absorb more enterprise customers without adding headcount at the same rate.

  • Own performance outcomes for the accounts the team covers — net revenue retention, retention rates, health score distribution, and escalation resolution — and report cleanly to leadership.

  • Grow usage inside existing accounts — across more teams, more markets, and more use cases

  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales on renewals and new-account expansion, with Forward Deployed Creatives on workflow adoption, and with Product on what customers in the region need built next.

  • Identify and develop talent — building a bench of strong individual contributors and emerging player-coaches who can grow with the organization.

  • Lead hiring for the team as it scales, setting an explicit bar for what "senior" looks like in EMEA Customer Success.

  • Set and maintain a high standard of execution across the team: account health, CRM hygiene, renewal management, expansion identification, and customer engagement quality.

  • Serve as a senior point of escalation for complex customer situations that have exceeded what the team can resolve independently.

  • Contribute to CS strategy alongside regional and functional leadership — bringing a ground-level view of team capability, customer patterns, and operational gaps into planning conversations.

Who You Are

  • 10+ years of experience in Customer Success or a closely related client-facing function, including substantial experience leading teams of senior individual contributors (not only early-career CSMs) with direct accountability for performance outcomes.

  • A proven people manager — you've built and developed CS teams, navigated performance conversations with directness and care, and have a track record of retention and growth among your reports.

  • A record of personally holding senior relationships at large enterprise or agency accounts, including the conversations that go badly.

  • Evidence you've made a team's work repeatable — you've taken a function running on effort and given it a system, and can say what you cut to get there.

  • Strong operational leader — you build reliable execution systems, hold teams to consistent standards, and are comfortable owning outcome metrics rather than just activity metrics.

  • Presence — you can lead people who already know their job well, in a region removed from headquarters, and earn their respect quickly while holding your own point of view.

  • Comfortable operating across multiple markets within the region while working closely with a leadership team based elsewhere.

  • Effective cross-functional partner — you work well with Sales, Product, and GTM leaders and understand how CS fits into the broader revenue motion.

  • Comfortable operating in a scaling environment where team structure, tooling, and process are still being refined — you improve the system rather than waiting for it to be finished.

What Sets You Apart

  • Experience building or significantly scaling a CS function at a high-growth startup — including hiring, process development, and team structure design.

  • Fluency with marketers — real time spent working with advertising agencies or brand marketing teams, whether from a software vendor, a media owner, an ad tech or martech company, or from inside an agency or brand.

  • Background at a creative technology, generative AI, or product-led growth company.

  • Track record of developing CS managers or leads from IC backgrounds — not just hiring experienced managers externally.

  • Deep familiarity with CRM and customer success tooling, and a point of view on how to use data to manage team performance.

Nice to Have

  • An additional European language.

  • Experience at a creative software, martech, or ad tech company selling into agency groups and global brands.

  • Familiarity with adjacent, newly-opened markets relevant to the region's growth (e.g. the Middle East).

data.description:
TL;DR: As our first Executive Assistant, you'll support Conduct's founders by protecting their time, keeping priorities moving and making the company feel sharper in how it runs day to day. It's a high-trust role, close to every big decision, at a company running faster than ever.

WHY CONDUCT

We believe the world's largest companies should move at the speed of their ideas, not the speed of the decade-old systems they run on. Today they don't.

Every process change, every new product line runs into software systems layered with decades of custom code and complexity no human mind can fully comprehend. New requirements take months to ship, system migrations cost $100M+ and years of pain.

We're building the AI operating system that absorbs this complexity and gives enterprises back their speed and ambition. Major enterprises already trust us with their most critical systems, we've closed game-changing SI partnerships, just raised a $60M Series A, and demand is outpacing what we can service.

We're a small, talent-dense team doing our life's work out of London and NYC. Extreme ownership, high velocity, low-ego collaboration. What you build here shapes the company and how the world's largest companies operate. We sponsor visas and are convinced diverse teams build better products, so we especially encourage underrepresented groups in tech to reach out.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You'll work side by side with our three founders as they tackle one of the most complex problems of our generation. Their time is one of the most valuable things we have, and you'll help to decide how it gets spent. One day that means getting a CEO to a customer in Germany. The next, it's prepping a board meeting or landing a candidate we've been chasing for months. Plans often change hourly and you'll help keep everything on track. You'll be our first EA, so you'll set the standard for how we support the founders. As we grow, the team around you might too, and you'll help shape how it works. Few roles give you this view of how a generational company gets built, and as we scale, your scope grows with us.

In practice:

  • Help run packed founder calendars and decide what they spend their time on

  • Set up the meetings that move Conduct forward, with enterprise customers, investors and partners, and make sure everyone walks in prepared and walks out with next steps

  • Plan global founder travel and fix it fast when things don’t go to plan

  • Live in founder inboxes and threads, prioritising by what matters most to the business, handling what you can and flagging what you can’t

  • Write on the founders' behalf to customers, investors and partners, and get every detail right

  • Keep board and investor meetings running smoothly, from scheduling to follow-ups

  • Help candidates have a great first experience of Conduct

  • Spot what's slowing the team down and build the fix

WHO WE HIRE

You're the person everyone goes to when something needs to get done properly. You're sharp, calm under pressure and good with people, and you'd rather be in the room where decisions happen than watching from the outside. You might already be an EA, or you might be in a role where you've quietly been doing the job of one.

In practice that tends to look like:

  • You've supported founders, CEOs, or senior execs in a high-pressure, high-excellence environment, ideally a fast-scaling startup, and you know how to keep up

  • You thrive when things are messy and moving fast, and you bring structure without waiting to be asked

  • You're smart and proactive, and you see what's needed before anyone asks

  • You're happy to push back, even with a founder, when something doesn't need to happen

  • You communicate clearly and confidently, in writing and in person, whether it's an investor, a customer or a new hire

  • You bring maturity and sound judgement to confidential matters

  • When something doesn't work, you fix it or automate it, and you'll happily pick up work that's nowhere near your job description

  • You have a zero-error mindset: anything with your name or a founder's on it is right first time, even on the busiest days

  • Speaking German is a plus

We have partnered with 1,500+ companies to deliver a new kind of learning that's transforming today’s workforce.

In April 2026, we announced $70 million in strategic funding, led by Schroders Capital, with participation from StepStone Group, Lightspeed Venture Partners and General Catalyst. At an increased valuation of $2.1bn, the round makes us Europe’s first EdTech double unicorn.

But we aren’t stopping there. With a strong operational footprint and 800+ employees, we have ambitious plans to continue scaling. We’re building a world where tech skills unlock people’s potential and output.

Join Multiverse and power our mission to equip the workforce to win in the AI era.

The role:

Multiverse’s mission is to equip the workforce to win in the AI era. Joining us means being part of a talented team, tackling the challenges of being in a scaling organisation solving complex problems, whilst contributing to our company and product growth. As a team, we always prioritise quality - you’ll hold the hiring bar whilst keeping pipeline moving when there’s commercial pressure to move fast.

As a Talent Partner, you’ll be growing your experience as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, and own end-to-end recruitment for the roles you’re responsible for. You’ll show up prepared with market knowledge, using it to set realistic expectations on timelines, candidate availability and what the market will and won’t accept, and adjusting your approach when conditions change. You’ll use pipeline data to spot where a process is breaking down and fix it. You use AI to power your productivity, and focus your time on what AI can’t do: building strong stakeholder relationships, giving candidates an exceptional experience and building connections.

Teams you’ll support: Operations - this is our learner-facing org who work day-in-day-out to give our apprentices a great learning experience and provide measurable impact to our customers; and G&A - our core business partnering teams across People and Talent, Finance, Legal, CEO Office and Comms.

If you have experience as a recruiter or Talent Partner, ideally somewhere with a high talent bar, and are genuinely excited about being at the forefront of a fast-evolving recruiting role, we’d love for you to apply.

What you’ll do:

  • Run recruiting for your roles end-to-end: attraction and sourcing, qualifying and hiring top talent for Multiverse. We have a high hiring bar, and you’ll partner closely with managers to assess the market, calibrate regularly, build rigour into our assessment and make pivots based on data.

  • Partner with hiring managers to expertly qualify requirements, challenge assumptions using market data and past hiring experience, and build a shared understanding of what good looks like.

  • Design structured interview and assessment processes for the roles you own.

  • Be an exceptional operator, running processes that focus on the very highest quality of hire as we scale, and make the most of your tech stack to do so. We invest in great tools (Ashby, Claude, Gemini, Juicebox, Brighthire, LinkedIn) to support you. You’ll source through these platforms and build your own network and referrals.

  • Manage candidate relationships end-to-end: anticipating candidates’ needs and questions, tailoring your communication to their profile and stage in the pipeline, building buy-in and providing high quality, timely feedback. You’ll own candidate experience and maintain strong NPS, and build talent pools from silver medallists.

  • Analyse pipeline data to identify where a hiring process is breaking down, and use those insights to adjust your sourcing or process.

  • Partner with your colleagues across the People and Talent team to ensure we’re collectively driving the right talent outcomes for Multiverse.

We value competence more than years of experience, but you’ll most likely have the following to be successful:

What you’ll bring:

  • You embody our Operating Principles in how you work.

  • Proven experience in a recruiting or Talent Partner role, supporting multiple hiring managers, ideally in a scaling, highly agile business environment.

  • You can credibly partner with managers, and are confident using market knowledge to advise constructively.

  • You can evaluate candidates effectively, and stay regularly calibrated with your hiring team. You can point to where you’ve designed or improved structured assessment and coached managers.

  • You build strong candidate relationships, understanding skills, motivations and decision criteria, and handle feedback conversations well.

  • You’re comfortable with data, and use it alongside qualitative feedback to spot problems and change course.

  • You are highly motivated and autonomous, but curious to learn and ask questions where you don’t know.

  • You are building AI into your everyday workflows, and are rigorous in your approach to data hygiene to ensure good tools are built on even better data, and verify the outputs.

Why this role may not be for you

Role Purpose

The Leadership & Culture Development Lead owns how Neko's leaders are developed and how the leadership bar shows up in practice, plus which culture products get built and how they deploy across markets.

This role merges leadership and culture development deliberately: it is broader than either would be alone, and the combination is what earns the credibility to coach and challenge the ELT. It sits on the two priorities CHROs rank first and second for 2026.

What You'll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months

  • Onboard every new leader into Neko's leadership standards, Vitals and culture code from day one of their leadership role. (Member-first, Always)

  • Turn the Neko leadership model into ongoing practice — coaching, mentorship, scans — with a measurable improvement in leadership capability, not a one-off training event. (Impact, Not Activity)

  • Ship a reusable culture product library that any market or clinic can deploy without this role being in the room. (Chase 10X, Not 10%)

  • Run the first leadership and culture scans that show where the gaps are and what to do about them. (Optimistic Truth-seeking)

  • Direct the AI Enablement releases: i.e leadership buddy and culture buddy live and in use by real leaders. (Tech-enabled, Human-centred)

Leadership development

  • Own how leaders are developed and what the leadership bar looks like in practice.

  • Design and run leadership development programmes and leadership scans.

  • Provide coaching and mentorship directly to leaders, including holding the standard with the ELT.

Culture

  • Own culture design and iteration, ways of working, and input into the EVP.

  • Decide which culture products get built and how they are deployed across HQ and clinics.

Decisions & Authority

  • Owns the leadership development and culture product roadmap.

Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we're unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Role overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to help build and evolve our new Common case-management system, which powers support-case handling across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

You will own significant end-to-end initiatives across our backend services: case lifecycle, routing and assignment, queue management, case evidence and history, and migration from legacy systems. This is a hands-on role for someone who can turn ambiguous customer and operational problems into durable technical solutions, coordinate other engineers, and set the standard for reliability and craftsmanship on the team.

What you'll do

  • Lead one or more project-level Case Management initiatives, on your own or by guiding a group of engineers, from discovery and design through rollout, measurement, and operational ownership.

Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. 

What you'll do

This role is scoped by skill rather than by product. The problems below span multiple departments and show up across our Search and Places data work, our Location and Navigation Intelligence work, and the Platform work that makes Mapbox usable by agents. You'll be hired into one specific team or product area, but you'll work across teams where your expertise meets the highest-priority AI problems. You should expect to move between teams and tech stacks as the work demands.

At this level you own the technical design and delivery of a multi-component AI system, and you are accountable for the quality of what ships in your area.

In this role, you will:

  • Define how the products you own should work, build a measurement framework for it, and build evaluation systems for non-deterministic behavior. Formulate hypotheses around the products we build and seek the signal needed to validate them. Define what a correct result is for a given input and state, determine whether to assemble datasets from real usage or hand-written cases, and gate changes on regression results.

  • Run continuous evaluation of the products we build, whether APIs, SDKs, data representations, or reference applications, from the position of the end user, whether developer, agent, or consumer. Assess the gaps such as misuse of parameters or integration anti-patterns, recommend the fixes, and make sure they land.

  • Own the MVP against an agreed north star technical design, and balance technical perfection against shipping useful increments.

  • Build data pipelines and the tooling around them: ingestion, conflation, entity resolution, quality checks, and the batch and streaming jobs that keep a large dataset current.

  • Track and pull external datasets, models, and benchmarks from published research and open-source releases. Evaluate what fits the problem and constraints , and decide when to adopt what exists versus build your own.

  • Design feedback loops so that using a product generates data that improves it. Instrument systems so failures arrive with enough context to reproduce, then turn the recurring ones into evaluation cases.

  • Design the boundary between a model and the tools it calls. Build or improve the model harness, decide what the model handles, what it delegates, and how to keep it working from the state it actually fetched.

  • Work to a latency and cost target per request: streaming, partial results, caching, model routing, prompt structure.

  • Build the internal harnesses and tools (CLI, MCP, and others) your team needs to iterate quickly, and share the parts that generalize with other teams.

  • Raise the bar on your team through code and design review, and bring other engineers up on eval practice.

  • Some of the technical questions in this area are still open. You will help answer them.

  • Participate in an on-call rotation to ensure our systems remain available to customers 24/7. Team members alternate as the on-call primary responder, which may require immediate response outside normal working hours, including weekends.

What We Believe are Important Traits for This Role

  • Bachelors degree in STEM discipline and 5+ years of software engineering experience, with production ownership of services, pipelines, or SDKs.

  • 2+ years shipping LLM-backed features to real users, in systems that carried error budgets, on-call rotations, and customers who noticed regressions.

  • Direct experience or deep understanding of designing evaluations for non-deterministic systems. You can describe a dataset you built and the failure it caught.

  • Data engineering depth: SQL, at least one distributed processing framework, and experience with pipelines where a wrong record mattered more than a slow one.

  • Fluency with tool calling and agent orchestration, including the failure modes: stale context, hallucinated arguments, silent partial success, unbounded loops.

  • Working knowledge of more than one agent harness, and opinions about where each of them is weak.

This is your opportunity to join a small group of obsessed game makers, building an ambitious mobile game focused on collection and social.

Someone who plays games seriously, but understands that at least a bit of silliness is needed for success. Someone who thinks about all the edge cases, but knows doing it alone, will always leave blind spots.   • 5+ years of experience shipping UI/UX design for apps/games

  • Range of 2D Art skills (UI elements, illustrations, animations, etc.)

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • Enjoys TCGs

Where You'll Be

This opportunity is based in our London office, and because we value a collaborative work environment and genuine human interactions, it is mostly an office‑based role.

Supercell New Games

This is a dedicated environment for building from zero and shaped around a core belief: the best developers don’t need more direction, they need more freedom and fewer barriers. This is where games get the space they need to become cultural phenomenons.

Players are waiting for your vision and ambition to build the next forever game a.k.a. the best work of your career. We back this up with creative and operational autonomy, and the infrastructure, capital, and experience needed to take a game from an idea to global scale.

This is not for everyone. Building towards a billion-dollar game is going to be hard. But let's not kid ourselves: it should also be fun.

You build the rocket. We bring the launchpad.

Game-changing Financial Model

Supercell is great with stuff around benefits and wellbeing, but most importantly you get to focus on what matters: making games. Skip the Venture Capital pitch decks and looking at runway spreadsheets. In exchange, we're offering a compensation model that makes this opportunity financially life-changing.

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, and Brawl Stars. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

data.description:
Recognized on the 2025 Forbes Cloud 100 list, ClickHouse is one of the most innovative and fast-growing private cloud companies. With more than 4,000 customers and $250M ARR, ClickHouse leads the market in real-time analytics, data warehousing, observability, and AI workloads.

We're hiring a Product Manager to own partner integrations at ClickHouse. data.title: Head of Legal
data.description:
Remote | United Kingdom | Crypto & Payments | FCA Authorisation | Employment or B2B

Our client is an established, profitable fintech operating at the intersection of crypto and traditional payments. It runs a consumer on/off-ramp platform and a fast-growing B2B infrastructure business: APIs and white-label solutions that let exchanges, neobanks, PSPs, wallets and other platforms embed regulated crypto and fiat services. The company is authorised under MiCA and PSD2 in the EU and is now building its regulatory presence in the UK. The culture is owner-led, high-ownership and low-bureaucracy: decisions are made quickly and close to the founders.

About the role

This is a senior, hands-on legal role with a single, clear mandate: own the company’s UK regulatory build. You will report directly to the CEO and be the most senior legal voice in the business on UK matters.

The UK’s new cryptoasset regime takes effect in October 2027. From that date, regulated cryptoasset activity in the UK requires FCA authorisation. You will own a first-wave authorisation under this new regime end to end, alongside a UK e-money application. For a regulatory lawyer, this is a career-defining piece of work, and the window to start it is narrow.

The role has no direct reports at hire. You will work closely with the company’s EU legal function. This is a deliberately focused UK mandate, not a group legal role.

What you will own

  • FCA cryptoasset authorisation: perimeter analysis of B2C and B2B activities against the new regime, application strategy, drafting, regulatory business plan input, RFI handling and dialogue through to decision.

  • UK EMI application: ownership on the same basis, including sequencing between the two applications.

  • FCA relationship: acting as the senior in-house legal counterpart to the regulator.

  • UK conduct perimeter: the cryptoasset financial promotions regime, Consumer Duty, the UK Travel Rule, and safeguarding and prudential requirements.

  • Post-authorisation readiness: governance, senior manager and certification considerations, reporting and disclosures.

  • External counsel: briefing, directing and quality-controlling UK external counsel, and managing that spend.

  • International expansion: legal lead on additional licence applications in other jurisdictions, and advice where the UK and EU regulatory perimeters meet.

  • Commercial legal: drafting and negotiating English-law B2B agreements. This includes MSAs, API and white-label terms, referral and agent agreements, and banking, payment and card scheme counterparty agreements.

  • UK consumer-facing legal: consumer terms, financial promotions review and UK-specific disclosures.

  • UK employment: UK employment law and contractor arrangements, in partnership with HR.

What we are looking for

  • Qualified solicitor or barrister in England & Wales, typically with 8+ years PQE.

  • Hands-on UK financial services regulatory experience, including at least one FCA authorisation or variation of permission that you personally owned or materially led, from perimeter analysis to decision.

  • Direct, personal interaction with the FCA: correspondence, meetings and representation that you led yourself.

  • Crypto or digital-asset legal experience at licensed or established firms, such as registered or authorised exchanges, regulated on/off-ramps, licensed custodians or infrastructure providers.

  • Cryptoasset, e-money or payments perimeter experience. Engagement with the 2025–26 FCA cryptoasset consultations is highly relevant.

  • Ability to draft and negotiate English-law B2B fintech agreements independently.

  • A track record of owning regulatory outcomes, not only advising on them. Law-firm backgrounds are welcome where this is evident.

  • Ability to take a clear position under pressure from senior stakeholders and counterparties, and to translate legal risk into business options with a recommendation.

  • Comfort operating as a remote senior with no legal support structure beneath you, working with a leadership team based outside the UK.

  • Practical use of AI tools in legal drafting, research or review.

  • Fluent legal English to regulator-facing standard.

  • Existing right to work in the UK, and the ability to attend regulator meetings in London as required.

Team management experience is not required. We welcome strong senior counsel ready to step into a Head of Legal role.

Nice to have

  • Previous Head of Legal, GC or senior counsel role at a UK-authorised EMI, PI or FCA-registered cryptoasset firm.

  • Experience of a firm moving from AML registration to full FSMA authorisation.

  • Involvement in industry working groups or trade association engagement on the new UK crypto regime.

  • SM&CR experience.

  • Knowledge of UK safeguarding and prudential requirements for e-money and payments.

  • Crown Dependency (Jersey, Guernsey, Isle of Man) or Australian regulatory exposure.

  • Card scheme legal experience, such as Visa/Mastercard rules and principal membership.

  • Experience building a legal or regulatory function in a jurisdiction from scratch.

What’s on offer

  • A direct reporting line to the CEO and ownership of the company’s UK market entry.

  • A defining role in a first-wave authorisation under the UK’s new cryptoasset regime.

  • A remote setup in the UK, with a flat structure and fast decisions.

  • An employment or B2B contract, with a performance bonus linked to UK authorisation milestones.

  • A fast, transparent hiring process, typically completed within four weeks.

data.title: Product Designer
data.description:
Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.

Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.

Dave is an inspector. Today he's climbing through one of Europe's biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he'll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.

We're building the best AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we're building the world's largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.

It's a $2T market and we're just getting started, with ambitions. We work with 6 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.

We've assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Goldman Sachs, Flexport and Amazon.

Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with 100+ unicorns backed to date.

About the role

We're hiring our first Product Designer.

Every engineer at Scope is a product engineer: they talk to users, decide what to build and ship it themselves. You'll work the same way, with design as your edge, and help the engineers around you to build a better product. That covers the whole experience, not just the surface: which problem we solve, how the flow works, what happens when things go wrong, and how it all looks. You'll work closely with the engineers, with Ish our Product Manager, and with Jakob the CTO.

We work in person five days a week from our office in Farringdon.

What you'll work on

Some examples of surfaces in our product that will need your help:

  • Our mobile app gets used inside tanks and on top of pressure vessels. People wear thick gloves, there's usually no signal, and one hand is often holding on to something. Most of what makes a normal app pleasant doesn't apply there, so a big part of the job is figuring out what does.

  • Then there's the report. How AI and the inspector will work together to produce 40 page reports and review them is something nobody has designed well yet.

  • Inspectors but also decision makers should be able to ask things like "Which tanks were over the corrosion limit last year?". Sometimes the right interface will be a chat but often it isn't.

What you'll do

  • Go on site with inspectors and test your designs there, gloves and all.

  • Own the design of every launch, down to the empty states.

  • Prototype fast, in code when it helps.

  • Work next to engineers while they build, so the details come out right.

  • Decide with Ish and Jakob which problems are worth solving.

  • Build the design system that lets engineers ship great work without waiting on you.

Who you are

  • Minimum 3 years designing products that were shipped.

  • A portfolio that shows the messy middle, not just the final screens.

  • You sweat the mobile details: touch targets, offline, errors.

  • You have opinions on where AI helps and where it gets in the way.

  • You'd happily put on a hard hat to understand a problem.

  • Bonus if you've designed for industrial or field work, or prototype in code.

Interview process

  • Intro call.

  • Portfolio deep dive with Ish and an engineer: one project, including what went wrong.

  • Interview with a cofounder: Jonny (CEO) or Jakob (CTO and CPO).

  • Onsite: a real Scope design problem, worked on with the team, then a short presentation.

  • Offer!

What we offer

  • £70k to £100k base + significant equity, so you have a stake in what you are building

  • Full visa sponsorship, giving us access to global talent and an international, diverse team

  • Tools to do your job, including a brand new MacBook and Scope merch

  • Generous above-market annual leave allowance

  • Bupa private medical (0 excess, pre-existing conditions covered) + Bupa dental

  • Employee pension through NEST

  • Flexible parental leave (including adoption leave)

  • Healthy meal-prep lunch and dinners, a fully stocked fridge, and team lunches on Fridays

  • Regular events including off-sites

We value diverse perspectives. If you don't match every point above but this is the kind of problem you want to work on, we strongly encourage you to apply.

Our engineering team members span design, analysis, prototyping, testing, manufacturing, assembly and integration, quality control, engineering documentation, and more.

  • Define, develop, and optimize test and operational requirements, procedures, and Concepts of Operations (CONOPs).

  • Direct integration, installation, and troubleshooting of electrical systems on launch vehicles, spacecraft, and ground support equipment.
  • Lead on-console operations, maintaining real-time situational awareness and communications during critical operations.

  • Drive process improvements, automation, and standardization across Integrated Operations.

  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and process improvement skills.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

You will be selling into mid-to-large corporate accounts across a broad range of industries, with a particular focus on sectors where TransPerfect's expanded capabilities — including creative production via The Mill — create strong differentiation and cross-sell opportunity.

data.description:
TopChrono, leader historique de la livraison express et du dernier kilomètre, entre dans une nouvelle ère ! Face aux mutations du secteur (explosion du e-commerce, ubérisation, nouvelles technologies), nous avons entrepris un vaste chantier de transformation, adoptant une dynamique startup pour réinventer nos solutions, activités et stratégies.

Vous souhaitez intégrer une entreprise en pleine évolution et contribuer activement à son succès ? Ce poste est pour vous !

 

Ce que nous vous offrons

  • Un environnement stimulant : une dynamique startup au sein d’un groupe établi (CA de 70M€, 500 collaborateurs).

  • Des opportunités d’évolution et de formation : développez vos compétences et faites avancer votre carrière.

  • Avantages sociaux : télétravail hybride, tickets restaurant, mutuelle performante, primes d’intéressement.

  • Une équipe conviviale et innovante, engagée à relever les défis d’un secteur en mutation.

Votre rôle : fidéliser, engager et maximiser l’impact !

 

Rattaché(e) au Rattaché(e) au Directeur des Opérations, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :

Rattachement hiérarchique

• Encadre un à deux collaborateur(s) en charge du suivi quotidien de la métrologie sur l'ensemble des agences au

niveau national.

 

Mission principale

Le Responsable Métrologie garantit la conformité métrologique des équipements utilisés pour le transport des échantillons biologiques. Il est responsable de l'étude, du choix, de l'installation et du suivi des matériels permettant d'assurer le maintien de la chaîne de température réglementaire dans les véhicules frigorifiques. Il travaille en étroite collaboration avec le Responsable Parc Automobile, les Responsables Exploitation et les fournisseurs afin d'assurer la fiabilité des équipements et la qualité du transport.

 

PRINCIPALES RESPONSABILITES

Métrologie et maîtrise de la température

• Définir et mettre en œuvre la politique métrologique de l'entreprise.

• Garantir le respect des exigences réglementaires relatives au transport des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer le suivi des équipements de mesure de température (capteurs, enregistreurs, sondes, etc.).

• Organiser les opérations de vérification, d'étalonnage et de qualification des équipements.

• Analyser les dérives et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives.

• Connaître et faire appliquer les référentiels applicables : ADR (matières biologiques catégorie B – UN3373), norme NF EN 12830 (enregistreurs de température) et NF X15-140 (étalonnage) / accréditation COFRAC.

 

Étude et déploiement des matériels

• Étudier les solutions techniques adaptées aux besoins de l'entreprise.

• Définir les spécifications techniques des équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

• Piloter l'installation des équipements frigorifiques et des systèmes de surveillance embarqués.

• Participer à la validation des nouveaux véhicules et matériels.

• Assurer la maîtrise et le suivi quotidien des plateformes de télésurveillance métrologique : deux solutions sont actuellement utilisées, l'une auprès d'un fournisseur couvrant la majorité du parc, l'autre auprès d'un second fournisseur actuellement en phase de test.

• Superviser l'outil interne propriétaire de l'entreprise, connecté aux équipements et générant des alertes en temps réel en cas de dérive de température.

• Remonter au service IT les besoins d'évolution et contribuer au développement et à l'amélioration continue de ces outils.

 

Coordination avec le parc automobile et l'exploitation

• Travailler avec le Responsable Parc pour planifier les installations, maintenances et immobilisations des véhicules.

• Coordonner avec l'Exploitation afin de limiter l'impact des interventions sur l'activité.

• Veiller à la disponibilité opérationnelle des véhicules conformes aux exigences de température.

• Assurer la sensibilisation et la formation des conducteurs aux bonnes pratiques de maintien de la chaîne du froid (chargement, fermeture, temps d'ouverture des portes, contrôles visuels).

• Tenir à jour un tableau de bord des non-conformités température et en assurer le suivi avec la facturation des pénalités associées.

• Assurer le reporting Qualité de Service auprès des Responsables Exploitation et du Commerce, afin d'assurer le suivi avec le client et de le rassurer sur les actions menées.

 

Gestion des fournisseurs

• Identifier et sélectionner les fournisseurs de matériels et de prestations métrologiques.

• Participer aux consultations, appels d'offres et négociations.

• Suivre les contrats de maintenance et les performances des prestataires.

• Assurer une veille technologique sur les équipements de transport sous température dirigée.

 

Qualité et amélioration continue

• Participer aux audits internes et externes.

• Élaborer les procédures et instructions de travail.

• Assurer le suivi des indicateurs de performance.

• Conduire les analyses de causes en cas de non-conformité.

• Proposer des actions d'amélioration continue.

• Représenter la métrologie lors des audits qualité menés directement par les clients laboratoires et préparer les éléments de preuve associés (certificats d'étalonnage, historiques de température).

 

ACTIVITES DECISIONNELLES

Le Responsable Métrologie est amené à :

• proposer les investissements en matériels de mesure et équipements frigorifiques ;

• valider les choix techniques des installations ;

• décider des actions à engager en cas de dérive de température ou de non-conformité ;

• arbitrer les solutions techniques en lien avec les contraintes opérationnelles ;

• sélectionner les fournisseurs dans le cadre de sa délégation.

• Toutes ces décisions devront être validées avec la Direction des Opérations.

 

RELATIONS FONCTIONNELLES

En interne

• Direction des Opérations

• Responsable Parc Automobile

• Responsable Exploitation

• Service Qualité

• Conducteurs

• Commerce (reporting Qualité de Service et suivi client lié aux non-conformités température).

En externe

• Fournisseurs d'équipements frigorifiques

• Prestataires de métrologie

• Clients laboratoires, dans le cadre des audits qualité et des demandes de justificatifs métrologiques.

 


PROFIL RECHERCHE

Formation

• Bac +3 minimum dans un domaine technique, qualité ou équivalent.

Expérience

• 2 à 3 ans d'expérience dans une fonction technique, qualité ou analytique similaire.

• Une expérience dans le transport de produits de santé, la logistique pharmaceutique, les laboratoires ou le transport sous température dirigée est appréciée mais non indispensable, ce poste étant nouvellement créé en interne.

Compétences techniques

• Capacité à étudier des cas techniques et à aider à la prise de décision.

• Connaissances de base en métrologie, étalonnage et gestion de la chaîne du froid.

• Connaissance de la réglementation applicable au transport d'échantillons biologiques (ADR – UN3373, NF X15-

140 / COFRAC).

• Analyse de données de température.

• Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et des logiciels de suivi métrologique.

Qualités personnelles

• Sens de l'organisation.

• Rigueur et méthode.

• Esprit d'analyse.

• Capacité de prise de décision.

• Aisance relationnelle.

• Force de proposition.

• Capacité à coordonner plusieurs interlocuteurs.

• Réactivité face aux situations d'urgence.

Objectifs du poste

• Garantir le maintien permanent de la chaîne de température des échantillons biologiques.

• Assurer la conformité réglementaire des équipements et des véhicules.

• Optimiser les investissements en matériels de métrologie et de transport frigorifique.

• Réduire les incidents liés aux écarts de température.

• Développer une collaboration efficace entre la métrologie, le parc automobile et l'exploitation afin de sécuriser les opérations de transport.

data.title: Solutions Engineer - French Speaker
data.description:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s presales function in France and Southern EMEA. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across France and Southern EMEA.

Sales Cycle Ownership & AE Partnership

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

Demo Excellence

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Develop and maintain reusable assets across demo environments, use cases, integration templates, objection handling, and industry playbooks, brought to life directly in Synthesia's platform.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

Product Expertise

  • Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value.

  • Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

  • Stay ahead of the AI-native learning and enablement space, so you can credibly discuss how customers are shifting from static methods to interactive practice and measurable skill development.

Ecosystem Collaboration

  • Product: share customer and prospect feedback with Product, flagging pain points, missing capabilities, and gaps that surface in your deals to help shape the roadmap.

  • Product Marketing: work with Product Marketing to understand and apply messaging and positioning in your deal cycles, and contribute to reusable assets like demo scripts and competitive battlecards.

  • Customer Success: brief Customer Success on technical context and champion relationships at handover, so your POCs and pilots convert cleanly into production deployments.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of pre-sales, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical experience in a SaaS environment (or equivalent technical customer-facing experience).

  • Delivers a strong standard demo aligned to the discovery points and agenda set with the AE, with a solid grasp of core demo technique (e.g., Tell-Show-Tell).

  • Applies established solution designs and best practices to the customer's use case, working with core ecosystem functions (Product, Customer Success) as the deal requires.

  • Identifies and surfaces deal risk and next steps based on what the customer tells you, escalating clearly to your AE so it gets actioned.

  • Working knowledge of MEDDPICC and Command of the Message, and can articulate why Synthesia is a fit for the prospect.

  • Resourceful: knows how to find the right person or tool internally, and is building their own network across the GTM organization.

  • Comfortable with the technical fundamentals in at least one area (creation flows, APIs, integrations, security, compliance) and eager to build depth quickly.

  • Self-motivated and organized, able to manage a growing book of POCs, demos, and customer conversations while hitting deadlines.

  • Willing to travel for customer discovery and on-site demos as needed.

We'd be particularly excited if

  • You speak Spanish and Italian

Location

We’re ideally looking for someone based in Paris who can spend time in our office at 40 Rue du Colisée, 75008 Paris, or someone based in the UK who can spend time in our London office at 20 Triton Street, Regent’s Place, London NW1 3BF. Please confirm where you are located and whether you can spend two days a week in either location.

  • Collaborative mindset; thrives working with AEs, Product, Customer Success, and other teams to drive customer and company success.

  • Product orientation; genuine curiosity about how customers use technology

Location

data.title: Responsable commercial régional
data.description:
Description de l'équipe

SumUp accélère le déploiement de ses équipes de vente terrain en France, et ce poste à responsabilité façonnera cette croissance à Toulouse, en apportant nos outils de paiement et de gestion aux petites entreprises de la région. La personne retenue dirigera et développera une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en assurant personnellement des acquisitions dans un premier temps tout en construisant la structure, la culture et le modèle de coaching qui porteront la région. C'est l'occasion de construire une région depuis ses fondations, avec une évolution possible vers un poste de Territory Manager à mesure que l'équipe et l'activité se développent, en rapportant au Head of Region France.

Vos missions

  • Diriger et développer une équipe de consultants commerciaux terrain indépendants, en construisant les compétences et la culture nécessaires pour s'imposer sur le marché

  • Porter les objectifs d'acquisition de revenus de la région, piloter le portefeuille de marchands acquis et le développer par la vente croisée et la montée en gamme

  • Fixer le niveau d'exigence en matière de performance commerciale, en ancrant une culture de coaching et de responsabilisation au sein de l'équipe terrain

  • Façonner les outils de vente, du support de présentation aux contenus d'accompagnement, pour permettre à l'équipe de rivaliser et de gagner

  • Maintenir une présence forte sur le terrain, réaliser des audits auprès des marchands et transformer la connaissance du marché en actions concrètes

  • Définir la stratégie concurrentielle de la région et tenir les parties prenantes seniors informées de l'avancement

Vous êtes fait pour ce poste si…

  • Expérience avérée dans la direction et le développement d'équipes commerciales, incluant le coaching de consultants indépendants vers une performance durable

  • Expérience dans la construction d'une région ou d'un territoire commercial dès ses débuts, avec la structure nécessaire pour le faire évoluer

  • Solide connaissance des services aux marchands, des paiements, des systèmes de point de vente ou de la vente auprès des PME, par exemple dans l'hôtellerie ou le voyage

  • Maîtrise du français et de l'anglais, avec une crédibilité reconnue pour évoluer dans des environnements multiculturels et face à des parties prenantes variées

  • Prise de décision stratégique et orientée données, avec la capacité à diriger dans l'incertitude d'un marché en forte croissance

Pourquoi rejoindre SumUp

🌎 Opportunité de travailler avec des SumUppers du monde entier sur des produits fintech à grande échelle utilisés par des millions d'entreprises, dans le cadre d'un poste de terrain couvrant la région de Toulouse. Ce poste implique des déplacements réguliers pour accompagner votre équipe sur le territoire 🌈 Engagement envers la diversité et l'inclusion : faites partie d'un environnement de travail qui valorise et promeut la diversité, favorisant un cadre inclusif où les perspectives de chacun sont respectées et accueillies 🚀 Adhésion à notre programme d'options d'achat d'actions virtuelles (VSOP) : vous détiendrez une participation dans le succès futur de SumUp 📚 Un budget annuel dédié de 2000 € pour votre développement personnel, utilisable pour assister à des conférences et/ou faire progresser votre carrière grâce à une formation complémentaire 💼 Sécurité financière : des cotisations de retraite d'entreprise qui soutiennent votre avenir à long terme 🏥 Accompagnement santé : nous prenons en charge 50 % du coût mensuel de votre assurance santé (Mutuelle et Prévoyance) 🚌 Avantages supplémentaires : nous proposons des titres restaurant (Swile) et prenons en charge vos frais de transport 🏖 Congés généreux : profitez de 25 jours de congés payés, ainsi que des jours fériés et des jours de congés spéciaux 🎉 Petits déjeuners réguliers, événements d'équipe, fêtes de bureau et activités sportives 🌴 Break4me : un mois sabbatique après 3 ans d'ancienneté 🔗 Prime de cooptation : bénéficiez de récompenses supplémentaires en recommandant des talents pour rejoindre l'équipe SumUp

À propos de SumUp

Soyez acteur d'un changement qui compte vraiment.

Chez SumUp, notre mission est d'accompagner les petites entreprises du monde entier en leur proposant des outils simples et accessibles qui leur permettent de prospérer. Aujourd'hui, plus de 4 millions d'entreprises dans 39 marchés font confiance à SumUp comme partenaire financier pour gérer leurs paiements, leurs finances et leurs relations clients.

Notre engagement envers les petites entreprises se reflète dans notre équipe diversifiée de plus de 4 000 SumUppers originaires de plus de 90 nationalités, unis par une collaboration mondiale et un esprit innovant. Nos valeurs fondamentales constituent le socle de notre identité et de nos convictions, façonnant notre culture de travail et portant notre réussite. Nous cultivons l'inclusion et une culture d'apprentissage continu, en offrant un espace sûr pour l'épanouissement personnel et professionnel. Nos différences font notre unicité et notre force, à mesure que nous œuvrons à créer un environnement où chacun se sent à sa place et soutenu, quelle que soit son identité.

SumUp est fier d'être un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances, recherchant et accueillant activement la diversité au sein de ses équipes. Nous ne fondons nos décisions de recrutement ou d'emploi sur aucun critère de race, de couleur, de religion ou de conviction religieuse, d'origine ethnique ou nationale, de nationalité, de sexe, d'identité de genre, d'orientation sexuelle, de handicap, d'âge, ou de tout autre critère protégé par la loi applicable ou interdit par la politique de l'entreprise. Notre engagement va au delà du recrutement pour créer un lieu de travail sûr et respectueux, où toute forme de harcèlement est strictement interdite. Découvrez-en davantage sur notre culture et nos opportunités sur notre site carrières, et suivez notre actualité sur LinkedIn, Instagram et TikTok.

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

data.title: Senior Java Software Engineer
data.description:
Chez Exotec, nous mettons l’excellence technologique au service de la redéfinition des relations entre humains et robots. A travers le monde, nos solutions révolutionnent la façon dont nos client·e·s délivrent leurs produits aux personnes consommatrices finales. Nous contribuons au succès des plus grandes marques du commerce et de l’industrie, tout en améliorant les conditions de travail de leurs salarié·e·s.

Par l’alliance de l’intelligence artificielle et d’un hardware performant, nos robots sont désormais déployés dans le monde entier et leur succès a fait de nous la première licorne industrielle française.

Rejoindre Exotec, c’est l’opportunité de donner du sens à vos compétences. Grandissez avec nos ExoPeople dans le monde entier pour faire de vos idées, des réalités.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de notre département R&D, vous rejoignez l’équipe Studio, en charge du développement de notre outil de conception et de configuration d’entrepôts robotisés.

De la modélisation d’un entrepôt en 3D au dimensionnement d’une solution Skypod (solution robotisée de stockage et de préparation de commandes pour les entrepôts logistiques), en passant par l’optimisation des coûts et la préparation du déploiement, Studio accompagne les équipes Exotec à chaque étape de leurs projets.

En tant que Senior Java Software Engineer, vous contribuez à faire évoluer cet outil stratégique en concevant et développant son backend et ses API. Vous intervenez sur des problématiques techniques variées, allant des moteurs de règles métier aux intégrations avec l’écosystème Exotec, avec un objectif : proposer des solutions fiables, performantes et adaptées aux besoins des utilisateurs.

En lien étroit avec les équipes techniques, produit et métier, vous participez activement aux choix de conception et à l’amélioration continue de Studio, afin de faciliter la conception et le déploiement des solutions robotiques Exotec à travers le monde.

Vos missions

  • Développer le backend de Studio : concevoir et faire évoluer les services Java et Spring Boot, les API et les fonctionnalités liées à la conception 3D, au dimensionnement des solutions et au calcul des coûts.
  • Concevoir les intégrations : développer et maintenir les connecteurs avec les outils de chiffrage, AutoCAD et les API de l’écosystème Exotec, notamment ICT et MCP.
  • Garantir la qualité du produit : assurer la performance, la robustesse et la fiabilité des applications, analyser les incidents de production et contribuer à l’amélioration continue du code.
  • Contribuer à la livraison continue : participer aux processus CI/CD, aux releases et à la validation des évolutions avec GitLab.
  • Collaborer avec les équipes : recueillir les besoins des utilisateurs, travailler avec les équipes produit, frontend, commerciales et projets, et participer aux rituels agiles de l’équipe.

Profil

Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une école d'ingénieurs ou d'une formation de niveau Bac+5 en informatique ou en informatique industrielle, et justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience en développement web.

Vous disposez des compétences suivantes :

  • Vous maîtrisez Java et l’écosystème JEE, notamment Spring et Spring Boot.
  • Vous avez une bonne connaissance des technologies web et de la conception d’API.
  • Vous êtes à l’aise avec les bases de données relationnelles, notamment PostgreSQL, ainsi qu’avec les environnements Linux.
  • Vous maîtrisez les outils de gestion de versions et de développement collaboratif, notamment GitLab.
  • Vous connaissez idéalement un framework JavaScript, tel que React ou Vue.js.
  • Vous disposez d’un niveau d’anglais opérationnel.

Structuré(e), rigoureux(se) et imaginatif(ve), vous savez prendre des initiatives et proposer des solutions pragmatiques. Vous appréciez le travail en équipe et êtes à l’aise pour collaborer avec des interlocuteurs aux profils variés, dans un environnement de travail convivial.

Poste soumis à astreinte.

Benefits

  • Couverture mutuelle et prévoyance santé compétitive
  • Politique famille avantageuse
  • Programme de mobilité interne et internationale
  • Nombreuses opportunités de formation et de développement

 

Chez Exotec, nous garantissons l’égalité des chances dans notre processus de recrutement. L’ensemble des candidatures reçues sont étudiées indépendamment de l’âge, du genre, de l’origine, de la religion, de la couleur de peau, de la nationalité, du sexe, du handicap, de l’orientation sexuelle ou de toute autre distinction protégée par la loi. Nous mettons en place un environnement de travail inclusif et respectueux de toutes les différences. En rejoignant le Pacte Parité, Exotec s’engage pour un écosystème French Tech plus paritaire.

La révolution robotique portée par Exotec ne fait que commencer, vous en êtes ?

Votre rôle

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, composée de 6 ingénieurs, vous contribuez à améliorer les performances, la fiabilité et la disponibilité des systèmes robotiques Exotec.

Notre mission : exploiter les données et analyser les défaillances pour améliorer la robustesse et la durée de vie de nos systèmes, tout en réduisant les arrêts opérationnels.

À l’interface entre hardware et software, vous identifiez les causes racines des défaillances, développez des outils d’analyse et pilotez des améliorations techniques. Vous intervenez sur l’ensemble du système, de l’analyse des données terrain au développement et à la validation de solutions concrètes.

Au sein de l’équipe R&D Reliability, vos missions sont les suivantes :

  • Analyser les défaillances et améliorer la fiabilité : exploiter les données terrain, identifier les principaux modes de panne, rechercher les causes racines et définir des actions correctives et préventives.

  • Développer et tester des solutions logicielles : réaliser des développements de software embarqué en autonomie afin de tester vos améliorations et de résoudre des problématiques à l’interface entre hardware et software.
  • Contribuer à l’évolution des systèmes : travailler avec les équipes de conception pour améliorer les composants, les sous-systèmes et les architectures hardware.
  • Concevoir et réaliser des essais : définir des protocoles de test, mener des expérimentations sur des systèmes dédiés à la R&D et mesurer l’efficacité des améliorations apportées.
  • Enrichir votre connaissance des systèmes sur le terrain : participer au support client pour mieux comprendre les conditions d’utilisation, investiguer les problèmes rencontrés et identifier de nouvelles pistes d’amélioration.

Votre profil
