data.title: Senior Product Manager
data.description:
About The Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager with real technical depth and an AI-first way of working. You'll own a product area end to end: finding problems worth solving, shaping the solution, taking it from 0 to 1 and growing it from there.
You understand architecture, you've written code, you know how databases work, and you speak engineering fluently. Your main job is product. The technical depth is what lets you move faster and make better calls.
AI isn't a feature we're adding. It's how we work and how we build. Expect roughly 70% product and 30% engineering, with full accountability for results.


Your Mission

  • Product direction: set the vision, strategy and roadmap for your area. Decide what to build, why, and how success is measured.
  • 0-to-1 delivery: take new products and features from problem discovery to launch and iteration.
  • Discovery and validation: work directly with users and data to understand real problems, not assumed ones. Run interviews, usability tests and experiments before committing to build.
  • Metrics and outcomes: define, instrument and track the KPIs for your area. Use product analytics to find friction, prioritise the highest-impact work, and shut down what doesn't work.
  • Engineering partnership: understand architectural trade-offs, review technical approaches and unblock decisions. Write specs engineers actually want to read: clear, technical and opinionated.
  • AI and automation: find where LLMs and agents create real product value, build the case, and ship it.
  • Fast prototyping: validate ideas with AI tools (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, agents), scripts, no-code, or whatever gets you to the answer quickest.
  • Hands-on work: write queries, dig into data pipelines, spin up prototypes, and open a PR when it makes sense.
  • Prioritisation: balance user impact, business value, effort and regulatory constraints, and work closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics and business owners to ship continuously.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in product management or product engineering with strong technical involvement, and a track record of taking products from 0 to live use with real users.
  • AI-native: you use LLMs, vibe coding and agents daily, and you've applied LLMs or agentic AI to real products.
  • Strong in Python or a similar language, enough to build things yourself. Comfortable with SQL, git, databases and evaluating system architecture.
  • Fluent in product analytics and research: you define metrics, read data yourself, and validate through interviews, usability testing and experiments.
  • Strong grasp of UX. You can take a complex flow and make it simple.
  • Experience shipping with Design and Engineering in an agile environment.
  • Clear communicator in English and self-directed. You can explain technical decisions to non-technical people, write specs engineers respect, and don't wait to be told what matters.

Nice to Have
  • Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical field.
  • Experience in fintech or another regulated industry.
  • Early-stage startup background.
  • Hands-on LLM orchestration or prompt engineering.
  • Background in software engineering, QA or product analytics.


Why Join Vivid?

  • We have a hybrid model in our Limassol and Berlin offices, or fully remote outside office locations. 
  • We support relocation to Cyprus (visa, package) when needed.
  • AI-first culture – we use it every day, not just talk about it.
  • Learning & development budget to support your professional growth. 
  • Fully paid vacation and sick leave. 
  • Sports compensation. 
  • Real growth prospects, significant responsibility, and the ability to make an immediate impact from day one.


Compensation range

Final compensation is determined individually, based on your experience, skills and the scope of the role, assessed against objective, gender-neutral criteria.


About Vivid

At Vivid, we're on a mission to change how businesses and individuals manage their money across Europe. For businesses, we build tools that actually make a difference: multi-IBAN accounts, high-yield savings, business cashback, team cards, and accounting integrations that save real time — all in one place. And for individuals, we offer a simple way to manage and grow your wealth: access to global stocks, ETFs and 150+ cryptocurrencies, cashback, and personalised financial insights.

Our mission? Your success. Everyone deserves the chance to see their finances flourish, and we're dedicated to empowering our customers to make this a reality.

Founded in 2019 in Berlin by Alexander Emeshev and Artem Iamanov, Vivid has quickly grown into one of Germany's top financial platforms for SMEs and private accounts. Since then, we've expanded rapidly across Europe, earning the trust of over 500,000 customers — and with over €200 million raised and a valuation of €775 million, we're just getting started.

We're building Vivid as an AI-native organization — across every function, from product to compliance to operations. Automation handles a growing share of day-to-day execution. For us, this means our teams can focus on architecture, strategy, and high-impact decision-making. This changes how we work: less manual execution, more ownership in building systems that scale. We want to help define what AI-native looks like in a regulated financial environment — and we're looking for people who want to build that future with us.

data.title: Security Engineer (Hybrid or Remote)
data.description:
About The Role

We’re looking for a Security Engineer to own and improve the security of our internal environment — the identities, SaaS apps, endpoints, AI tooling, and networks our employees use every day. This is a hands-on senior role: we expect you to design controls, find the gaps, and drive the changes that close them — and to build the automation that makes it scale.

We’re an EMI-licensed fintech in a fully cloud-native AWS environment, we use AI heavily, and we’re growing fast. We need someone who can lead technical initiatives independently, influence our security architecture, challenge approaches that no longer fit, and explain it clearly to engineers and leadership.


Your Mission

Detection & Response (SIEM) — our top priority

  • Own SIEM alerting end-to-end: ship logs from endpoints, IdP, VPN, SaaS, and cloud; write and tune detection rules; cut false positives.
  • Act as first responder for security incidents — investigate, contain, drive to closure with clear runbooks — and feed recurring issues back into preventive controls.
Identity, Access & SaaS
  • Administer the IdP (SSO via SAML/OIDC, MFA, conditional access) and run access recertification end-to-end across IdP, SaaS, AWS, and internal tools — scope, evidence, follow-through on revocations.
  • Hunt down over-permissive and stale access, enforce least privilege and PAM, catch SoD gaps, and make JML and third-party access work in practice.
  • Improve SaaS security posture (Google/Microsoft, Slack, GitHub, others) and apply DLP controls to limit data leakage.
Endpoint, Email & Phishing Defense
  • Keep the endpoint stack healthy and well-tuned — MDM, XDR/AV, device-compliance checks for VPN/ZTNA — and define posture requirements (disk encryption, EDR present, OS version) with automated remediation.
  • Defend against phishing and spoofing — secure email gateway rules, DMARC/SPF/DKIM — and run phishing simulations and security awareness, acting on the results.
Automation & Ownership
  • Build internal tooling and automate repetitive operations — reduce manual work, don't just operate it.
  • Own the roadmap for your areas: identify gaps, lead initiatives independently, and raise the bar rather than just maintain it.


Your Profile

  • 5+ years in security operations, corporate/IT security, or endpoint engineering.
  • Strong with a SIEM (Splunk, Elastic, Panther, Sumo Logic) — detection engineering and incident response — plus an identity provider (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace), access recertification, and least-privilege / PAM.

data.title: CDI - CREATIVE DESIGNER - BRAND CONCEPTS (H/F)
data.description:
LA MAISON JACQUEMUS
 
Jacquemus a été fondée par Simon Porte Jacquemus en 2009 à Paris, en France.
Dédiée à la mémoire de la mère du créateur, la marque puise son inspiration dans une passion pour la culture. Les collections femme et homme font référence à l'art de vivre à la française et aux gestes universels de beauté, intégrant des influences allant de la photographie d'art aux arts décoratifs, en passant par le cinéma, la peinture et la sculpture.
 
Au fil des années, Jacquemus a mis en scène ses défilés dans des lieux uniques et inattendus, notamment une piscine parisienne, le Musée Picasso, un champ de lavande en Provence, un champ de blé aux abords de Paris, un marais salant en Camargue et une plage à Hawaï. Plus récemment, la marque a investi des lieux tels que le canal du Château de Versailles (Le Chouchou), la Fondation Maeght (Les Sculptures), la Casa Malaparte (La Casa) et l'appartement parisien d'Auguste Perret (La Croisière).
 
Basé dans le 8ᵉ arrondissement de Paris, Jacquemus est une maison de mode indépendante comptant plus de 300 employés. Réputée pour sa forte présence numérique et son expansion internationale, la marque a développé des expériences de vente innovantes à travers le monde avant d'ouvrir son premier flagship permanent au 58 Avenue Montaigne à Paris en 2022. Depuis, des boutiques ont été ouvertes à New York (SoHo) et Londres (New Bond Street).
 
 
 
VOTRE RÔLE

Vous contribuez au développement de l'identité de JACQUEMUS à travers les concept image, défilés, projets spéciaux, Beauté, expérience et l'ensemble des supports de communication de la Maison. Vous imaginez de nouveaux langages graphiques, développez des concepts créatifs avec le Brand Concepts Director et accompagnez leur déploiement sur l'ensemble des points de contact.

 

VOS MISSIONS

  • Participer au développement des concepts créatifs des projets spéciaux, collaborations et initiatives de Brand Expansion.
  • Participer au développement des identités visuelles des campagnes, collections, défilés et projets spéciaux, de leur conception à leur déclinaison.
  • Développer les systèmes graphiques, lettrages, traitements typographiques et directions artistiques associés.
  • Réaliser des recherches créatives, iconographiques et graphiques pour alimenter les réflexions du Studio Image.
  • Concevoir les propositions graphiques des campagnes de communication et des grands temps forts de la Maison.
  • Concevoir les supports de communication liés aux défilés (invitations, moodboards, présentations, dossiers de presse…).
  • Développer les principes d'identité visuelle destinés au Retail Design, aux expériences de marque et aux activations.
  • Participer au développement de nouveaux formats digitaux, motion et contenus innovants.
  • Encadrer la déclinaison graphique des identités sur les différents supports.
  • Assurer la cohérence créative de l'ensemble des livrables en collaboration avec les équipes Image, Retail, Digital et Communication.

 

VOTRE PROFIL 

  • Excellente culture graphique et artistique.
  • Très forte maîtrise de l'identité visuelle, de la typographie et des systèmes graphiques.
  • Capacité à développer des concepts créatifs.
  • Excellente maîtrise de Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects et Premiere.
  • Aisance avec Keynote et PowerPoint.
  • Très bonne maîtrise du motion design.
  • Intérêt voire maîtrise d’outils IA appliquée à la création.
  • Capacité à travailler de manière transversale avec plusieurs équipes.
 
Le poste est situé rue de Lisbonne dans le 8è arrondissement de Paris.

data.title: Talent Acquisition Manager
data.description:
Diabolocom is the leading European sovereign cloud contact center (CCaaS) and customer experience management (CX) platform. It helps organizations transform customer experience by augmenting agents' capabilities through AI-human collaboration, automating routine customer interactions, and delivering personalized experiences at scale. Built on proprietary AI, private cloud, and native telecom infrastructure, the platform automates workflows, improves data quality, and empowers customer service and sales teams across every channel. 
 
Backed by more than two decades of experience and twice recognized by Frost & Sullivan for AI technology innovation and customer experience technology leadership, Diabolocom is trusted by more than 400 organizations—including BPCE, Carrefour, Nikon, and Mitsubishi—to power mission-critical customer operations in over 60 countries, helping organizations strengthen customer loyalty and accelerate growth.


About the role

To support our growth, we are looking for a Talent Acquisition Manager to join our HR team in Paris.

You will manage recruitment processes end-to-end, from understanding the hiring need and identifying the right sourcing strategy to interviewing candidates, managing the selection process and closing the hire.

A significant part of your activity will involve recruiting technical and highly specialized profiles, including Software Engineers, AI and Research profiles, Infrastructure experts, senior technical specialists and, depending on business needs, leadership and C-level positions.

You will work with a wide variety of stakeholders across the company: experienced hiring managers, technical experts, senior leaders and managers who may need more guidance throughout the recruitment process. Being able to adapt your approach, challenge when necessary and keep recruitment processes moving will therefore be an important part of your role.

You will join a collaborative Talent Acquisition team composed of a Talent Acquisition Team Lead, another Talent Acquisition Manager and an HR team member combining recruitment with broader HR projects, within the HR department.

We are looking for someone who is already comfortable managing recruitment independently, while remaining curious and eager to learn, develop their expertise and adopt our recruitment practices.


What you will do

  • Manage recruitment processes from A to Z, from the initial briefing with the hiring manager through sourcing, interviews, coordination of the selection process, offer management and contract signature.

  • Partner with hiring managers to understand their needs, challenge requirements when relevant and translate them into an effective recruitment and sourcing strategy.

  • Recruit across a variety of roles, with a strong focus on technical and complex profiles, including senior Software Engineers, AI/Research profiles, Infrastructure specialists, technical leadership and other hard-to-find profiles.

  • Take ownership of direct sourcing and headhunting, identifying and engaging passive candidates rather than relying primarily on inbound applications.

  • Build relevant talent pools and continuously explore new sourcing channels, tools and approaches.

  • Conduct structured interviews to assess candidates' experience, skills, motivations and potential fit with the role and environment.

  • Provide hiring managers with clear, fact-based candidate assessments and recommendations throughout the selection process.

  • Manage candidate communication throughout the recruitment journey and contribute to a professional, transparent and engaging candidate experience.

  • Adapt your way of working to different stakeholders, from very experienced senior leaders to managers who require more support in structuring their recruitment process.

  • Keep our ATS and recruitment data accurate and up to date and contribute to the monitoring of key recruitment indicators.

  • Share market insights with the team and hiring managers, including candidate availability, compensation expectations, competitive dynamics and sourcing challenges.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement projects within Talent Acquisition, such as sourcing practices, interview methodologies, candidate experience, automation, documentation and recruitment processes.

  • Work closely with the rest of the Talent Acquisition and HR team, sharing knowledge, candidates, sourcing techniques and best practices.


    • What we are looking for

  • You already have a first solid experience in Talent Acquisition, ideally around 3 to 5 years, either in-house or in a recruitment agency/search environment.

  • You are able to manage a recruitment process independently from initial briefing to hire, while knowing when to ask for input or collaborate with the team.

  • You have already recruited technical and/or particularly complex profiles. Previous exposure to Software Engineering, AI/Data, Infrastructure, Research or senior technical positions would be particularly relevant.

  • You are comfortable working on senior and hard-to-find profiles and understand that some searches require persistence, creativity and a highly targeted approach.

  • Direct sourcing is part of your recruiter DNA: you are comfortable approaching passive candidates and using tools and techniques such as LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean searches, talent mapping and other relevant sourcing channels.

  • You are comfortable interacting with stakeholders at different levels of seniority, including senior leaders and C-level executives, and can adapt your communication and level of guidance accordingly.

  • You know how to manage several recruitment processes simultaneously, prioritize effectively and maintain momentum even when working with busy stakeholders.

  • You combine autonomy with a strong team mindset: you take ownership of your searches but naturally share information, help colleagues and contribute to collective recruitment goals.

  • You are curious and eager to keep developing your recruitment expertise. You already have strong foundations, but you are still keen to learn new approaches, tools and practices.

  • You have strong interpersonal and communication skills and care about building high-quality relationships with both candidates and hiring managers.

  • Ability to build, manage and improve recruitment dashboards would be a strong plus for this role.

  • You are fluent in French and English, both written and spoken.

  • Spanish would be a strong plus, as would experience recruiting across several European or international markets.


    • What's in it for you

  • A structured onboarding program to discover our product, technology, teams and culture.

  • The opportunity to work on challenging searches across Software Engineering, AI, Infrastructure, Product, business and leadership roles.

data.title: Senior ML Engineer
data.description:
Who we are

Yubo is the Social Discovery app to make new friends and hang out online. By eliminating likes and follows, we empower our users to create genuine connections and show up as their true selves.

We've pioneered a new way for Gen Z to socialize online, and with millions of active users, our goal is to redefine how we connect today and tomorrow.

Our team is international, multicultural and deeply committed to its mission. As the leading platform to socialize online, we have a special responsibility to build a safe digital space for our community. Safety is embedded in our DNA, and our proactive approach focuses on user protection, support, and education.

Join us in this exciting journey and help us shape the future of social interactions!

About this role

As Yubo continues to scale, Machine Learning is becoming a core production layer, powering critical systems across safety, recommendations, and product optimization.

What makes this role unique is both the scale and diversity of our data, and the level of maturity we are aiming to reach.

We process massive volumes of images, text, and real-time user interactions, across millions of users worldwide, creating a wide range of high-impact ML challenges, including:

  • Content moderation (image, text, behavior)

  • Recommendation systems and user engagement optimization

  • Behavioral detection and trust & safety models

  • Emerging use cases such as dynamic pricing and growth optimization

At the same time, our current ML stack is still evolving.
Legacy models are not fully integrated into pipelines, lifecycle management remains inconsistent, and our approach can sometimes resemble “develop, deploy, and forget.”

As ML usage expands across the company, this creates increasing complexity and dependency on reliable, well-structured systems.

There is still a huge amount of untapped potential, with many ML use cases yet to be designed, tested, and scaled, but unlocking it requires building a more robust and scalable ML operating model.

We are therefore looking for a Senior ML Engineer to join our Platform Engineering team, reporting directly to Mikael (Head of Platform Engineering).

You will play a key role in delivering ML initiatives across the company, helping turn promising ideas into reliable production systems. You'll work on everything from model development and experimentation to deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement, while contributing to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices

Your responsibilities

 

ML Systems & Delivery

  • Deliver end-to-end ML use cases (recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation models, etc.).

  • Design, train, evaluate, and deploy ML models where appropriate.

  • Balance speed of delivery with robustness and reliability.

ML Lifecycle & Reliability

  • Drive improvements across the ML lifecycle (training, deployment, monitoring, iteration).

  • Establish KPIs and monitoring standards to track model performance over time.

  • Ensure continuous alignment with product and safety objectives.

  • Help improve the reliability and observability of production ML systems.

Platform & Standardization

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform through tools, workflows, and reusable components.

  • Help establish and promote scalable ML engineering practices across teams.

  • Contribute to improving self-service ML capabilities where relevant.

Legacy & Advanced Use Cases

  • Take ownership of legacy models and realign them with current business needs.

  • Improve, retrain, and integrate them into modern pipelines.

  • Contribute to best practices around LLM usage in moderation, recommendation, and other product domains.

  • Explore and implement advanced ML approaches where relevant.

Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Data Engineering, MLOps, Backend Platform, and Product teams.

  • Act as a bridge between ML, platform, and business stakeholders.

  • Provide technical leadership on ML initiatives and help improve engineering practices across teams.

  • Share knowledge and help raise the overall ML maturity of the organization.

 

Our technical environment / ML scope

  • ML frameworks: PyTorch

  • Languages: Python (data stack)

  • Core topics: Neural networks, LLMs, data sampling

  • Use cases: Recommendation systems, safety algorithms, moderation

  • Ecosystem: Data Engineering, MLOps pipelines, Backend Platform

 

Who you are

  • You have 5+ years of experience in ML / Data, including work on large-scale datasets (datasets of hundreds of gigabytes).

  • You have strong expertise in modern ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch or JAX).

  • You are highly proficient in Python (data ecosystem).

  • You have strong knowledge of neural networks and practical experience with LLM-based systems.

  • You understand ML systems end-to-end (data → training → deployment → monitoring).

  • You have strong experience in production ML systems, not only research.

  • You demonstrate strong product sense and can align models with business needs.

  • You are pragmatic and impact-driven, balancing experimentation with delivery.

  • You are able to explain complex ML topics clearly (strong pedagogy).

  • You operate well under ambiguity and can structure complex problems.

  • You are able to drive technical decisions and influence stakeholders through expertise and collaboration.

 

In your first 6 months, you will

  • Deliver an end-to-end ML use case to validate impact and execution.

  • Audit and improve lifecycle management of existing ML models.

  • Refactor and retrain at least one legacy safety model.

  • Build reusable ML components that improve development efficiency across teams.

  • Improve monitoring and observability of production ML systems.

  • Contribute to the evolution of our ML platform and engineering practices.

  • Help move critical ML systems toward more reliable and measurable long-term operation.

The recruitment process

What we offer

  • Great health insurance coverage for both you and your family by Alan, fully paid for by Yubo !

  • Numerous benefits for parents: additional parental leave, easy access to nurseries and daycare facilities in France.

Our approach to privacy & safety

As part of your role, you may handle tools and features involving personal data. We expect all employees to demonstrate strong awareness of privacy and safety issues, and to actively support our Privacy & Safety by Design efforts.

Join Yubo and help shape the future of Social Discovery while enjoying a culture that values flexibility, well-being, and impact.

You own the impact: Step up, adapt, and make it matter

Unconventionally Smart: Hack with intent, borrow smart, build better

Enjoy Top-notch Benefits

data.title: Scientific Product Director, Clinical Prediction
data.description:
About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The role

Our clinical-prediction offer gives pharma partners the evidence to guide decisions before and during clinical development. We are looking for a Scientific Product Director to turn this science into sellable products: decide what gets developed and when, define what each capability can claim and output, and shape how results are delivered to partners.

You will report to Gustave Ronteix, CTO and co-founder, and work daily with a tight-knit interdisciplinary team composed of Computational Biology, Data Science, R&D, Platform Strategy & Operations, BD and Pharma Partnerships.

What you'll do

1. Own the product roadmap

  • Design and build a scalable product capable of derisking and accelerating clinical development of drug candidates based on Orakl’s scientific capabilities

  • Turn signals from BD, Pharma Partnerships and R&D into capability definitions: specs, target metrics, validation plan, in- vs out-of-scope definition, cost to deliver

  • Set priorities and dates with Engineering and Data Science; flag slippage early and make the trade-offs

  • Identify productization-gaps from delivery audits and analysis, and feed recurring ones back into the roadmap

2. Oversee product maturity and decide what we sell

  • Maintain the capability catalog: what is available now, in beta or on the roadmap, and what each can and cannot claim

  • Contribute to the final decision of when a capability is ready to sell (based on Data Science’s validation evidence) versus what is not-yet sellable in the pipeline, and communicate it internally

  • Oversee the scientific case for each capability: white papers, application notes, posters

3. Design how results reach partners

  • Design the reports, data packages and dashboards partners receive, and direct the engineers who build them

  • Own the deliverable contents: figures, statistical summaries, methods, limitations

  • Embed the approved claims and the QC checklist in every template, so Pharma Partnerships can produce a correct deliverable at scale

  • Keep templates current as the validated envelope changes, and pull or revise one when it no longer applies

What we're looking for

Must have

  • PhD or equivalent in cancer biology, pharmacology, biostatistics or computational biology

  • 8+ years in translational oncology, biomarker or diagnostics development, computational-biology platforms or preclinical CRO services, including 2+ owning a product roadmap

  • Technical depth: you read and understand production code, and can brief and review the work of engineers who build our reports and dashboards

  • You judge evidence: from a validation pack - back-tests, calibration, biomarker cutoffs -, you can state a claim the data supports and refuse the one it doesn't

  • You have experience working at the intersection of scientific and business departments within fast-growing companies

  • You know how pharma decides: you have seen proposals, SOWs and due-diligence questions, and know what a go/no-go decision needs from a prediction

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have

  • You have seen bespoke research work turned into something repeatable and sellable

  • Scientific authorship: Posters, talks, papers or white papers; a presence at AACR, ASCO, ESMO or SITC

  • Regulatory: exposure to regulated or quality-managed environments

  • Therapeutic or preclinical knowledge: ADC, immuno-oncology or targeted therapy; organoid or in-vitro pharmacology

  • Clinical-trial design or Trial statistics: adaptive designs, sample size, endpoints

  • Templated reporting: report-generation frameworks or web front-end

What we offer

  • Mission: work on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Ownership: a product function to build from the ground up.

  • Impact: pharma teams make real portfolio decisions with what you define.

  • Team: an exceptional crew of clinicians, biologists, engineers and data scientists, most with a PhD.

👉 More about Orakl here and here

Interview process

  1. Intro call (30 min) with Gustave Ronteix, CTO

  2. Case interview (1h)

  3. Case study (take-home)

  4. Conversations with BD, Pharma Partnerships, the Engineering / Data Science leads and Platform Strategy & Operations.

  5. References: 2-3, including a direct manager

Vous rejoindrez la Direction de l’emploi, de l’environnement et des politiques sociales (DIREEPS) qui assure la mise en œuvre d’une centaine de politiques publiques confiées à l’ASP par une quinzaine de ministères et établissements publics nationaux, comme les aides à l’apprentissage, l’activité partielle , le service civique, le leasing social, le chèque énergie, …

Vous intégrerez le Service Animation, Gestion et Contrôles des aides qui élabore le cadre administratif opérationnel de gestion des politiques d’aides publiques.

Objectifs :

Au sein d’un secteur, le chargé d’action assure l’ingénierie administrative, le pilotage opérationnel et l’animation d’une ou plusieurs politiques d’aides publiques dans le cadre des missions confiées par les décideurs publics.

Vous interviendrez notamment sur le dispositif Chèque énergie.

Les principales missions :

Assurer l’ingénierie administrative pour la conception de politiques d’aides publiques

  • Analyser les cadres d’intervention et conseiller les décideurs publics

  • Elaborer les procédures d’instruction et d’assistance aux usagers et les expressions de besoins SI

  • Conduire le changement pour le déploiement des dispositifs (communication, formation)

data.title: Process Engineer - Ultra sonic welding (m/f/d)
data.description:
Join us in driving connectivity forward!

At One Mobility Group, we bridge worlds—combining nearly a century of German automotive engineering precision with the innovation power of the globe's largest electronics and ICT manufacturer. This unique positioning makes us the strategic partner for end-to-end mobility solutions—from initial concept design to large-scale manufacturing. Our comprehensive portfolio spans the full spectrum of electrified mobility, including power distribution systems, high- and low-voltage modules, safety components, and advanced charging solutions. We specialize in integration expertise that seamlessly connects data, power, and sensing – redefining what’s possible in intelligent, connected mobility.

At One Mobility, you will join a vibrant international team of 10,500 people, working together in 17 countries across Europe, Asia, North America, the Middle East, and Africa. Step into a culture where inclusivity is the foundation, where your ideas are trusted and supported, your passions are nurtured, and the spirit of collaboration is encouraged.

We move fast, think differently, and empower our people to deliver breakthrough solutions.

We are looking for

Process Engineer - Ultra sonic welding (m/f/d)

at one of our locations in EMEA region - Germany (Reutlingen), France (Masevaux)

Your tasks:

  1.    Technical Leadership & Competency Management

·       Primary contact and technical lead for local Process Engineers within their respective area of specialization

·       Ensure training, qualification, and continuous development of local Process Engineering functions across all plants

·       Ensure effective know-how transfer between plants in both directions

 

2.     Global Process Support & Governance

·       Provide technical support and troubleshooting for manufacturing plants worldwide in process-related matters

·       Define, standardize, and continuously develop global process standards

·       Own end-to-end responsibility for process-related topics throughout the entire product lifecycle

·       Serve as Process Owner for the Master Process FMEA (P-FMEA) to ensure a consistent global risk management approach

·       Monitor compliance with industry standards and quality requirements

 

3.     Process Development & Continuous Improvement

·       Analyze current-state processes and perform gap analyses against target-state requirements

·       Develop, implement, and continuously optimize robust and scalable production processes

·       Improve efficiency, productivity, and quality while sustainably reducing costs and downtime

·       Utilize KPIs and established methodologies such as Lean Management and Six Sigma for problem solving and process improvement

·       Systematically capture and roll out lessons learned across plants to drive continuous improvement

 

4.     Project & Capital Investment Management

·       Support RFQ (Request for Quotation) activities

·       Ensure on-time procurement of machinery, including support and participation in FAT/SAT activities, while adhering to budget targets

·       Lead and coordinate continuous improvement and optimization projects

 

5.     Innovation & Technology Management

·       Conduct proactive technology scouting and trend monitoring to advance manufacturing processes and capabilities


  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or related field

  • Knowledge of:

    o    Automotive Core Tools (APQP, FMEA, PPAP, etc.)

    o    IATF 16949

  • Fluent English skills (German is nice to have)

  • Weld engineer or mechanical engineer experience (acc. To process area)

  • Experience in ultra sonic welding is nice to have

  • Experience in manufacturing is mandatory (automotive is nice to have)

  • 2-5 years of experience in process engineering

  • Willingness to travel (20-40% yearly)

Our offer:

  • A permanent, full-time position

  • A mixed team of fresh talent and long-standing employees

  • Extensive training and development opportunities

  • A structured induction program

  • An attractive remuneration package

Are you interested?

We are looking forward to receive your application. If you have any questions in the meantime do not hesitate to contact us. Please apply online in English and use our web portal at onemobility.recruitee.com.

data.title: Devops Engineer
data.description:
As a DevOps Engineer, you will be an integral part of an existing team comprising sixseven DevOps professionals. You will play a vital role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our cloud infrastructure and the internal platform built on it, which serves over 1800+ client companies, with 2.5+ million registered users and 30,000 daily active users. 

You will collaborate closely with all engineering squads including Development, Architecture, AI, and Data teams, to ensure the smooth and efficient delivery of our SaaS product. Our objective is to treat our infrastructure as a product for our developers, managing its complexity so they don’t have to. We provide simple, ready-to-use tools that enable them to build, deploy, and run their services efficiently.. Your expertise will be crucial in driving continuous improvement and fostering innovation within our DevOps and Platform Engineering practices.

You will have the opportunity to:

- Make a tangible impact in a rapidly evolving company. You will be responsible for building and maintaining a scalable infrastructure (accommodating more developers, more customers, and expansion into more countries) while optimizing resources (monitoring costs, reducing toil, and improving time to market) to support our growing activities.

- Engage in the continuous enhancement of our practices and undertake challenging and comprehensive projects. If you are interested in topics like SRE practices and platform engineering, you will play a key role in our transformation.

- Establish your own niche within a highly-skilled team that is eager to learn, share knowledge, and progress together.


Within 1 month, you will
  • Discover 360Learning, its platform, its teams and its culture.
  • Become familiar with our R&D way of working.
  • Understand the team’s processes.

    • Within 3 months, you will
  • Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Terraform, Ansible and Helm.
  • Automate the deployment of applications, configurations and infrastructure to achieve a high level of flexibility and confidence in production setups and deployment processes.
  • Improve our global security, challenge our worldwide scaling, increase our performance.

    • Within 6 months, you will:
  • Collaborate with other squads to implement and improve our DevOps practices.
  • Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and implement solutions to improve system stability and availability.
  • Manage and maintain our Azure cloud infrastructure.
  • Ensure the security and compliance of our systems and data.
  • Participate in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 support.
  • Manage incidents and post-mortem.
  • Work closely with developers to facilitate their daily tasks, help them conform to best practices and ensure environments meet requirements  (e.g.: simplify and automate the deployment process, provide metrics and monitoring to the engineering squads).
  • Build and improve our internal platform: easy-to-deploy tools and templates that move infrastructure work off the squads' plate ("shift down"), so developers can ship without being infrastructure experts.
  • Improve monitoring and load testing to secure and enhance the performance of our infrastructure

    • Within 12 months, you will:
  • Actively participate in DevOps decisions for all critical projects related to our platform’s performance and reliability.
  • Evangelize and train our R&D team on Devops culture by defining all best practices and building them into the platform by default.

    • The Skill Set
  • 3+ years of experience as a DevOps Engineer or in a similar role.
  • Ideally, you have worked in a tech or a SaaS company
  • You know how to run systems in production
  • Interest in platform engineering and developer experience: you like building tools that other engineers enjoy using
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, GitOps).
  • Experience with containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Strong understanding of networking, security, and system administration.
  • You have a coding background (scripting, programming)
  • Passion for automation and continuous improvement.
  • You have working proficiency in English (level B2 or equivalent)Fluent English (US/UK) / B2 level or equivalent (FR)
  • Enthusiasm for our working environment explained here:  https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L

    • Our technical stack

  • Cloud: Azure Cloud

  • Container orchestration: k8s, ArgoCD

  • Infra as Code: Terraform, AnsibleHelm

  • Monitoring tool: Datadog

  • Database: MongoDB Atlas

  • Application language: Javascript


    • What we offer:
  • Compensation: Package includes base salary, a variable component and equity 📈
  • Benefits/Perks: Work From Home stipend, RTT, lunch vouchers, medical insurance, gym subscription, 1 month parental leave for the second parent. 
  • Balance: Flexible hours, full remote work possible anywhere in France 🏠
  • Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We have 6 active ERGs including Mental Health, Environmental/Sustainability, Women, Parents, LGBTQIA2S+, and Ethnic Diversity. Each group has at least one executive team member serving as a member of the group, bringing greater awareness to each group’s activities and providing a quick path to impact 🤝
  • Corporate Social Responsibility: Review our CSR Charter: 360learning.com/blog/corporate-social-responsibility-charter 🌎🌏🌍
  • Culture: A framework that will help you make an impact - envision our way of working and our Convexity Culture:https://bit.ly/Convexity_360L & find out more about the teams, product and processes https://bit.ly/42H1ggC 🚀👩🏻‍💻🏆

    • Interview Process:
  • Phone Screen with our Talent Acquisition Manager
  • Discovery Meeting with our Lead Devops Engineer
  • Case Study to do at home and to discuss with a Devops Engineer
  • Clarification Meeting with a Devops Engineer
  • Culture-fit Meeting with our VP Engineering
  • Offer!
    • Who We Are
    360Learning enables companies to upskill from within by turning their experts into champions for employee, customer, and partner growth. With our LMS for collaborative learning, Learning & Development teams can accelerate upskilling with the help of internal experts instead of slow top-down training. 360Learning is the easiest way to onboard and upskill employees, train customer-facing teams, and enable customers and partners–all from one place.

    360Learning powers the future of work at 1,700 organizations. Founded in 2013, 360Learning has raised $240 million with 400+ team members across North America and EMEA.

    Learning Includes Everyone.
    In concert with our culture, 360Learning believes learning includes everyone and that means embracing the strengths of diversity, connectedness, and inclusion. Through conscientious efforts, our global footprint celebrates cultures, perspectives, and experiences from all over the world to support our platform that is built for all regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, veteran status or any other aspect which makes an individual unique or protected by laws and regulations in the locations where we operate. Thus, 360Learning is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace, and we commit to continue this throughout our processes for recruitment, compensation, benefits, performance, promotion, and all other conditions and terms of employment. We want to learn from and with you!

Nous recherchons des commerciaux terrain expérimentés, à l'aise pour se rendre dans une entreprise, engager la conversation avec le propriétaire et convaincre de nouveaux commerçants.

En tant que conseiller commercial itinérant indépendant, vous vendrez les solutions de paiement, de point de vente et logicielles de SumUp aux petites et moyennes entreprises de votre région. Vous identifierez vous-même vos prospects, gérerez votre portefeuille d'opportunités et accompagnerez les clients lors de leur mise en route.

Vous devrez justifier d'une expérience en prospection à froid et apprécier la vente en face à face sur le terrain. Vous gérerez votre propre activité et organiserez vos démarches commerciales de manière autonome, tout en bénéficiant de la formation et du soutien de SumUp.

Vos missions

  • Trouver de nouveaux clients grâce à des visites en face à face, de la prospection en porte-à-porte et des démarches directes.

  • Cibler les entreprises locales générant d'importants volumes de paiement et susceptibles de tirer parti des produits SumUp.

  • Poser des questions sur le fonctionnement de chaque entreprise et recommander des solutions adaptées en matière de paiement, de matériel, de caisse et de logiciels.

  • Gérer le processus de vente depuis le premier échange, en passant par les démonstrations de produits, la gestion des objections et la conclusion, dans le cadre du partenariat.

  • Aider les clients à mettre en place et à commencer à utiliser leurs produits SumUp.

  • Établir des relations avec les chefs d'entreprise et demander des recommandations aux clients satisfaits.

  • Planifier vos visites et vos suivis afin d'optimiser votre temps sur le terrain.

  • Suivre votre activité, vos opportunités et vos résultats de vente, et transmettre les informations nécessaires au traitement des ventes.

  • Échanger avec votre interlocuteur SumUp pour bénéficier de son expertise produit et de conseils commerciaux.

Ce que nous recherchons

Indispensable

  • Au moins un an d'expérience dans la vente sur le terrain dans des secteurs tels que les télécommunications, l'énergie, les technologies d'entreprise, la gestion des déchets, les systèmes de sécurité ou l'approvisionnement en produits alimentaires et boissons.

  • Une expérience de la prospection à froid, notamment en démarchant des entreprises en face à face et en trouvant vos propres prospects.

  • Une expérience de la vente auprès de petites et moyennes entreprises et des relations directes avec les propriétaires ou les décideurs.

  • Des résultats démontrables en matière d'acquisition de nouveaux clients et d'atteinte d'objectifs commerciaux. Nous vous demanderons des exemples de vos réalisations et de la manière dont vous y êtes parvenu.

  • La capacité à gérer un processus de vente de la première prise de contact à la conclusion, y compris la gestion des questions et des objections.

  • Un bon sens de l'organisation et un suivi rigoureux.

  • La capacité à gérer les refus, à tirer les leçons des retours d'expérience et à persévérer.

  • Une bonne compréhension du statut d'indépendant et la volonté de développer votre portefeuille de clients.

  • La capacité à vous déplacer sur votre territoire de vente afin de rencontrer régulièrement vos prospects et clients.

Atouts

  • Un réseau existant de chefs d'entreprise locaux susceptibles de bénéficier des produits SumUp.

  • Une expérience dans le domaine des paiements, des services aux commerçants ou des systèmes de point de vente.

Une expérience de la vente par téléphone est un atout, mais vous devez également avoir vendu en face à face sur le terrain.

Rémunération

Il s'agit d'une activité indépendante, rémunérée exclusivement à la commission, sans salaire de base ni revenu minimum garanti. Les commissions sont déplafonnées et dépendent de vos résultats commerciaux et de l'activité des commerçants apportés.

Le système de commissions comprend, dans le cadre des conditions Partner :

  • Paiements : 50 % du revenu net annualisé lié aux transactions.

  • Matériel : 50 % du prix de vente retenu dans le barème.

  • Logiciels et abonnements : 50 % du montant annuel retenu dans le barème.

  • Revenu résiduel : 20 % du revenu net mensuel généré par les commerçants apportés, pendant une durée maximale de trois ans.

  • Avantage de bienvenue : trois fois le montant habituel des commissions résiduelles pendant les trois premiers mois.

  • Primes supplémentaires liées à certains produits ou opérations commerciales.

Les nouveaux partenaires bénéficient des conditions Partner pendant la période de lancement. Leur maintien est ensuite soumis aux critères d'activité du programme ; un barème Agent de 40 %, sans commissions résiduelles, peut s'appliquer.

Les conditions d'éligibilité, les bases de calcul et les modalités de versement sont précisées dans le contrat et présentées avant tout engagement. Les commissions s'entendent avant déduction de vos frais professionnels, cotisations sociales et impôts applicables.

Formation et accompagnement

Nous vous aiderons à vous familiariser avec les produits et leur commercialisation grâce à un parcours initial et à un accompagnement continu couvrant la prospection, les entretiens de vente, les démonstrations, la gestion des objections et l'accompagnement des clients.

Les modalités du parcours initial et les prérequis à la commercialisation vous seront communiqués avant le démarrage.

Votre interlocuteur SumUp vous apportera également son soutien en matière de développement territorial, d'analyse de vos opportunités et de conseils commerciaux, dans le respect de votre autonomie d'organisation.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

TA FUTURE ÉQUIPE :

L'équipe Product & Engineering, c'est le cerveau technologique de Seyna : elle construit la plateforme qui fait tourner Seyna et ses courtiers, du travail de discovery jusqu'à la mise en production, en sprints de 2 semaines. En tant que Software Product Engineer, tu rejoins l'équipe Tech avec un rôle unique, embarqué au plus près des équipes métier (actuariat, juridique, comptabilité…), en reportant directement à Guillaume, notre CPTO. CE QUE TU FERAS :

  • Immersion métier : Plonger dans l'équipe que tu outilles et pratiquer réellement son métier, pour comprendre de l'intérieur ses processus, ses contraintes réglementaires et ses irritants du quotidien.

  • Discovery & priorisation : Mener la recherche utilisateur (interviews, observation, analyse des process), identifier les problèmes à plus fort impact et piloter seul ton backlog selon la valeur business attendue.

  • Specs & architecture : Traduire les besoins en specs concises et en décisions d'architecture documentées, pour que chaque choix soit tracé et facilement repris par l'équipe Tech.

  • Delivery de bout en bout : Développer, tester et mettre en production toi-même tes solutions, avec un vrai niveau de qualité production (code review, tests, monitoring, documentation). Livrer vite, sans créer de dette !

  • L'IA au cœur du build : Utiliser les agents de code (Claude Code…) comme levier de vélocité, et intégrer l'IA directement dans les outils que tu construis : automatisation, extraction, génération, agents métier.

  • Mesure & itération : Définir des critères de succès avec le métier, mesurer l'adoption et l'impact de tes outils, et itérer rapidement à partir des données et des retours utilisateurs.

  • Alignement & diffusion : Réutiliser les briques existantes de la plateforme Seyna avec les équipes Product & Engineering, faire remonter ce qui mérite d'être industrialisé et partager tes méthodes de build augmenté par l'IA pour faire monter toute l'organisation en niveau.

TU ES AU BON ENDROIT SI :

  • Tu maîtrises le développement full-stack en TypeScript (React, Node.js) sur AWS et GitHub, et tu livres du code de qualité production.

  • Tu as une vraie rigueur d'ingénierie : architecture réfléchie, tests, code review, monitoring et documentation font partie de ton ADN.

  • Tu es AI-native : les agents de code font partie de ton quotidien, et tu sais intégrer l'IA dans des produits utiles.

  • Tu sais mener une discovery : interviewer, observer, et formuler clairement le vrai problème avant d'écrire la moindre ligne de code.

  • Tu apprends vite et tu adores plonger dans un métier qui n'est pas le tien.

  • Tu es orienté(e) impact : tu mesures ce que tu livres et tu t'appuies sur la data pour décider de la suite.

  • Tu aimes résoudre des problèmes complexes et tu sais embarquer des profils tech comme non-tech, sans autorité hiérarchique.

  • ✨ Bonus si tu as déjà rédigé des specs et arbitré un backlog dans un rôle de Product Manager.

CE QUE SEYNA TE PROPOSE :

💵 Rémunération: Un package compétitif avec des BSPCE pour que vous puissiez partager le succès à mesure que nous grandissons.

🏖 Congés payés: 7 à 10 jours de RTT (selon le nombre de jours ouvrés dans l'année) en plus de vos 28 jours de congés payés.

🍜 Ticket restaurant: Une carte ticket restaurant Benefiz prise en charge à 60% par Seyna (10€/jour).

🚇 Transport en commun: 50% de votre moyen de transport préféré (Navigo, vélo, train) pris en charge par Seyna.

🚑 Assurance santé: Mutuelle Generali prise en charge à 95% par Seyna

🏄 Événements d'équipe: Un séminaire annuel pour profiter de moments tous ensemble.

🧡 Une équipe positive avec qui travailler au quotidien et une opportunité excitante de rejoindre une insurtech à forte ambition (FT120) !

NOTRE PROCESSUS DE RECRUTEMENT :

En moyenne, notre processus de recrutement dure 2 à 3 semaines ! Voici plus de détail ci-dessous :

  • Un 1er échange avec Gianni (Talent Acquisition Manager) - 45' → Tu pourras mieux comprendre le rôle, les missions et ce qu'on attend pour ce poste.

  • Un Hiring Manager Interview avec Guillaume (CPTO) - 45' → Cela te permettra d'entrer dans le détail du poste : les missions au quotidien, les défis et les attentes liées au rôle.

  • Un Skills-based Assessment avec Kseniia (Engineering Manager) et Maxime (Senior Staff Engineer) - 60' → Le case te donne l'occasion de montrer concrètement tes compétences et ton savoir-faire en lien avec le job.

  • Un Seynalma Interview avec Charlotte (Client Performance Director) et Anne-Céline (Senior CSM) - 2x45' → Cela te permettra de voir si notre culture d'entreprise colle avec tes valeurs et ta façon de travailler.

  • Un Final Interview avec Stephen (CEO) - 30' → C'est le moment d'échanger avec notre CEO et de voir si tes drivers matchent avec nos 3 Unique Selling Propositions pour les Talents !

Compensation: €75K – €90K • Offers Equity

data.title: Psychotherapeut:in (a) - Digital Health/Basel (40-100%)
data.description:
Standort: Hybrid (Stadt Basel & Home Office)
Anstellung: Festanstellung mit viel Freiheiten und Selbstbestimmung

Pensum: 40-100%
Start: Ab sofort oder nach Vereinbarung

 

Du willst nicht einfach nur behandeln, sondern etwas bewegen?
Dann bist Du bei Oviva genau richtig.

 

Warum Oviva?

 

Bei Oviva verfolgen wir eine klare Mission: Wir wollen nachhaltige, personalisierte, klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich machen.

Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen mit gewichtsbedingten Erkrankungen. Für viele ist Gewichtsverlust ein Ziel, doch unser Ansatz geht weit darüber hinaus: Wir helfen, die Gesundheit zu verbessern, Selbstvertrauen aufzubauen und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Wir haben bereits über eine Million Menschen in Grossbritannien, der Schweiz, Deutschland und Polen unterstützt – und wir stehen erst am Anfang. Jedes Gespräch und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte diese Zukunft aktiv mit.

 

Die Stelle

 

Ein breites therapeutisches Spektrum mit Tiefgang

 

Menschen mit Adipositas sind vielfältig – ebenso wie ihre Geschichten. Viele unserer Patient*innen leiden zusätzlich unter psychischen oder neu divergenten Herausforderungen wie ADHS, Autismus-Spektrum-Themen, Burnout, Depression, Angststörungen oder Binge-Eating-Störungen.
Unser Ziel ist es, diesen Menschen eine ganzheitliche, respektvolle und wirksame therapeutische Begleitung zu bieten – jenseits von Stigmatisierung und oberflächlichen Ansätzen.

 

Bei Oviva greifen wir Themen auf, die viele unserer Patient*innen beschäftigen – wie Selbstbild, hormonelle Veränderungen, Elternschaft, Belastung im Alltag oder emotionale Essmuster. In der Psychotherapie bei Oviva dürfen all diese Themen ihren Platz haben.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du führst Psychotherapien in unserer Praxis und online via Video-Sessions durch.

  • Du arbeitest interdisziplinär mit Ernährungsberaterinnen & Ärztinnen zusammen.

  • Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie moderne, digitale Psychotherapie bei Oviva aussieht.

  • Du bringst Deine Expertise ein, um Versorgung neu zu denken und echte Wirkung zu erzielen.

  • Du bringst aktiv Ideen und Vorschläge mit, wie wir als Team uns weiterentwickeln können.

Dein Profil

  • eidg. anerkannte Psychotherapeut/in

  • Abgeschlossenes klinisches Jahr in einer Institution der SIWF Kategorie A, B oder C

  • Drei Jahr klinische Erfahrung

  • Leidenschaft für digitale, patientenzentrierte Versorgung

  • Offenheit, Neues zu gestalten – und Altes zu hinterfragen

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit


Was Dich bei Oviva erwartet

  • Wirkung mit Sinn: Du wirst Teil eines engagierten Teams, das die Gesundheitsversorgung für Menschen mit Adipositas und Typ-2-Diabetes revolutioniert.

  • Dynamische Kultur: Ein Umfeld, in dem Zusammenarbeit, Kreativität und Veränderung gefördert werden.

  • Attraktive Benefits: Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt, flexible Arbeitsmodelle und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

 

Wir freuen uns über Deine Bewerbung. Weitere Informationen findest Du auf unserer Homepage: https://oviva.com/ch/de/psychotherapie/.

 

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:
Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

 

Oviva engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Wir begrüßen und ermutigen Bewerber*innen mit allen Hintergründen und Identitäten einschließlich, aber nicht beschränkt auf Nationalität, ethnische Zugehörigkeit, Geschlecht, sexuelle Orientierung, Alter, Fähigkeiten, Religion und sozioökonomischen Status. Wir suchen aktiv nach Kandidat*innen, die eine einzigartige Perspektive mitbringen, um uns beim Aufbau eines stärkeren, inklusiven Teams zu helfen.

 

Oviva engagiert sich für die Unterstützung von Kandidat*innen und Mitarbeiter*innen mit Behinderungen

 

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

data.description:
Bei Oviva und Ovivamed Clinic verfolgen wir die Mission, nachhaltige, personalisierte und klinisch wirksame Versorgung für alle zugänglich zu machen, während wir Europas führende KI-gestützte Plattform für die Behandlung chronischer Krankheiten aufbauen. Unsere digitalen Programme unterstützen Menschen dabei, gewichtsbedingte Erkrankungen in den Griff zu bekommen. Dabei konzentrieren wir uns auf das, was am wichtigsten ist: die Gesundheit zu verbessern, das Selbstvertrauen zu stärken und die Lebensqualität zu steigern.

Bis heute haben wir über eine Million Menschen in Großbritannien, der Schweiz und Deutschland unterstützt. Hinter unserer Mission steht ein engagiertes Team, das in vier Ländern tätig ist, einschließlich unseres Hubs in Polen. Jedes Gespräch, jede Coaching-Session und jede Zeile Code bringt uns einer gesünderen Zukunft näher.

Komm zu uns und werde Teil des Teams, das diese Zukunft möglich macht!

Die Rolle

Als Facharzt/Fachärztin für Endokrinologie und Diabetologie bei Ovivamed spielst du eine zentrale Rolle in der Betreuung von Patient:innen mit Adipositas und Diabetes Typ 2. Du trägst zur Entwicklung evidenzbasierter, digital unterstützter Behandlungspfade bei und arbeitest eng mit einem interdisziplinären Team aus Ärzt:innen, Ernährungsberater:innen, Psycholog:innen und Bewegungstherapeut:innen zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Durchführung endokrinologischer Sprechstunden mit Fokus auf Adipositas und metabolische Erkrankungen

  • Langfristige Betreuung von Patient:innen mit Typ-2-Diabetes inklusive medikamentöser Einstellung

  • Kollegiale Mitbetreuung innerhalb des ärztlichen Netzwerks sowie Zusammenarbeit mit externen Spezialist:innen

  • Aktive Beteiligung an interdisziplinären Fallbesprechungen und Fortbildungen

  • Beurteilung von bariatrischen Eingriffen in enger Abstimmung mit dem Team

  • Nutzung und Mitgestaltung digitaler Tools und Qualitätsstandards im klinischen Alltag

Dein Profil

  • Facharztanerkennung in Endokrinologie und Diabetologie (FMH)

  • Erfahrung mit Adipositastherapie und metabolischen Erkrankungen

  • Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit und evidenzbasierter Versorgung

  • Interesse an der Arbeit mit digitalen Tools & Plattformen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mindestens C1), weitere Sprachen von Vorteil

  • Idealerweise Berufsausübungsbewilligung in Zürich, Bern oder Basel

Was Ovivamed Dir bietet

  • Pionierarbeit in der Digitalisierung der medizinischen Arbeit: Arbeite in einem hochspezialisierten Team, das sich der Verbesserung der Lebensqualität von Menschen mit Adipositas verschrieben hat.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Hybride oder Remote Tätigkeit: Nutze die Möglichkeit, dir deinen Alltag flexibel einzuteilen und hybrid zu arbeiten, was eine ausgewogene Work-Life-Balance fördert.

  • Innovative Unternehmenskultur: Werde Teil eines der führenden Digital Health Unternehmens von Europa.

  • Attraktive Anstellungsbedingungen: Profitiere von konkurrenzfähigen Gehältern und fortschrittlichen Konditionen bei der Pensionskasse, wie die Übernahme von 60% der Beiträge durch Ovivamed.

Es ist uns sehr wichtig, eine Kultur zu haben, in der die Menschen gerne arbeiten wollen. Dies erreichen wir, indem wir unsere Werte bei allem, was wir tun, in den Vordergrund stellen:

Patient*innen stehen bei uns an erster Stelle, Wir befähigen unsere Teams, Wir machen es möglich

Ovivamed engagiert sich leidenschaftlich dafür eine inklusive Kultur zu schaffen, die die unterschiedlichen Stimmen unserer Mitarbeiter*innen ermutigt, unterstützt und feiert. Wir sind ein wirklich inklusiver Arbeitsplatz, an dem man man selbst sein kann und alle willkommen sind.

Bereit, etwas zu bewirken? Begleite uns bei der Transformation der digitalen Gesundheitsversorgung. Bewirb Dich noch heute!

data.title: DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Join our mission

We're proud to work with many incredible companies, accelerating their ability to build their products.

We've spent years watching talented engineering teams lose momentum to the same frustrating bottleneck: waiting. Waiting for CI to finish. Waiting for builds to complete. Waiting for tests to run.

After experiencing this pain firsthand at companies of every size, we set out to build the developer infrastructure platform we'd always wanted to use. Something that would seamlessly integrate with our workflows and the tools teams already love—but make everything dramatically faster and more cost-effective.

Today, we're already accelerating hundreds of companies around the world, helping them ship features instead of waiting for infrastructure. We've built something that feels almost magical in its simplicity: change your runs-on line, mount your toolchain cache directory and suddenly your builds are 5x faster.

About the role

Namespace's approach is low-friction, designed for immediate integration into existing developer toolchains, empowering teams to experience tangible results within just five minutes. With an end-to-end stack optimized for high performance—including compute, memory, storage, and networking—Namespace delivers capabilities and efficiencies unmatched by traditional cloud providers.

As a DevOps Engineer at Namespace, you'll build and operate the infrastructure that makes this performance possible. You'll own the compute, storage, and networking behind every build our customers run, keeping the platform fast, reliable, and cost-effective as we accelerate more companies around the world.

Our culture

We're looking for people with grit—people who push through ambiguity, take ownership, and keep going when things get hard. You're deeply curious, driven to understand how things work and how they can be improved. Most importantly, you have a strong bias to execution: you don't wait for perfect conditions, you ship, learn, and iterate quickly. If you care about building, moving fast, and making real impact, you'll fit right in.

What you'll do

  • Own the reliability, performance, and scalability of the infrastructure that runs every customer’s build, test, and CI job on Namespace.

  • Optimize performance across compute, memory, storage, and networking.

  • Automate provisioning, deployment, scaling, and recovery across our fleet.

  • Build observability, alerting, and incident response processes that identify and resolve issues before they affect customers.

  • Drive capacity planning and cost efficiency, so we continue to deliver infrastructure that is both faster and more cost-effective.

  • Collaborate closely with product engineers to ship new capabilities quickly and safely.

What we're looking for

  • Strong engineering fundamentals and hands-on experience operating production infrastructure at scale.

  • Deep knowledge of Linux, networking, and storage, plus experience with tools like Kubernetes, Terraform, or similar.

  • Proficiency in Go, Python, or a similar language, automation is paramount.

  • Deep experience with observability tooling and participating in on-call rotations.

  • A strong focus on performance and a rigorous approach to measuring and improving it.

  • Bonus: experience with bare metal, virtualization (KVM, Firecracker), or running CI/CD systems at scale.

You can expect:

  • Competitive salary and stock options

  • Flexible working hours

  • Market-leading parental leave

Life at Namespace Labs:

  • We pride ourselves in being a small team of experts that can achieve a lot.

  • We balance our long-term vision with short-term pragmatism.

  • We believe in being fully transparent internally on how decisions are made, on how the company is doing, and we use that information to drive our decisions.

data.title: Représentant(e) commercial(e) - Genève
data.description:
Salonkee est l'une des entreprises beauty-tech à la croissance la plus rapide en Europe. Nous aidons des milliers de salons à simplifier leurs opérations quotidiennes et à offrir une expérience client hors du commun.

Notre logiciel tout-en-un simplifie la prise de rendez-vous, les paiements et la gestion client, permettant ainsi aux professionnels de se concentrer sur l'essentiel : délivrer une prestation exceptionnelle. Nous sommes fiers de façonner l'avenir de l'industrie de la beauté grâce à l'innovation, la collaboration et une approche résolument humaine.

L'opportunité

Rejoins notre équipe en tant que représentant(e) commercial(e) et deviens l'un des visages de la révolution digitale du secteur. Chez Salonkee, tu as l'opportunité unique de piloter des projets ambitieux, de collaborer avec des experts passionnés et de marquer de ton empreinte l'expansion d'une scale-up en plein essor.

Tes missions

  • Maîtrise du cycle de vente (A à Z) : tu pilotes l'intégralité du parcours d'acquisition de nouveaux clients pour Salonkee. Cela inclut la chasse initiale, la prise de rendez-vous qualifiés, la réalisation de démonstrations percutantes et le closing des contrats.

  • Ambassadeur(rice) de terrain : tu mènes des présentations produits directement sur site pour démontrer, avec clarté et conviction, la valeur ajoutée de nos solutions pour le business de tes clients.

  • Conseil stratégique & optimisation : tu accompagnes tes prospects avec expertise en leur proposant des solutions digitales sur mesure pour optimiser leurs processus et libérer tout leur potentiel de croissance.

  • Stratégie multicanale : tu utilises différents canaux de communication pour approcher les clients potentiels et développer des relations de confiance durables.

  • Accompagnement & formation : tu assures la formation de tes nouveaux clients pour garantir une adoption parfaite de l'outil et un succès immédiat dès le premier jour d'utilisation.

Ton profil

  • Expérience sales : pas besoin d'un CV parfait; ce qu'on cherche avant tout, c'est quelqu'un avec la fibre commerciale et le drive pour aller chercher le client. Une première expérience en vente terrain B2B ou en prospection téléphone/physique est un vrai atout: tu sais ce que c'est que d'aller chercher le client là où il est

  • Tempérament chasseur : tu as le goût du challenge, une résilience à toute épreuve et une appétence naturelle pour la prospection active

  • Autonomie & organisation : véritable self-starter, tu planifies tes journées de façon stratégique et trouves les meilleurs leviers pour établir Salonkee dans ton secteur

  • Excellent relationnel : tu sais instaurer une confiance immédiate et créer un lien fort avec des entrepreneurs indépendants

  • Digital native : tu es à l'aise avec les outils SaaS et les environnements tech: la maîtrise d'un CRM est un vrai plus.

  • Mobilité : le permis B est indispensable. Tu gères en totale autonomie la région de Genève.

  • Langues : français natif. Un anglais professionnel est apprécié pour collaborer avec nos équipes internationales.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Véhicule de fonction + carte essence

  • Organisation autonome. Tu gères ton agenda dans un cadre de confiance

  • Un parcours d'intégration structuré : formation produit, accompagnement terrain avec ton manager les premières semaines, et accès à l'expérience de nos équipes déjà en place dans 6 autres pays

  • Un accès direct au leadership et une vraie capacité d'influence sur la stratégie commerciale dès tes premiers mois

  • L'opportunité de participer à une success story et d'avoir un impact tangible sur l'avenir du secteur de la beauté et du bien-être

  • Des événements d'entreprise réguliers pour renforcer la cohésion d'équipe et créer des opportunités de networking et de collaboration

Chez Salonkee, nous sommes convaincus que l'innovation s'épanouit dans un environnement où chacun se sent inclus et valorisé. Nous bâtissons une équipe diversifiée à l'image de l'industrie que nous servons : créative, passionnée et riche de perspectives variées. Peu importe qui tu es ou d'où tu viens, tu trouveras ici ta place pour grandir, contribuer et être toi-même.

Salonkee promeut l'égalité des chances et la diversité. Nous accueillons toutes les candidatures, indépendamment du genre, de l'origine, de l'âge, du handicap ou de l'identité.

data.title: Embedded Engineer
data.description:
Accelerating embodied AGI.

The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.

MicroAGI is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.

We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.

Our models learn from data captured in the physical world, by hardware we design and build ourselves. As Embedded Engineer, you will own the firmware that runs on that hardware, from the first register write to the moment data leaves the device, so that what reaches our ML team is clean, synchronized, and trustworthy.

What You Will Do

  • Write and own the firmware for our data-capture hardware: sensors, motion-capture rigs, custom IoT setups, and prototype robots.

  • Build real-time data acquisition: drivers, DMA, buffering, and streaming from many sensors at once without dropping a sample.

  • Solve multi-sensor synchronization, calibration, and time-stamping so every data point lines up across devices and modalities.

  • Bring up new boards with our Electrical Engineer and turn fresh hardware into working devices fast.

  • Build the path from device to dataset: communication protocols, on-device logging, and handoff into our data pipeline.

  • Work shoulder to shoulder with ML engineers. Your firmware decides what their training data looks like, and a timing bug can quietly ruin months of data.

  • Make firmware reliable in the field: testing, OTA updates, error handling, and diagnostics that tell us what went wrong.

Requirements

  • Up to 5 years writing production firmware for embedded or IoT systems.

  • Strong C/C++, experience with an RTOS (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, or similar), and deep familiarity with microcontrollers (STM32, ESP32, NXP, or similar).

  • Hands-on experience with peripheral interfaces and protocols: SPI, I2C, UART, USB, BLE, CAN, or similar.

  • Experience integrating sensors in firmware: IMUs, cameras, depth sensors, force sensors, or similar.

  • A strong understanding of how firmware decisions affect data quality, especially for EMG/EEG sensing: ADC configuration, sample rate, jitter, filtering, and buffering. You know that a great model on a noisy signal still loses to a decent model on a clean one, and you write code accordingly.

  • Comfortable debugging at the hardware boundary with a logic analyzer, oscilloscope, and debugger.

  • Genuinely curious about ML: you read papers, you have trained at least one model end to end, and you understand that dataset quality beats model architecture choice.

  • High agency: you don't wait to be told what to do. You are comfortable in 0-to-1 ambiguity, where the spec is "figure out what the spec should be".

  • Discreet: you handle confidential hardware roadmaps and customer data with care.

  • Fluent in English. German is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • A background in robotics, motion capture, or wearable devices.

  • Experience with real-time or hard-deadline systems: audio, video sync, or robotic control loops.

  • Experience with embedded Linux, time-sync protocols (PTP or similar), or low-power design.

  • Familiarity with ML training pipelines. Even if you don't run them, you can read a training script.

  • Open-source firmware contributions.

  • Experience taking firmware from prototype to small-batch production: test fixtures, provisioning, and certification support.

Who Will Thrive at MicroAGI

Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:

  • Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.

  • Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.

  • Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.

  • Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.

This is for you if:

  • You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.

  • You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.

  • You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

This is not for you if:

  • You are looking for a predictable 9-to-5.

  • You would forward output you cannot explain.

  • "That’s not my job" feels like a reasonable answer.

How We Hire

We read every application and reply within five working days.

  1. Talent Screen (30 min): a first conversation, both ways.

  2. Technical or Functional Interview (60 min): how you think when the problem changes.

  3. Your Work (60 min): bring something you are proud of and walk us through it.

  4. Leadership (30 min): a conversation with our CEO.

  5. Coworking Day (engineering and research roles): a day building with the team on a real problem.

Then a decision, usually within a few days.

Pay Transparency

Compensation includes base salary and equity. The salary range for this role is shown on this posting.

What We Offer

  • Agency: real ownership from day one, and decisions that actually matter.

  • Freedom: to choose how you solve the problem, without layers of approval.

  • A seat on a rocketship: one of Europe’s fastest-growing deep-tech companies, at the earliest stage.

  • Free food and drinks in the office.

Equal Opportunity

MicroAGI welcomes applications from everyone. We assess candidates on their work and potential, regardless of ethnic origin, gender, religion or belief, disability, age, or sexual identity.
