data.title: Data Scientist
data.description:
KAYAK, part of Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG), is the world's leading travel search engine. With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

As an employee of KAYAK, you will be part of a travel company that operates a portfolio of global metasearch brands including momondo, Cheapflights and HotelsCombined, among others. From start-up to industry leader, innovation is at our core and every employee has an opportunity to make their mark. Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

KAYAK is looking for a mid-level Data Scientist to build recommendation systems that improve how travelers discover and choose travel options.

You’ll translate product and business questions into measurable modeling problems, develop and test solutions with data and experimentation, and partner with researchers, engineers, and cross-functional teams to bring promising work into production. Your work will improve the traveler experience and key business metrics across KAYAK.

If you’re excited to solve challenging recommendation problems and make a measurable difference for travelers, we’d love to hear from you.

This role will be required to work from our Zurich office 3 days per week.

In this role, you will:

  • Translate product and business challenges into well-defined modeling problems, hypotheses, and measurable objectives.

  • Ship production-ready, scalable Machine Learning solutions with real-world impact on user experience and key business metrics.

  • Design and evaluate experiments, building rapid prototypes, assessing results rigorously, and iterating on promising ideas.

  • Collaborate across Data Science, Product, and Engineering, communicating findings, recommendations, and trade-offs clearly and concisely to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Please apply if you have:

  • Strong technical foundations in statistics, machine learning, and programming, backed by a track record of solving complex, real-world data science problems. Demonstrated capability matters more than academic credentials.

  • Hands-on experience developing ML models in business or production environments, with the ability to clearly explain the problems addressed, your specific contributions, and the resulting impact.

  • Ownership, sound judgment, and analytical thinking, with the ability to navigate technical trade-offs, work independently, and recognize when to seek guidance.

  • Fluency with AI-assisted workflows, leveraging modern tools to improve productivity and quality while critically evaluating their outputs and limitations.

  • Curiosity, humility, and a collaborative mindset, with a commitment to continuous learning, sharing knowledge, and improving together.

Bonus qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with technologies relevant to KAYAK’s stack, such as PyTorch, Polars, CometML, Arize, Docker, Airflow, Trino and Git/Github.

  • Familiarity with Agile ways of working, such as sprint planning and team ceremonies.

Benefits & Perks

  • Work from (almost) anywhere for up to 20 days per year

  • Focus on mental health and well-being:

    • Company-paid therapy sessions through SpringHealth

    • Company-paid subscription to HeadSpace

    • Company-wide week off a year - the whole team fully recharges (and returns without a pile-up of work!)

  • No meeting Fridays

  • Paid parental leave

  • Paid volunteer time

  • Focus on your career growth:

    • Development Dollars

    • Leadership development

    • Access to thousands of on-demand e-learnings

  • Travel Discounts

  • Employee Resource Groups

  • 5 weeks paid vacation + a day off for your birthday

  • Social events & Thursday happy hours

  • Free lunch 2 days per week

  • Pension plan contributions

  • Supplemental accident insurance

  • Health insurance subsidy of 250 CHF per month

  • Lunch Check Card of 180 CHF per month

  • Profawo membership which is a non-profit organization dedicated to promoting the compatibility of family and work

 

Inclusion

At KAYAK, we want everyone to have the space to grow, share ideas and do great work. That’s why we’re focused on hiring the best talent from all walks of life and experiences, supporting them well and making sure no one feels like they have to fit a mold to belong here.

Need any adjustments for the interview, application or on the job? No problem - just give us a heads-up. We’ve got you.

Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.

Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Design Release Manager to join our Airframe Team in Lausanne. In this role, you will bridge the gap between initial mechanical concept and full-scale manufacturing, taking complete ownership of the manufacturing dossier for our composite structures and airframe modules.

From day one, you will drive Design for Manufacturability and Design for Assembly directly inside the design loop, before parts are frozen. You will set and hold the release standard, define geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, manage engineering change orders, and act as the single authority signing off on product transfer gates to manufacturing.

What You Will Do

  • Manufacturing Dossier Ownership: Own and maintain the complete transfer package for your designated airframe module, including controlled drawing packages, bill of materials structures, material and finish specifications, critical characteristics, and acceptance criteria.

  • Design Loop Integration: Collaborate directly with mechanical design engineers early in the design phase to optimize composite layups, bonded joints, tooling interfaces, and tolerance stack-ups while design changes are still fast and low cost.

  • Transfer Gate & Release Authority: Serve as the final authority on product release packages, evaluating transfer readiness against gate standards before handing hardware over to manufacturing operations.

  • Disposition & Configuration Management: Manage engineering change orders and serve as the single technical contact for drawing dispositions, non-conformance reviews, and design clarification requests from the production line.

  • Supplier & Manufacturing Alignment: Work closely with production operations and external suppliers to evaluate manufacturing constraints for composite structures and precision assemblies.

  • Feedback & Continuous Improvement: Analyze initial production build data and floor feedback to refine manufacturing dossiers and update gate standards for future design iterations.

What We Are Looking For

  • Background: B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline.

  • Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerance Analysis: Practical mastery of applying GD&T with intent, performing tolerance stack-up analyses, and defining clear acceptance criteria.

  • Composite Structures & Manufacturing: Strong working knowledge of composite materials, layup sequences, tooling limitations, cure cycles, and bonded structural joints.

  • Drawing & Package Control: Proven experience owning released drawing packages, managing structured bill of materials, and running engineering change order workflows.

  • Early Stage Execution: Demonstrated success integrating manufacturing and assembly principles directly into active design reviews rather than conducting post-design audits.

  • Language Skills: Professional proficiency in both English and French to work fluidly across design engineering and French-speaking production teams.

What We Offer

  • Direct ownership in defining the release and manufacturing transfer standards for high-performance defense airframes.

  • Active collaboration with design engineers early in the development cycle where engineering decisions carry high leverage.

  • High-visibility technical impact across fast-scaling, hardware-centric production programs.

We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

data.title: Characterization Lead
data.description:
At Kandou, we are redeﬁning the economics of AI infrastructure. Our mission is to democratise AI by signiﬁcantly reducing the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) of hardware systems — a critical barrier to scalable adoption.

Our proprietary MIMO-over-copper technology powers a high-performance, chiplet-based AI memory fabric that is both scalable and energy-efficient. Unlike traditional interconnects, our solution reduces power consumption signiﬁcantly while preserving high bandwidth and ultra-low latency — unlocking unprecedented efficiency for AI training and inference at scale.

As Characterization Lead, you will own performance characterization of Zinal retimer silicon and the Randa Active Electrical Cable (AEC) channel. This is a Principal / Senior Staff individual contributor role with hands-on technical leadership. Your measurements will establish datasheet limits, channel classes and guard-bands for validation, manufacturing and customer specifications. Based primarily in Lausanne, you will work with silicon, signal integrity and validation teams, including channel characterization partners in Taiwan.

Responsabilities

· Lead silicon and channel characterization from measurement planning and bench setup through analysis, limit derivation and documented hand-off to validation.

· Characterize TX/RX SerDes performance across process, voltage and temperature: swing, jitter, sensitivity, equalization, adaptation, CDR lock, BER bathtubs and shmoos.

· Own channel measurements to at least 50 GHz, including de-embedding, insertion/return loss, mixed-mode S-parameters and common-mode and mode-conversion behavior.

· Establish reference-paddle baselines and channel classes by gauge, reach and frequency; correlate HTDR-derived metrics with calibrated VNA measurements.

· Derive datasheet limits and guard-bands from measured distributions, accounting for uncertainty, sample coverage and aging; maintain traceable datasets and limit revisions.

· Assess carrier-loading and forwarded-clock tradeoffs using measured channel data and simulation, and translate the findings into supported configurations and characterization limits.

· Characterize power, energy per bit and thermal behavior across operating modes and corners; investigate equalizer noise amplification and channel/thermal interactions.

· Coordinate shared laboratory equipment and characterization milestones with validation teams; lead technical reviews and deliver limits in time for downstream qualification and screening.

Essential Experience

· 10 to 14 years of experience in SerDes/silicon characterization and/or high-speed channel and signal integrity characterization following degree completion.

· Direct ownership of a characterization program whose results became datasheet limits or qualification thresholds for a shipping product.

· Strong VNA measurement experience to 50 GHz or beyond, including de-embedding, mixed-mode S-parameters (Sdd/Scc/Scd/Sdc) and insertion/return-loss mask interpretation.

· Hands-on TX/RX SerDes characterization, jitter decomposition, BER bathtubs, PVT shmoos and equalization/adaptation analysis.

· Demonstrated common-mode and mode-conversion measurement depth, with the ability to distinguish channel behavior from fixture and calibration artifacts.

· Statistical characterization and guard-band derivation across corners, with clear treatment of measurement uncertainty, sample size and aging.

· Experience with VNAs, oscilloscopes of at least 50 GHz bandwidth, BERTs, jitter instrumentation, thermal forcing and ATE characterization load boards.

· BS in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with the technical communication and coordination skills to hand off defensible limits to validation and manufacturing teams.

Essential Experience

· Characterization leadership for shipping 100G/lane or 200G/lane retimers, PHYs, AECs or AOCs.

· Deep mixed-mode characterization where common-mode behavior affects information transport and link margin.

· Experience producing datasheet limits that a separate validation team independently qualified.

· Multi-carrier or proprietary coding schemes, including OFDM-style subcarriers and space-time coding, and their characterization implications.

· Published work or patents in channel modeling, de-embedding or SerDes characterization.

· MS or PhD with a concentration in communications, RF/microwave engineering or signal integrity.

If this is the role you have been looking for and you want to be part of a growing Company, with an exciting future then we would love to hear from you. Together We Kandou It!!

data.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
data.description:
About Rivia

Rivia is a data engine for clinical trial intelligence. It provides data infrastructure and AI-driven workflows for clinical trial teams, enabling biotechs to run studies more efficiently and to demonstrate which patients derive the greatest benefit from new therapies. Biopharma companies are the source of most therapeutic innovation, yet clinical development is frequently slowed by fragmented data and outdated tooling. Rivia delivers a real-time, integrated view across clinical trial data, improving both trial execution and the evaluation of new treatments.

 

Our goal is for Rivia to become the new standard infrastructure for modern drug development, bringing new therapies to market more successfully at a fraction of the cost.

 

We seek highly driven, motivated and talented professionals to contribute to our growing startup.

 

About Rivia's Sales Team

Our Sales team is at the forefront of Rivia's growth, bringing innovative clinical trial technology to biotech and pharmaceutical companies across Europe and the US.

We operate in a complex, high-value B2B environment, where understanding customers, building trust, and creating meaningful relationships are essential to success.

As we scale, we're building a high-performing commercial organization that combines ambition, strategic thinking, and relentless execution.

The Role

As a Business Development Representative at Rivia, you will be a driving force behind our growth, identifying, engaging, and creating opportunities with biotech and pharmaceutical companies across Europe.

This is not a role where you'll simply follow a predefined playbook. You'll help build and continuously improve our outbound engine, experimenting with new approaches, identifying untapped opportunities, and finding creative ways to connect with the right decision-makers.

You'll own your prospecting activities from initial research and outreach through qualification and handover to our Account Executives. You'll develop a deep understanding of the clinical trials industry, our customers' challenges, and how Rivia can create meaningful value for their organizations.

We're looking for someone who is ambitious, commercially sharp, and relentless in pursuing results. Someone who moves fast, takes ownership, learns quickly, and isn't discouraged by rejection. You'll need to be comfortable navigating complex organizations, engaging senior stakeholders, and finding ways to open doors that others can't.

You'll work closely with our Account Executives and commercial leadership, contributing directly to our pipeline generation strategy and the evolution of our go-to-market approach.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build, experiment, exceed ambitious targets, and have a direct impact on the growth of a Series A startup, we'd love to meet you.

Working Model: This role is based on-site in our Zürich office.

What Excites You

  • Building something from the ground up. You enjoy creating and improving outbound strategies rather than simply executing an established playbook.

  • The challenge of opening doors, engaging hard-to-reach decision-makers, and turning cold prospects into meaningful business opportunities.

  • Working in a fast-paced, high-performance environment where ambitious targets, ownership, and measurable results drive your success.

  • Understanding complex industries, learning about customers' challenges, and connecting innovative technology to real business needs.

  • Experimenting with different prospecting approaches, messaging, and channels to discover what works and continuously improve results.

  • Working closely with Account Executives and commercial leadership, contributing ideas and challenging assumptions to improve our go-to-market strategy.

  • Being part of an ambitious startup where your individual contributions directly influence company growth and commercial success.

  • Taking ownership of your results, pushing through challenges, and continuously raising the bar for yourself and the team.

Responsibilities

Outbound Prospecting & Pipeline Generation

  • Own outbound prospecting activities, identifying and engaging potential customers across biotech and pharmaceutical companies in Europe.

  • Build and execute targeted, multichannel outbound campaigns through email, LinkedIn, cold calling, and other creative approaches.

  • Research target accounts, map key stakeholders, and identify relevant decision-makers and influencers within complex organizations.

  • Generate and qualify high-quality sales opportunities, ensuring a consistent pipeline of relevant prospects for our Account Executives.

  • Develop personalized outreach strategies that connect Rivia's value proposition to prospects' business challenges and priorities.

  • Take accountability for individual activity, meeting, and qualified pipeline generation targets.

Commercial Strategy & Market Intelligence

  • Contribute to building, testing, and optimizing our outbound strategy, identifying new segments, opportunities, and approaches to improve pipeline generation.

  • Collaborate with Account Executives to define target accounts, qualification criteria, and effective handover processes.

  • Develop a strong understanding of the clinical trials landscape, including biotech business models, clinical development challenges, and industry trends.

  • Gather insights from prospect conversations to identify market opportunities, refine messaging, and strengthen our commercial positioning.

  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Product teams to improve campaigns, customer understanding, and go-to-market effectiveness.

Execution & Continuous Improvement

  • Own and maintain accurate prospecting data, activities, and pipeline information in our CRM.

  • Track and analyze prospecting performance, including outreach effectiveness, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.

  • Continuously experiment with new messaging, tools, and outreach strategies to improve results and increase efficiency.

  • Proactively identify bottlenecks, challenge ineffective approaches, and implement improvements.

  • Contribute to building a high-performance sales culture based on ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and accountability.

What Excites Us

  • At least 2 years of experience in B2B outbound sales, business development, or sales development, ideally in a SaaS or technology-driven environment.

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving or exceeding prospecting, meeting generation, or qualified pipeline targets.

  • Strong outbound prospecting skills, with experience using cold calling, personalized email outreach, LinkedIn, and other channels to generate opportunities.

  • A relentless, results-oriented mindset, with the resilience to navigate rejection, persistence to pursue opportunities, and drive to exceed ambitious goals.

  • Strong commercial judgment and curiosity, with the ability to understand business challenges and translate them into relevant sales conversations.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, including the confidence to engage senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

  • A proactive, independent, and resourceful approach to problem-solving, with the ability to take initiative and deliver results without constant direction.

  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage a high volume of outreach while maintaining quality and personalization.

  • A data-driven mindset, with the ability to analyze performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and adapt strategies quickly.

  • Experience working with CRM systems and modern sales prospecting tools.

  • A genuine interest in innovative technology, biotech, and the opportunity to make an impact on how clinical trials are conducted.

  • Professional fluency in English.

Bonus Points

  • Experience selling into biotech, pharmaceutical, healthcare, or life sciences organizations.

  • An existing understanding of clinical trials, drug development, or the pharmaceutical industry.

  • Experience prospecting into complex enterprise organizations with multiple stakeholders and long sales cycles.

  • Previous experience helping build or scale outbound sales processes in an early-stage startup.

  • Experience working with complex technical SaaS products.

  • Familiarity with sales engagement, automation, and AI-powered prospecting tools.

Hiring Process

Our hiring process typically takes 2–4 weeks and includes four stages:

  • Meet and Greet: A 30-minute conversation with our People team to get to know each other, your experience, and what motivates you.

  • Sales Deep Dive: A conversation with our Sales team to explore your prospecting experience, commercial mindset, and approach to generating opportunities.

  • Practical Assessment: A sales-focused exercise to understand how you research accounts, build outreach strategies, and engage potential customers.

  • Meet the Team: Join us at our Zürich office to meet the team, learn more about Rivia, and explore our mutual fit.

 

Our Values

At Rivia, we are committed to excellence, continuous learning, and the success of both our customers and our team. If you are driven to exceed targets, eager to shape the future of clinical trials, and passionate about making a meaningful difference in the biotech industry, Rivia is the place for you.

  • In it to Win it: Approach every challenge with determination, resilience, and a drive, aiming for the best outcomes and solutions.

  • Embrace change: We see change as an opportunity for growth, innovation, and improvement, continuously evolving to stay one step ahead

  • Why not?: Asking why not, instead of why, allows us to show our curiosity, allowing us to challenge assumptions and explore new possibilities.

  • Find the gap: We are curious and we proactively approach identifying opportunities and solving problems before they arise.

  • Collective accountability: We are one team, on one mission and we are committed to shared responsibilities and mutual support, enabling trust and collaboration.

data.title: Commercial Director - Bern (m/f/d)
data.description:
Intro

Willkommen bei Sanoptis – einem führenden Netzwerk moderner Augenkliniken und augenärztlicher Praxen mit über 580 Standorten in ganz Europa. Unsere Vision ist es, Wohlbefinden und Lebensqualität durch erstklassige augenärztliche Behandlung zu verbessern. Unser innovatives, dezentrales Modell ermöglicht es unseren Partnerstandorten, unabhängig zu operieren und sich auf die individuellen Bedürfnisse ihrer Patienten zu konzentrieren. Gleichzeitig sind sie Teil eines größeren Netzwerks mit starken Partnern, das ihnen Synergieeffekte, modernste Technik und viele weitere Vorteile bietet.

Dich begeistert ein Mix aus strategischem Gestaltungsspielraum und operativ-kommerzieller Optimierung und Du willst Deine wirtschaftliche Expertise bei einem dynamisch wachsenden Player der Augenheilkunde unter Beweis stellen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen.

In dieser Rolle wirst Du zur Führung und Optimierung der kaufmännischen Aktivitäten mehrerer Augenzentren in Bern die kaufmännische Geschäftsführung übernehmen. Dein Verantwortungsbereich umfasst die strategische Überwachung, das Leistungsmanagement, die Teamführung und die Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams. Dein Engagement für hervorragende Leistungen wird dazu beitragen, die Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, die Patientenzufriedenheit zu erhöhen und das Wachstum der Präsenz von Sanoptis in der Region zu fördern.


In dieser Rolle wirst Du

  • Unsere Augenzentren kaufmännisch leiten: Du wirst den Betrieb mehrerer Zentren wirtschaftlich leiten und dabei die Einhaltung der Sanoptis-Standards in den Einrichtungen sicherstellen.
  • Betriebsergebnisse und Geschäftsziele verantworten: Die betrieblichen Leistungskennzahlen zu Patientenzufriedenheit, Finanzindikatoren, Einnahmen, Ausgaben und Rentabilität wirst Du überwachen. Ferner wirst Du mit den Finanz- und Buchhaltungsteams bei der Entwicklung und Verwaltung von Budgets, Finanzprognosen und Kostenkontrollmaßnahmen zusammenarbeiten.
  • Leistungsziele definieren: Du wirst Leistungsbewertungen durchführen und Ziele definieren. Es ist Dir ein wesentliches Anliegen, für Deine Mitarbeiter und Teams ein positives Arbeitsumfeld zu gewährleisten, das Leistung durch effektive Kommunikation und Zusammenarbeit fördert.
  • Die regionale Strategie planen: Die Formulierung regionaler, strategischer Pläne im Einklang mit unseren übergeordneten Geschäftszielen erarbeitest Du. Hierfür wirst Du eng mit dem Head of Operations sowie Ärzten und Fachkräften vor Ort arbeiten und netzwerken.
  • Wachstum durch Standortentwicklung vorantreiben: Du siehst Wachstumschancen in Deiner Region und erkennst sie frühzeitig, um sie gewinnbringend zu nutzen. Du wirst durch effektive Marketing- und Werbestrategien zur Steigerung des Patientenaufkommens in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Marketingteam beitragen. Dein Ziel ist es, einen Ausbau des Marktanteils zu erreichen.


Du wirst zusammenarbeiten mit

  • Einem starken Operationsteam, bestehend aus vielen Ex-Beratern (Bain, BCG, Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman).
  • Leitenden Angestellten und Führungskräften bei Sanoptis, darunter der Head of Operations und das Führungsteam, das für klinische Innovation und hervorragende Dienstleistungen verantwortlich ist.
  • Renommierten Spezialisten und führenden Experten auf dem Gebiet der Augenheilkunde.
  • Einem engagierten und qualifizierten Team von medizinischen Fachkräften und Assistenzärzten.
  • Interdisziplinären Teams in unserem gesamten Netzwerk, einschließlich Technologieexperten, die an den neuesten Fortschritten in der augenmedizinischen Behandlung und digitalen Gesundheitslösungen arbeiten.


Dein Profil überzeugt durch

  • Einschlägige Berufserfahrung in einem anspruchsvollen Umfeld, z. B. in der Strategieberatung (McKinsey, Bain, BCG o.Ä.) oder in ähnlich schnelllebigen Unternehmen.
  • Die nachgewiesene Fähigkeit, Geschäfts- und Finanzanalysen auf Führungsebene zu erstellen und zu kommunizieren. Du erstellst Analysen akribisch und detailorientiert.
  • Unternehmerisches Denken mit der Fähigkeit, große Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Problemlösungen unabhängig voranzutreiben. Eine eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit wenig Anleitung ist essenziell.
  • Nachgewiesene Erfolge im Umgang mit Interessensgruppen, einschließlich der Fähigkeit, ohne formale Autorität Einfluss zu nehmen und Dir eine wichtige Rolle bei der Entscheidungsfindung zu sichern. Du besitzt die Fähigkeit, auch in schwierigen Situationen Konflikte konstruktiv zu lösen und Durchsetzungsstärke zu behalten.
  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten im Bereich Organisation und Prozessmanagement.
  • Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau), Französischkenntnisse von Vorteil sowie Englischkenntnisse.
  • Die Bereitschaft, Ergebnisse zu erzielen und Dich in einem schnelllebigen Umfeld mit hoher Verantwortung zu entfalten.


Sanoptis bietet Dir

  • Wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung: Ein äußerst attraktives Gehaltspaket, ergänzt durch einen jährlichen, leistungsabhängigen Bonus, der an individuelle und unternehmensspezifische Leistungsziele gebunden ist.
  • Eigenständigkeit und kreative Freiheit: Die Möglichkeit, Dich zu beweisen, indem Du selbstständig arbeitest und eigene, innovative Ideen umfassend einbringst als Führungspersönlichkeit.
  • Berufliche Entwicklung: Möglichkeiten für kontinuierliches Wachstum und Karrierechancen bei guter Leistung, unterstützt durch Schulungen, Online-Akademien, Workshops und Branchenkonferenzen.
  • Inklusive Kultur: Arbeiten in einem ambitionierten Team mit regelmäßigem Austausch und Teamveranstaltungen.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Vergünstigte Konditionen auf zahlreiche ausgewählte Markenprodukte und Dienstleistungen über unseren Partner Corporate Benefits.
  • Körperliches Wohlbefinden: Eine subventionierte Mitgliedschaft bei Wellpass, die Deine körperliche Gesundheit unterstützt.


Gleiche Chancen

Bei Sanoptis schätzen wir Talent, Leidenschaft und Einstellung über spezifische Erfahrungen. Wir begrüßen Bewerber aus verschiedenen Hintergründen und priorisieren gleiche Chancen für alle.

smino ist eine innovative Software-Lösung zur reibungslosen Koordinierung von Bauprojekten. Unsere Kunden erfassen mit Leichtigkeit Protokolle, weisen Aufgaben zu und teilen relevante Baupläne und Dateien mit allen Beteiligten. data.title: Embedded Control Engineer
data.description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.


BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Architect a breakthrough energy technology – Play a defining role in designing and integrating the systems that will power the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion plant, influencing decisions that shape the future of clean energy.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in fusion – Work across magnet design, HTS technology, manufacturing, structural integration, and controls, turning cutting-edge science into real hardware

  • Move fast and build what matters – Join a highly ambitious, multidisciplinary team that combines cutting-edge simulation with hands-on engineering, turning bold ideas into real hardware on the path to commercial fusion.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role, you will play a key part in developing the embedded control platform and will translate functional and control requirements into embedded hardware and software architectures, select appropriate microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA, or other controller technologies, and develop real-time software close to the hardware implementation. Your work will directly influence the performance, reliability, safety, and will require close collaboration with power electronics, integrated electronics, mechanical, thermal, and system engineers.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Define embedded controller architectures for power electronic converters and select suitable microcontrollers, DSP, FPGA.

  • Translate power electronics and control requirements into efficient, deterministic, and robust real-time software implementations.

  • Develop, test, debug, and validate embedded software on target hardware, from individual software blocks through complete controller implementations and automated testing environments to validate the design.

  • Explore new controller technologies, embedded architectures, and software implementation concepts to improve converter performance, flexibility, reliability, functionality, and maintainability.

WHO YOU ARE

  • You hold a University (Higher education) degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • You have a strong understanding of embedded architectures, and the practical considerations involved in selecting controllers for demanding real-time applications.

  • You are an expert in embedded software development for real-time applications, preferably in power electronics, industrial automation, or similar applications, spanning FPGA programming, systems programming, hardware interfaces and communication protocols.

  • You are experienced in monitoring and debugging software directly on target hardware

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with model-based development, hardware-in-the-loop testing, automated testing, or safety-critical software development is a plus.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-60 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

data.title: Analytical Chemistry Specialist - Freelance AI Trainer Project
data.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, which manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Analytical Chemistry Specialist – Freelance AI Trainer Project based in Switzerland.

Are you an analytical chemistry expert interested in contributing to the next generation of artificial intelligence? This freelance opportunity allows you to apply your scientific expertise to train and evaluate advanced AI models designed to support scientific discovery, education, and laboratory research. You will assess AI-generated responses to complex analytical chemistry questions, identify inaccuracies, and strengthen scientific reasoning across a wide range of applications. Your work will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and practical relevance of AI-generated scientific knowledge. Working remotely and independently, you will contribute specialized insights to the development of more capable and trustworthy AI systems. This role is ideal for experienced chemistry professionals who enjoy solving complex problems, communicating scientific concepts, and exploring the intersection of chemistry and emerging technology.


Accountabilities
  • Evaluate AI-generated scientific content: Review responses to theoretical and practical analytical chemistry questions, assessing their factual accuracy, logical consistency, scientific rigor, and relevance to real-world laboratory applications.
  • Apply specialized analytical chemistry knowledge: Develop and evaluate scenarios involving spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical analysis, quantitative chemical analysis, environmental testing, pharmaceutical analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Assess advanced analytical techniques: Challenge AI models on mass spectrometry, high-performance liquid chromatography (HPLC), gas chromatography (GC), nuclear magnetic resonance (NMR) interpretation, trace analysis, titrimetric methods, and related instrumentation.
  • Identify and document model weaknesses: Record reproducible errors, reasoning gaps, inaccurate interpretations, and other failure patterns to support systematic improvements in model performance.
  • Contribute to AI training and evaluation: Provide detailed scientific feedback, propose corrections, and recommend improvements to prompts, evaluation criteria, and testing methodologies.
  • Support scientific quality assurance: Apply principles of method validation, quality assurance and quality control (QA/QC), and analytical data interpretation to evaluate the reliability of AI-generated outputs.
  • Communicate scientific reasoning clearly: Explain conclusions, demonstrate analytical approaches, and document the steps behind technical judgments to help improve model transparency and reliability.

    • Requirements

  • Education: A PhD in analytical chemistry or a closely related chemical science discipline is preferred. Equivalent advanced expertise supported by relevant professional or research experience may also be valuable.
  • Technical expertise: Strong knowledge of analytical chemistry principles, instrumentation, spectroscopy, chromatography, electrochemical methods, quantitative analysis, and analytical method development.
  • Research or laboratory experience: Experience in laboratory-based research, analytical method validation, pharmaceutical or environmental testing, instrumentation-intensive studies, or related scientific applications is highly desirable.
  • Specialized analytical skills: Familiarity with techniques such as mass spectrometry, HPLC, GC, NMR, trace analysis, titrimetry, and laboratory QA/QC procedures.
  • Scientific evaluation skills: Ability to identify factual inaccuracies, assess scientific arguments, interpret experimental scenarios, and distinguish sound conclusions from flawed reasoning.
  • Written communication: Excellent technical writing skills and the ability to explain complex scientific concepts clearly, precisely, and logically.
  • Analytical thinking: Strong critical-thinking, problem-solving, and attention-to-detail skills, with the ability to break down complex problems and document reproducible findings.
  • AI training readiness: Interest in evaluating AI-generated content, identifying model limitations, and contributing to the development of more reliable scientific AI systems.
  • Working arrangements: Ability to work independently in a remote freelance environment, manage assignments effectively, and provide a secure computer and reliable high-speed internet connection.

    • Benefits

  • Competitive hourly compensation: A pay range of $8–$65 per hour, with the final rate determined by expertise, professional experience, and geographic location. The final offer may vary from the advertised range.
  • Remote flexibility: Work remotely from India, with the flexibility associated with a freelance contract arrangement.
  • Meaningful scientific impact: Help shape AI systems that may support scientific education, research, analytical problem-solving, and laboratory workflows.
  • Intellectually stimulating work: Apply advanced analytical chemistry knowledge to challenging scientific questions and emerging AI evaluation tasks.
  • Specialized professional contribution: Use your research, instrumentation, and laboratory expertise in an innovative technology-focused environment.
  • Independent contractor arrangement: Manage your work in a freelance capacity, subject to project requirements and applicable engagement terms.
  • Benefits clarification: This is a contract position. Company-sponsored benefits, including health insurance and paid time off (PTO), are not provided. Contractors are responsible for supplying their own computer and high-speed internet connection.

data.title: Senior Radiochemist
data.description:
ABOUT US

Transmutex is a Swiss company founded in 2019. Transmutex is currently advancing the HI-BEAM (High Intensity Breakthrough Engineering for Advanced Medicine) project, an ambitious programme to develop an industrial-scale facility for the reliable production of medical-grade Actinium-225 (Ac-225), a critical radionuclide for emerging targeted alpha therapies. 

Our team spans nuclear physics, engineering, software, radiochemistry, pharmaceutical and industrial development. Working with research labs and industrial partners worldwide, we are building the production capacity needed for the next generation of cancer treatments.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As the HI-BEAM project progresses from conceptual design into experimental validation, Transmutex is expanding its radiochemistry capability to translate established laboratory methods—supported by collaboration with leading international research institutes—into automated, reproducible, and commercially viable production processes.

We are seeking a Senior radiochemist to actively contribute to the technical design of Transmutex’ s radiochemistry process, in strong collaboration with renowned research labs. You will report to the Head of Extraction unit and be part of a small international team

You will primarily be based in Vernier, GE, with regular travel to Villigen, AG and to partner research labs in North America.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

Process development:

  • Design and optimize radiochemical separation and purification.
  • Collaborate across teams to develop radiochemical processes and methodology.
  • Perform radiochemical and chemical analyses, including alpha and gamma spectrometry.
  • Track radiochemistry developments and adopt relevant innovations and best practices.

Industrialization and operations:

  • Develop the radiochemical process flowsheet, including unit operations, process parameters, material balances, cycle times and waste streams.
  • cale up and transfer laboratory processes to a robust and GMP-compliant production line.
  • Define process, equipment, utility, instrumentation and facility-interface requirements.
  • Support equipment selection, sizing, qualification, commissioning and process validation.
  • Develop operating procedures, batch records, control strategies and consumables requirements.
  • Prepare laboratory and production operations aligned with capacity and customer needs.
  • Train and mentor colleagues.

Compliance, quality, and safety:

  • Work with QA and Safety to ensure regulatory compliance and meet applicable standards
  • Implement and monitor safety protocols and regulatory requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS AND PROFESSIONAL ACHIEVEMENTS

The candidates we are looking for must have:

  • PhD or Master’s degree in Radiochemistry, Nuclear Chemistry or related field
  • A minimum of 10 years of experience in radiochemistry.
  • Proven experience in radiochemical separation and purification with strong knowledge of actinide chemistry.
  • In-depth understanding of radiochemistry processes, equipment and tools.
  • Mastery of characterization, alpha or gamma spectrometry, ICP-MS, ICP-OES, liquid scintillation counting, or comparable analytical techniques.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of safety, radioprotection and GMP regulations and requirements. 
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with ability to collaborate effectively with multiple internal and external stakeholders across disciplines. 
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities to address complex technical challenges.
  • Proven experience in translating lab-scale processes to GMP production line would be an asset
  • Fluent in English. Excellent knowledge of French or German would be an asset

TERMS AND CONDITIONS

  • Start date:          early 2027, and no later than April 2027
  • Location:            Vernier, GE, with monthly presence at Villigen, AG; Switzerland. This position also involves regular travels to North America.
  • Contract:            Full-time, permanent employment contract
  • Package:             We offer competitive remuneration and social security, accident/disability insurance and pension plans; one day per week work from home, as well as five weeks’ paid vacation.

RECRUITMENT PROCESS:

One to two technical interviews with the hiring manager, HR and other Transmutex team members; interview with Management for shortlisted candidates. At least one interview will be organized on-site in Geneva.

data.title: Solution Consultant - R&D
data.description:
We are rebuilding biotech for the AI era.

When a breakthrough is delayed, the world waits. Getting a molecule from discovery to patients, or a crop from lab to field, involves thousands of slow, manual, disconnected steps. AI has the potential to change this, compressing decades of R&D work into years. But that only happens when clean, structured scientific data and AI are built into how science gets done.

Benchling is the AI platform for biotech R&D. Scientists use Benchling to design experiments, capture structured data, and run AI agents and models directly in their workflows. Over 200,000 scientists around the world trust Benchling to power their most important work, from academic labs to Sanofi, Moderna, and more than half of the world's top 50 biopharma.

We’re building an AI scientist for our customers. We can’t do that if we haven’t built the muscle ourselves. AI fluency is the foundation we build on; it's core to how we work, and we're committed to helping every new hire integrate it into their day-to-day. As part of our interview process, you'll complete a brief AI-focused exercise or discussion so we can understand how you think about and use AI to drive impact in your role. Feel free to reference any tools, platforms, or workflows you use today.

ROLE OVERVIEW

 Benchling Solution Consultants (SC) are the primary solution leads with Benchling’s largest customers and prospects. Their solutions are deployed into complex enterprise IT environments, interfacing with other vendor solutions, lab instruments, and legacy applications. This is a highly visible role that partners with both external and internal teams to develop the optimal solutions that drive the most value for our customers. The SC is a pre-sales role, and as such works closely with Benchling sales leadership, account executives, professional services, and product leaders to ensure the best solutions are presented. SCs work with senior scientific and IT leaders from prospects and customers, to establish credibility and confidence from the first meeting, and to create solutions based on cutting-edge technologies.

The SC must be comfortable with Life Sciences R&D processes and scientific concepts, have experience with enterprise SaaS solutions, and be adept at working with internal and external leaders and stakeholders. You must work as a trusted adviser to translate customer objectives into detailed solutions and effectively communicate and demonstrate those solutions to prospects and customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Effectively partner with account executives, SC peers, and leadership to create account and deal strategies that lead to selection, planning out customer engagements that lead to compelling solutions.

  • Manage organized discoveries to uncover customer needs and requirements that relate to decision criteria and key business issues.

data.title: Value Strategist
data.description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

ElevenLabs is looking for a Value Strategist to help our customers identify, quantify, and realize the business value of ElevenLabs across our portfolio, with a primary focus on ElevenAgents.

This is a senior individual contributor role within our global Revenue organization, spanning the full customer lifecycle from early sales conversations through proof of concept, deployment, renewal, and expansion. You will work directly with customers and prospects to understand their businesses, build the case for investment, and establish how that value will be measured over time.

On our most strategic accounts, Deployment Strategists in our Forward Deployed Engineering team already build account-specific business cases and ROI narratives as part of delivery. You will partner with them rather than duplicate that work. Your mandate is the value discipline across the whole book: the Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial accounts where no one is embedded, and where value today is quantified deal by deal or not at all. You will build the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, and playbooks that let every seller articulate and measure value consistently, and you will use what you learn from strategic deployments to make that methodology sharper.

This is not a quota-carrying role, nor is it a traditional advisory function. We are looking for a builder and a doer: someone who can engage credibly with senior customer stakeholders, get deep into a customer's operations and data, build rigorous models themselves, and turn ambiguous business problems into clear, actionable recommendations.

You will define how ElevenLabs understands, measures, and communicates customer value globally.

In this role you will

  • Shape value from the beginning. Partner with Revenue teams and prospects early in the sales cycle to understand customer priorities, identify high-value opportunities, and establish the business case for investing in ElevenLabs.

  • Build our global value strategy. Develop the frameworks, benchmarks, calculators, discovery approaches, and playbooks that define how ElevenLabs approaches value across industries and use cases.

  • Scale what works. Turn bespoke work with our largest customers into repeatable approaches that enable our Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Commercial teams to articulate and measure value without requiring bespoke support for every customer.

  • Identify where ElevenLabs can have the greatest impact. Develop a deep understanding of a customer's business, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities to determine which use cases have the greatest potential and why.

  • Quantify the opportunity. Build rigorous financial and operational models that translate ElevenLabs use cases into measurable outcomes across revenue, cost, productivity, customer experience, and other relevant dimensions.

  • Define how value will be proven. Establish success metrics and measurement approaches for proofs of concept and deployments so that customers and ElevenLabs have a shared understanding of what success looks like from the outset.

  • Measure value realization. Partner with customers and internal teams after deployment to understand the impact ElevenLabs is delivering, identify gaps between expected and realized value, and determine where additional opportunities exist.

  • Support expansion and long-term customer value. Use insights from existing deployments to help customers understand what they have achieved and identify where ElevenLabs can drive additional impact.

  • Work directly with the data. Analyze customer and industry data, build models, pressure-test assumptions, and develop recommendations yourself. You should be equally comfortable working in the details and communicating the implications.

  • Partner with Deployment. On strategic accounts, work alongside Deployment Strategists who own the account-level business case, contributing methodology and capturing what works into reusable assets. Across the rest of the book, be the primary owner of value quantification and measurement.

  • Influence senior stakeholders. Communicate complex analysis simply and credibly, and engage with senior leaders internally and externally when the opportunity requires it.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of relevant experience across operating roles, strategy, management consulting, analytics, finance, customer strategy, or other roles requiring rigorous business problem solving.

  • Strong operating judgment. You understand how businesses work and can quickly get underneath a customer's operating model, workflows, economics, and strategic priorities.

  • Exceptional analytical ability. You can personally build sophisticated financial and operational models, work with incomplete or imperfect information, make assumptions explicit, and turn analysis into decisions.

  • Structured problem solving. You are comfortable starting with an ambiguous question such as "Where could AI create the most value in this business?" and developing a rigorous approach to answering it.

  • Customer credibility. You can work directly with customers across functions and levels, ask incisive questions, challenge assumptions constructively, and establish trust quickly.

  • Commercial judgment. You understand how business value connects to technology investment decisions and can partner closely with Revenue teams while maintaining an objective, customer-first perspective.

  • Excellent communication. You can distill complex analysis into a clear point of view and communicate it effectively in writing and verbally, from working teams through senior executives.

  • A builder mentality. You are excited to start by doing the work yourself, learn from customers, and turn what works into scalable methodologies and tools.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace. You can move quickly across industries, customer types, and use cases while maintaining a high bar for analytical rigor.

  • Ability to operate globally. You are comfortable partnering with teams and customers across regions and traveling when valuable for customer work.

  • Willingness to travel. Must be willing and able to travel up to 10% of the time.

Bonus points

  • Experience in strategy or management consulting, particularly in operational transformation, technology, customer experience, or growth.

  • Experience as an operator within a technology company or other fast-moving business.

  • Experience working on AI, automation, customer experience, or technology-enabled business transformation.

  • Experience developing business cases, value frameworks, or analytical methodologies that were ultimately scaled beyond an individual project or customer.

  • Experience working with enterprise customers on complex, cross-functional initiatives.

Location

This is a global role within the Revenue organization. The role can be based in San Francisco or remotely, with the option to work from our San Francisco office.

You will work with customers and ElevenLabs teams across regions and should expect travel for customer meetings and onsite work when it meaningfully advances the work.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

data.title: Senior Sales Engineer - UK
data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role

As a Sales Engineer it’s your mission to show the value of Camunda and guide organizations planning to automate their core business processes.

You accompany prospective customers in their product evaluation of Camunda. You are responsible for achieving the product win, getting answers to all product related technical questions, and arranging all presales interactions driving the evaluation.

In this role you will partner with our Account Executives and Solution Architects, supporting you by conducting proof of concepts or handling other deeply technical discussions. You will help qualify opportunities and then help set and execute a sales strategy to achieve a win.

The effectiveness of Camunda's Sales Engineers is gauged by their ability to convert prospects into Camunda customers both efficiently and at a high rate.

This position requires a strong interest in cutting-edge software technologies. You should take pleasure in crafting sample code or custom demonstrations and exploring new technology, even if you're not highly experienced in software development. By empathizing with prospects, you better grasp their requirements and have engaging technical conversations, and excel at clarifying how Camunda's technology can benefit their business.

What you'll be doing:

  • Map customer requirements to our Camunda product portfolio

  • Position potential quantitative and qualitative business value of Camunda

  • Develop individual Camunda evaluation plans and demos for our prospects

  • Conduct product demos and product related Q&A sessions

  • Support the completion of RFI / RFP documents

  • Team with Account Executives to develop accounts

  • Organize and execute pre-sales engagements

  • Implement code snippets

  • Create and maintain pre-sales content and technical artifacts

What you bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product.

  • Strong Technical Foundation:
     A degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field—or equivalent practical experience. Solid understanding of programming fundamentals, modern software engineering practices, and common IT/system architectures.

  • Proven Sales Engineering Experience:
     Experience in Sales Engineering or Pre-Sales, with a deep understanding of sales cycles, value-based selling, and stakeholder engagement. Skilled in handling objections and driving deals to closure in a consultative selling environment.

  • Communication Excellence:
     Exceptional presentation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives tailored to technical and non-technical audiences alike.

  • Language Proficiency:
     Fluent in English (C1/C2 level or native proficiency)

  • Travel Flexibility:
     Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings, events, and team collaboration..

This role is an existing vacancy

#LI-AL1 #LI-remote #EMEAWest

What We Have to Offer:

Compensation

We offer competitive, fair, and transparent compensation. Salary ranges are location-based, with Standard and Major markets (global tech hubs) reflecting local competition.

The Annual Total Target Cash (base salary + 100% variable target, where applicable) shown below spans from the minimum in a Standard market to the maximum in a Major market. Final offers depend on skills, experience, and location, and we typically hire in the first half of the range to allow room for growth:

  • United States: $175,200.00 to $282,400.00

  • United Kingdom: £110,000.00 to £180,900.00

  • Singapore: S$217,500.00 to S$326,300.00

If you’re based elsewhere, you’ll be hired via Remote.com (our global employer partner), and your Talent Acquisition Partner will provide a personalized Total Rewards Calculator after your first interview.

Equity: We also offer equity (where applicable) through our Virtual Stock Option Plan (VSOP).

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • Remote & Flexible: Work from anywhere with the setup that suits you, home office budget, co-working space support, and flexible time off to recharge when you need it.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access locally tailored healthcare, Modern Health for global mental wellbeing, and our Live Well Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA), a flexible, global benefit that puts you in control of your whole life, not just work, from: staying active, to caring for family, exploring personal passions, meaningful experiences, and investing in your financial wellbeing. The Live Well program launches in 2026 and scales to €1,000 annually from 2027.

  • Financial Security: Retirement and pension plans (often with company contributions), plus life and disability insurance where relevant.

  • Professional Growth: Up to $/€/£1,000 per year for self-driven learning: courses, certifications, books, you decide!

At Camunda, we honour diverse cultures and backgrounds and are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to gender, race, ethnicity, religion, belief, sexual orientation, age, disability or any other protected characteristics under applicable law. data.title: Director, Business Development
data.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry? Are you interested in helping international brands/organizations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect was founded with a mission to help the world's businesses navigate the global marketplace. Today, we have grown to be an industry leader organization by helping clients globalize their business no matter what service they might need. TransPerfect provides a full array of language and business support services, including translation, subtitling and dubbing, multicultural marketing, website globalization, legal support, and any kind of technology solution.

That’s enough about us – what about you? We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

TransPerfect is looking for established sales professionals to further develop our engagement model. The Director of Business Development will be responsible for identifying and engaging with client prospects as well as managing client relationships during the full life cycle of client campaigns. Minimum 3 years experience in a similar role required.

Key position responsibilities:

  • Source and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (tradeshows, regional organizations, etc.)

  • Build a productive pipeline and manage each phase of the sales process

  • Cultivate and maintain long term relationships with clients by delivering elite client service and engaging them by using knowledge of each industry and organization

  • Formulate sales plan to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets

  • Generate daily outreach efforts (direct mail, digital marketing, cold calls) to prospective clients

  • Develop an effective understanding of the capabilities, benefits, and competitive advantages of TransPerfect's services

  • Present TransPerfect's solutions via one-on-one, group, online and in-person meetings

  • Set and manage client expectations while consulting with each client for best practices

  • Manage and control pricing and contractual issues

  • Travel (including multiple annual conferences, client meetings) - domestic and/or international


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Essential experience required:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent experience

  • Minimum 3 years successful sales experience

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in German and English

  • Familiarity and ability to communicate value and competitive advantages

TransPerfect values equal opportunities. Applicants are therefore considered regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnic origin, skin colour, religion, belief, descent, genes, disabilities, sexual orientation, marital status or other characteristics worthy of protection. Applicants with disabilities are welcome and encouraged. If you experience any issues with your application process or require assistance please contact ----- style="text-align:start;min-height: 1.7em;">

data.title: Solutions Consultant
Customer Service Specialist
DevOps Engineer
data.description:
Bij Centric geloven we dat technologie de wereld beter kan maken. Daarom zijn we constant op zoek naar enthousiaste en gedreven professionals zoals jij, die het verschil willen maken. Maak werk van deze mogelijkheden.

Wat jij doet

Als je van uitdagende technische opdrachten binnen het Cloud spectrum houdt, dan past Centric perfect bij jou. Je duikt in de wereld van Azure, of AWS, bij de ene opdracht werk je bij een financiële instelling en bij de volgende bij een overheidsinstelling. Het kan als Cloud DevOps Engineer bij Centric. Daarnaast bieden wij je de kans om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen.

Je duikt in de wereld van de Cloud en ontwerpt, implementeert en beheert de CI/CD DevOps pipelines. Hoe je dit doet? Door jouw kennis en ervaring effectief in te zetten bij klanten. Wat doe je onder andere nog meer?

  • Je ontwerpt, implementeert en automatiseert CI/CD pipelines en maakt hierbij gebruik van infrastructure-as-code

  • Je denkt en praat mee over source control en branching strategieën

  • Jouw infrastructure-as-code zorgt ervoor dat de infrastructuur die je uitrolt veilig is en compliant met het beleid van je opdrachtgever

  • Het zorgen voor het implementeren van beveiligingsprotocollen en compliance standaarden. 

Als Cloud DevOps Engineer treed je in dienst bij Centric en word je ingezet bij één of meerdere opdrachtgevers. De diversiteit in werklocaties, welke maximaal één uur van huis liggen, laat je kennismaken met vele organisaties. Zo blijf je ontwikkelen binnen jouw vakgebied. Met je Field Manager stel je een persoonlijk ontwikkelplan op en samen bepalen jullie welke opleidingen, training(en) en opdrachten passen bij jouw ontwikkelingswensen. Tot slot word je onderdeel van het expertisecentrum, waarin kennisdeling en onderlinge coaching met collega’s centraal staat.

 

Dit krijg je

Bij Centric bieden we een dynamische omgeving waarin je jouw vaardigheden kunt benutten voor diverse uitdagende projecten bij boeiende klanten. Hier krijg je de mogelijkheid om voortdurend bij te leren en te groeien in een omgeving die in de voorhoede staat van de nieuwste ontwikkelingen. Daarnaast kun je als Cloud Engineer rekenen op:

  • Een brutosalaris tot € 5.960,- per maand afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

  • Een winstdeling tot wel 50% van het gemiddelde bruto maandsalaris

  • Mogelijkheid tot thuiswerken en een goede werk-privébalans doordat je de ruimte krijgt om te bepalen hoe jij jouw werkweek indeelt

  • Uitgebreide opleidings- en ontwikkelmogelijkheden

  • 26 vakantiedagen, 8% vakantietoeslag (uitbetaling in mei) en loyaliteitsdagen: hoe langer je in dienst bent, hoe meer vrije tijd

  • Een bijdrage aan je pensioen en korting op je collectieve zorgverzekering

  • Een laptop en telefoon van de zaak

  • Een thuiswerkplekvergoeding van € 15,- per maand plus € 2,45 netto per thuiswerkdag en een mobiliteitsbudget, omdat jij zelf wil bepalen hoe je van huis naar het werk reist

  • Personeelsaanbiedingen bij toonaangevende merken

  • Een bonus tot € 1.500,- als jij een nieuwe collega aan ons voorstelt

  • Een personeelsvereniging die écht leuke dingen organiseert. Ga je mee naar Praag, de Efteling of skiën?

Dit breng je mee

Wij zorgen voor een werkomgeving waar jij blij kunt zijn en gewaardeerd wordt. Andersom vragen wij van jou als DevOps Engineer:

  • Minimaal 3 jaar werkervaring als Cloud DevOps Engineer

  • Hbo- of wo diploma in een technische richting

  • Bekwaamheid in scripttalen zoals PowerShell, Python of Bash, Golang, Bicep

  • Ervaring met configuratiebeheertools zoals Ansible, Chef of Puppet  

  • Bekendheid met containerisatie-technologieën zoals Docker en Kubernetes

  • Grondig begrip van netwerkconcepten, waaronder VPN, VNet en firewalls. CI/CD en Release Engineering tooling en praktijken

  • Containerisatie en Orchestratie. SRE-praktijken en principes

  • In bezit van een rijbewijs

Soft Skills: 

  • Uitstekende probleemoplossende en analytische vaardigheden

  • Sterke communicatieve en samenwerkingsvaardigheden

  • Vermogen om zelfstandig te werken en meerdere taken tegelijk te beheren.

Certificeringen: 

  • AZ-305, AZ 104 of AZ 204 certificering is een pluspunt.

Omring jezelf met mogelijkheden bij Centric

Word jij enthousiast van het ontwerpen, implementeren en automatiseren van CI/CD pipelines? Solliciteer via onze website naar deze vacature DevOps Engineer in Amsterdam of Rotterdam. Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met André Menger via +31 610949754, of

Hier starten jouw kansen

Zonder dat je het weet, ben je met Centric in aanraking geweest. Als je betaalt in de winkel. Als je een glas kraanwater drinkt. Als je een paspoort aanvraagt. Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien.

Zodra je onze businessunit Professional Staffing komt versterken, omring jij jezelf met mogelijkheden. Zo kun je jouw kennis vergroten door samen te werken met ruim 500 (gedetacheerde) collega’s. Als partner van ministeries, banken, verzekeraars en andere toonaangevende organisaties zorgen wij er dagelijks voor dat complexe projecten en veeleisende vraagstukken geen obstakels zijn, maar uitdagingen die met vertrouwen tegemoet getreden worden. Of het nu gaat om korte of lange opdrachten: de professionals van Centric Professional Staffing staan klaar om het verschil voor en bij onze opdrachtgevers te maken!

 

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

 

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures. Toegestuurde cv’s (in welke vorm dan ook) door genoemde partijen aan enige medewerkers van Centric zonder geldige schriftelijke zoekopdracht van onze HR Afdeling of Recruiters, worden beschouwd als publieke informatie. Er zal aan genoemde partijen geen vergoeding zijn verschuldigd in geval dat een kandidaat wordt aangenomen van wie ongevraagd het cv en/of andere gegevens zijn toegestuurd.

data.title: Senior Applicatie Consultant Burgerzaken
data.description:
Werken op het snijvlak van burgerzaken, technologie en dienstverlening. Dat is precies wat je doet als Senior Applicatie Consultant Burgerzaken bij Centric Digitale Overheid. Jij bent het primaire aanspreekpunt voor overheidsorganisaties die ondersteuning nodig hebben bij hun Burgerzaken-applicatie en treedt daarbij op als ambassadeur van Centric. Met jouw sterke helicopterview ben je in staat om overzicht te houden en effectief te sturen op binnenkomende meldingen. Je haalt energie uit het begeleiden van klanten, het optimaliseren van processen en het leveren van een positieve maatschappelijke bijdrage. Maak werk van deze mogelijkheden!

Wat jij doet

Je werkt samen met collega’s aan oplossingen binnen Burgerzaken die de digitale dienstverlening van gemeenten en andere overheidsorganisaties versterken. data.description:
Ben jij een ervaren Network Architect met brede multi-vendor kennis? Zoek je een rol waarin je technische diepgang combineert met mentoring en innovatie? Dan is dit jouw kans om impact te maken bij Centric!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Network Architect binnen Centric Cloud & Dataservices (DC & Network Services) werk je aan uitdagende projecten voor diverse klanten. Je ontwerpt en beheert complexe netwerkinfrastructuren met routers, switches, firewalls, WAFs en load balancers, zowel in de private als public cloud. Samen met het Securityteam integreer je geavanceerde beveiligingsmaatregelen zoals DDoS-bescherming, IPS/IDS en next-gen firewalls in jouw netwerkontwerpen.  Naast de focus op networking houd je ook de raakvlakken met het verdere IT Landschap zoals virtualisatie, compute en applicaties in beeld.
In het team met collega architecten bepaal je innovatieve oplossingen, waarmee we onze diensten secure, beschikbaar, geautomatiseerd en efficiënt aan onze klanten kunnen bouwen.

data.title: DevSecOps Lead | Software Quality & Security
data.description:
Vacature DevSecOps Lead bij Centric. Leid software quality, application security en DevSecOps, werk met Azure DevOps, CI/CD, security automation, Secure SDLC en cloud-native softwareontwikkeling.

Als DevSecOps Lead | Software Quality & Security ben jij de expert die de technische kwaliteit, security en software delivery van ons softwareportfolio naar een hoger niveau tilt. Je zorgt ervoor dat softwareontwikkeling, cloud deployment, security governance en DevSecOps-principes naadloos samenkomen binnen meer dan 20 bedrijfskritische applicaties voor diverse klanten.

Duizenden organisaties en hun miljoenen klanten rekenen elke dag weer op onze 200+ technologische oplossingen, hoogwaardige IT-diensten en 3.700 gekwalificeerde professionals. Samen zorgen we dat belangrijke processen in onze samenleving altijd doordraaien. 

Bij Centric Services werk je aan innovatieve oplossingen voor gemeenten, overheden, retailers, banken en vele andere sectoren. Je draagt dagelijks bij aan het leveren van een sterk full scope IT-services concept met een Nederlands karakter. Ons concept omvat alles van cloud- en applicatiebeheer tot het creëren van veilige en toekomstbestendige werkomgevingen, maatwerkapplicaties en detachering. Het verschil wordt gemaakt door onze medewerkers, en dat horen we keer op keer van onze klanten. Sluit jij je aan bij ons team?

We only have positions available for Dutch-speaking applicants residing in the Netherlands.

Centric aanvaardt geen ongevraagde hulp van intermediairs/uitzendbureaus of andere derden voor onze vacatures.
